local function smooth(a,b,x)
	local t=math.clamp((x-a)/(b-a),0,1)
	return t*t*(3-2*t)
end
local function gaussian(x,z,cx,cz,rx,rz)
	local dx,dz=(x-cx)/rx,(z-cz)/rz
	return math.exp(-dx*dx-dz*dz)
end
local function ellipse(x,z,center,radii)
	local dx,dz=(x-center.X)/radii.X,(z-center.Y)/radii.Y
	return math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz)
end
function C.lakeRadius(x,z)
	local dx,dz=(x-C.Lake.center.X)/450,(z-C.Lake.center.Y)/300
	local angle=math.atan2(dz,dx)
	return math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz)/(1+.055*math.sin(angle*3+.4)+.035*math.cos(angle*5))
end
local function streamProbe(x,z)
	local best,level,width=math.huge,nil,nil
	for i=1,#C.Stream-1 do
		local a,b=C.Stream[i],C.Stream[i+1]
		local dx,dz=b.position.X-a.position.X,b.position.Z-a.position.Z
		local t=math.clamp(((x-a.position.X)*dx+(z-a.position.Z)*dz)/(dx*dx+dz*dz),0,1)
		local px,pz=a.position.X+dx*t,a.position.Z+dz*t
		local d=math.sqrt((x-px)^2+(z-pz)^2)
		if d<best then best=d;level=a.position.Y+(b.position.Y-a.position.Y)*t;width=a.width+(b.width-a.width)*t end
	end
	return best,level,width
end
function C.height(x,z)
	local h=22+82*smooth(-1850,-150,z)+160*smooth(250,1650,z)+150*smooth(1400,2200,z)
	h+=232*gaussian(x,z,120,2160,580,430)+68*gaussian(x,z,-1550,1550,650,650)
	h+=48*gaussian(x,z,-1300,50,620,900)+62*gaussian(x,z,580,1050,700,500)
	h+=5*math.sin(x/195)*math.cos(z/170)+3*math.sin((x+z)/115)
	-- Low enclosing ridges hide the rectangular south/east/west Terrain edge.
	-- The north already has the tall mountain backdrop and is not raised here.
	local edgeDistance=math.min(2000-math.abs(x),2250+z)
	h+=130*(1-smooth(0,180,edgeDistance))
	local r=C.lakeRadius(x,z)
	if r<1.30 then
		local floor=53-43*(1-math.clamp(r,0,1))^.65
		h=floor+(h-floor)*smooth(.95,1.30,r)
		local island=ellipse(x,z,C.Lake.islandCenter,C.Lake.islandRadii)
		if island<1.5 then h=h+(C.Lake.islandTop-h)*(1-smooth(.7,1.5,island)) end
	end
	local swamp=ellipse(x,z,C.Swamp.center,C.Swamp.radii)
	if swamp<1.32 then
		local wet=59+2.2*math.sin(x/67)*math.cos(z/83)+1.4*math.sin(z/39)
		h=wet+(h-wet)*smooth(.62,1.32,swamp)
	end
	if x>300 and x<850 and z>300 and z<1200 then
		local d,level,width=streamProbe(x,z)
		local bed=math.min(h,level-3)
		h=bed+(h-bed)*smooth(width*.5,width*.5+65,d)
	end
	-- Flatten the clearings, then blend generously into the surrounding hills.
	for _,q in C.Zones do
		local dx,dz=x-q.x,z-q.z
		local radius=if q.kind=="Camp" then C.CampSafeRadius else q.width*.52
		local outer=radius+260
		if math.abs(dx)<outer and math.abs(dz)<outer then
			local d=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz)
			if d<outer then h=q.y+(h-q.y)*smooth(radius,outer,d) end
		end
	end
	-- A narrow rock lip above the 57-stud waterfall and a readable receiving
	-- basin below it. Apply after the nearby B clearing's broad terrain blend.
	local fallsX=math.abs(x-720)
	if fallsX<48 and z>850 and z<990 then
		local side=1-smooth(24,48,fallsX)
		local lower=side*smooth(850,860,z)*(1-smooth(900,910,z))
		h=h+(math.min(h,207)-h)*lower
		local upper=side*smooth(900,910,z)*(1-smooth(965,990,z))
		h=h+(math.max(h,264)-h)*upper
	end
	return h
end

local function junctionGrade(p)
	local y=p.Y
	for _,j in C.RoadJunctions do
		local dx,dz=p.X-j.center.X,p.Z-j.center.Y
		local d=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz)
		if d<j.radius then y=j.height+(y-j.height)*smooth(j.inner,j.radius,d) end
	end
	for _,q in C.Zones do
		local dx,dz=p.X-q.x,p.Z-q.z
		local inner=if q.kind=="Camp" then C.CampSafeRadius+36 else q.width*.5+64
		local outer=inner+360
		if math.abs(dx)<outer and math.abs(dz)<outer then
			local d=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz)
			if d<outer then y=q.y+(y-q.y)*smooth(inner,outer,d) end
		end
	end
	-- A distant node's broad blend must not give the two sides of an authored
	-- shared fork different heights. These small inner plateaux lie outside
	-- every node's protected clearing and therefore retain their common grade.
	for _,j in C.RoadJunctions do
		local dx,dz=p.X-j.center.X,p.Z-j.center.Y
		local d=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz)
		if d<j.inner+120 then y=j.height+(y-j.height)*smooth(j.inner,j.inner+120,d) end
	end
	return Vector3.new(p.X,y,p.Z)
end
C.applyRoadJunctionGrade=junctionGrade
local function rawSamples(edge,spacing)
	local controls=C.controlPoints(edge)
	local samples={controls[1]};local last=controls[1];local step=spacing or 20
	local function append(p)
		table.insert(samples,p);last=p
	end
	local function lineTo(p)
		local a=last
		local distance=Vector2.new(p.X-a.X,p.Z-a.Z).Magnitude
		for j=1,math.max(1,math.ceil(distance/step)) do append(a:Lerp(p,j/math.max(1,math.ceil(distance/step)))) end
	end
	for i=2,#controls-1 do
		local prev,corner,nextPoint=controls[i-1],controls[i],controls[i+1]
		local incoming=Vector3.new(corner.X-prev.X,0,corner.Z-prev.Z)
		local outgoing=Vector3.new(nextPoint.X-corner.X,0,nextPoint.Z-corner.Z)
		local radius=math.min(100,incoming.Magnitude*.22,outgoing.Magnitude*.22)
		if radius<1 then lineTo(corner) else
			local entry=corner-(corner-prev)*(radius/incoming.Magnitude)
			local exit=corner+(nextPoint-corner)*(radius/outgoing.Magnitude)
			lineTo(entry)
			local n=math.max(3,math.ceil(radius*2/step))
			for j=1,n do local t=j/n;append(entry:Lerp(corner,t):Lerp(corner:Lerp(exit,t),t)) end
		end
	end
	lineTo(controls[#controls])
	for i,p in samples do samples[i]=junctionGrade(p) end
	return samples
end
-- One dense height profile per corridor is shared by every requested spacing.
-- Node pads and common forks are fixed anchors; grade limits are applied only
-- between them, so callers at 8/16/24 studs cannot create conflicting roads.
local profileCache={}
local gradeLimit=math.tan(math.rad(17.4))
local function fixedGrade(p)
	for _,q in C.Zones do
		local inner=if q.kind=="Camp" then C.CampSafeRadius+36 else q.width*.5+64
		if (p.X-q.x)^2+(p.Z-q.z)^2<=inner*inner then return true end
	end
	for _,j in C.RoadJunctions do
		if (p.X-j.center.X)^2+(p.Z-j.center.Y)^2<=j.inner*j.inner then return true end
	end
	return false
end
local function profile(edge)
	if profileCache[edge] then return profileCache[edge] end
	local points=rawSamples(edge,8)
	local arc={0};local fixed={}
	for i,p in points do
		if i>1 then
			local a=points[i-1]
			arc[i]=arc[i-1]+Vector2.new(p.X-a.X,p.Z-a.Z).Magnitude
		end
		fixed[i]=i==1 or i==#points or fixedGrade(p)
	end
	local left=1
	while left<#points do
		local right=left+1
		while right<#points and not fixed[right] do right+=1 end
		local a,b=points[left],points[right]
		local length=arc[right]-arc[left]
		-- Fixed fork/clearing anchors define the corridor. For a very short
		-- numerical interval, retaining that anchor is safer than moving a pad.
		if length>0 and math.abs(b.Y-a.Y)<=gradeLimit*length+.001 then
			for i=left+1,right-1 do
				local fromLeft,fromRight=arc[i]-arc[left],arc[right]-arc[i]
				local low=math.max(a.Y-gradeLimit*fromLeft,b.Y-gradeLimit*fromRight)
				local high=math.min(a.Y+gradeLimit*fromLeft,b.Y+gradeLimit*fromRight)
				local p=points[i];points[i]=Vector3.new(p.X,math.clamp(p.Y,low,high),p.Z)
			end
			for i=left+1,right-1 do
				local p,prev=points[i],points[i-1]
				local allowance=gradeLimit*(arc[i]-arc[i-1])
				points[i]=Vector3.new(p.X,math.clamp(p.Y,prev.Y-allowance,prev.Y+allowance),p.Z)
			end
		end
		left=right
	end
	profileCache[edge]={points=points,arc=arc,length=arc[#arc]}
	return profileCache[edge]
end
function C.samples(edge,spacing)
	local data=profile(edge)
	local result={data.points[1]}
	local step=math.max(1,spacing or 20)
	local segment=1
	for distance=step,data.length-.001,step do
		while segment<#data.points-1 and data.arc[segment+1]<distance do segment+=1 end
		local a,b=data.points[segment],data.points[segment+1]
		local t=(distance-data.arc[segment])/math.max(.001,data.arc[segment+1]-data.arc[segment])
		table.insert(result,a:Lerp(b,t))
	end
	table.insert(result,data.points[#data.points])
	return result
end
-- Spatially index short grading segments. A terrain query inspects only its
-- 128-stud cell, rather than every segment in the entire 18-million-stud map.
local CELL=128
local cells={}
local gradingSegments={}
local function key(x,z) return math.floor(x/CELL)*10000+math.floor(z/CELL) end
for _,group in {{edges=C.Edges,width=72},{edges=C.HumanPaths,width=24}} do
	for _,edge in group.edges do
		local points=C.samples(edge,24)
		local width=edge.width or group.width
		for i=1,#points-1 do
			local a,b=points[i],points[i+1]
			local dx,dz=b.X-a.X,b.Z-a.Z
			local segment={a=a,b=b,dx=dx,dz=dz,inv=1/math.max(1,dx*dx+dz*dz),half=width*.5}
			table.insert(gradingSegments,segment)
			local margin=segment.half+32
			for ix=math.floor((math.min(a.X,b.X)-margin)/CELL),math.floor((math.max(a.X,b.X)+margin)/CELL) do
				for iz=math.floor((math.min(a.Z,b.Z)-margin)/CELL),math.floor((math.max(a.Z,b.Z)+margin)/CELL) do
					local cellKey=ix*10000+iz
					local list=cells[cellKey]
					if not list then list={};cells[cellKey]=list end
					table.insert(list,segment)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end
C.GradingSegmentCount=#gradingSegments
function C.terrainHeight(x,z)
	local h=C.height(x,z)
	local list=cells[key(x,z)]
	if not list then return h,false,math.huge end
	local best,chosen,bestT=math.huge,nil,0
	local nearestLine=math.huge
	for _,s in list do
		local t=math.clamp(((x-s.a.X)*s.dx+(z-s.a.Z)*s.dz)*s.inv,0,1)
		local dx,dz=x-s.a.X-s.dx*t,z-s.a.Z-s.dz*t
		local centerDistance=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz)
		if centerDistance<nearestLine then nearestLine=centerDistance end
		local d=centerDistance-s.half
		if d<best then best,chosen,bestT=d,s,t end
	end
	if chosen and best<32 then
		local center=chosen.a.Y+(chosen.b.Y-chosen.a.Y)*bestT
		return h+(center-h)*(1-smooth(0,32,best)),best<=0,nearestLine
	end
	return h,false,nearestLine
end
function C.waterLevel(x,z,groundHeight)
	local h=groundHeight or C.height(x,z)
	if C.lakeRadius(x,z)<1.2 and h<C.LakeLevel then return C.LakeLevel,"Lake" end
	if ellipse(x,z,C.Swamp.center,C.Swamp.radii)<1.05 and C.Swamp.level-h>=3 then return C.Swamp.level,"Swamp" end
	if x>300 and x<850 and z>300 and z<1200 then
		local d,level,width=streamProbe(x,z)
		if d<width*.48 and h<level then return level,"Stream" end
	end
	return nil,nil
end
function C.biome(x,z)
	if z< -1570 and math.abs(x)<700 then return "RangerStation" end
	if z>1450 then return "Mountains" end
	if x>900 and z> -1000 and z<650 then return "Swamp" end
	if z>650 and x< -250 and x> -1150 then return "LoggingCamp" end
	if z>650 and x>= -250 then return "StoneValley" end
	if x< -850 and z> -650 then return "PineForest" end
	if C.lakeRadius(x,z)<1.75 then return "Lake" end
	return "Meadow"
end
function C.materialHint(x,z,height,onRoad)
	height=height or C.height(x,z)
	local biome=C.biome(x,z)
	if onRoad then return "Ground",biome end
	if biome=="Mountains" and height>420 then return "Slate",biome end
	if biome=="StoneValley" then return "Rock",biome end
	if biome=="Swamp" then return "Mud",biome end
	if biome=="PineForest" or biome=="LoggingCamp" then return "Ground",biome end
	if C.lakeRadius(x,z)<1.30 then return "Sand",biome end
	return "LeafyGrass",biome
end
return C

	green = Color3.fromRGB(65, 235, 115),
	glow = Color3.fromRGB(110, 255, 150),
	glass = Color3.fromRGB(90, 220, 130),
}

-- Shared native/offline placement contract. Local -Z faces back toward spawn;
-- offsets within the five-tube V are applied after this collision-aware frame.
function Geometry.clusterFrame(spawnPosition: Vector3, shelterPosition: Vector3, baseId: number): CFrame
	assert(typeof(spawnPosition) == "Vector3" and typeof(shelterPosition) == "Vector3", "Base positions must be Vector3")
	local layout = assert(Geometry.ClusterLayout[baseId], "Unknown bio-tube base")
	local difference = shelterPosition - spawnPosition
	local back = V(difference.X, 0, difference.Z)
	assert(back.Magnitude > .001, "Base has no valid shelter-facing direction")
	back = back.Unit
	local ground = V(spawnPosition.X, spawnPosition.Y - .3, spawnPosition.Z)
	return CFrame.fromMatrix(ground, Vector3.yAxis:Cross(back), Vector3.yAxis, back)
		* CFrame.new(layout.ShiftX, 0, layout.Distance)
end

local function group(parent, name)
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = name
	folder.Parent = parent
	return folder
end

local function part(parent, origin, name, size, localFrame, color, material, collide, className)
	local object = Instance.new(className or "Part")
	object.Name = name
	object.Size = size
	object.CFrame = origin * localFrame
	object.Color = color
	object.Material = material or Enum.Material.Metal
	object.Anchored = true
	object.CanCollide = collide == true
	object.CanQuery = collide == true
	object.CanTouch = false
	object.CastShadow = material ~= Enum.Material.Neon and material ~= Enum.Material.Glass
	object.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	object.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	object.Parent = parent
	return object
end

local function cylinder(parent, origin, name, diameter, height, localFrame, color, material, collide)
	local object = part(parent, origin, name, V(height, diameter, diameter),
		localFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi / 2), color, material, collide)
	object.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	return object
end

local function beam(parent, origin, name, a, b, width, color, material)
	local delta = b - a
	local direction = delta.Unit
	local reference = if math.abs(direction.Y) > .95 then Vector3.zAxis else Vector3.yAxis
	local z = direction:Cross(reference).Unit
	local y = z:Cross(direction).Unit
	local object = part(parent, origin, name, V(delta.Magnitude, width, width),
		CFrame.fromMatrix((a + b) * .5, direction, y, z), color, material, false)
	object.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	return object
end

-- Explicit orthonormal basis gives identical results in native Studio and
-- the offline authoring runtime, including headings in the southern half.
local function aimFrame(position, target)
	local back = (position - target).Unit
	local reference = if math.abs(back.Y) > .95 then Vector3.zAxis else Vector3.yAxis
	local right = reference:Cross(back).Unit
	return CFrame.fromMatrix(position, right, back:Cross(right).Unit, back)
end

-- A real eight-sided prism: three rectangular slabs and four horizontal
-- triangular wedges. No overlapping rotated squares or solid round proxy.
local function octagon(parent, origin, name, diameter, height, y, color)
	local shell = group(parent, name)
	local radius = diameter * .5
	local a, b = radius * math.cos(math.pi / 8), radius * math.sin(math.pi / 8)
	part(shell, origin, "CentralSlab", V(a * 2, height, b * 2), CFrame.new(0, y, 0), color, nil, true)
	for _, side in {-1, 1} do
		part(shell, origin, "Wing_" .. side, V(b * 2, height, a - b),
			CFrame.new(0, y, side * (a + b) * .5), color, nil, true)
	end
	for index = 1, 4 do
		local corner = CFrame.Angles(0, (index - 1) * math.pi / 2, 0)
		local horizontalWedge = CFrame.fromMatrix(V((a + b) * .5, y, (a + b) * .5),
			Vector3.yAxis, Vector3.xAxis, -Vector3.zAxis)
		part(shell, origin, "BeveledCorner_" .. index, V(height, a - b, a - b),
			corner * horizontalWedge, color, nil, true, "WedgePart")
	end
	return shell
end

local function ring(parent, origin, name, radius, y, height, thickness, segments, color, material)
	local assembly = group(parent, name)
	local length = 2 * radius * math.tan(math.pi / segments) + .015
	for index = 1, segments do
		local angle = TAU * (index - 1) / segments
		part(assembly, origin, "Segment_" .. index, V(length, height, thickness),
			CFrame.new(math.sin(angle) * radius, y, math.cos(angle) * radius)
				* CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0), color, material, false)
	end
	return assembly
end

local function marker(parent, origin, name, position)
	local object = part(parent, origin, name, V(.05, .05, .05), CFrame.new(position), C.black,
		Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, false)
	object.Transparency = 1
	object.CastShadow = false
	return object
end

-- Build one 19.2-stud tube; tubeCFrame is the ground origin and local -Z is
-- its front. Markers are direct children and never inherit a second offset.
-- Public contract: PrimaryPart/StaticOrigin, DisplaySlot, SpecimenAnchor (8.7),
-- InjectorAnchor (14.5), Interaction.SpecimenTubePrompt (G).
function Geometry.build(parent: Instance, tubeCFrame: CFrame, slot: number): Model
	assert(parent and typeof(tubeCFrame) == "CFrame", "BioTube requires a parent and ground CFrame")
	assert(slot % 1 == 0 and slot >= 1 and slot <= 5, "BioTube slot must be 1..5")
	local tube = Instance.new("Model")
	tube.Name = "BioTube_" .. slot
	tube:SetAttribute("DisplaySlot", slot)
	tube:SetAttribute("StaticOrigin", tubeCFrame)
	tube:SetAttribute("BioTubeGeometryVersion", Geometry.Version)
	tube:SetAttribute("VisualHeight", Geometry.Height)
	tube:SetAttribute("VisualDiameter", Geometry.Diameter)
	tube:SetAttribute("IdleBubbleRate", 14)
	tube.Parent = parent
	local root = marker(tube, tubeCFrame, "TubeRoot", V(0, .025, 0))
	root.PivotOffset = CFrame.new(0, -.025, 0)
	tube.PrimaryPart = root
	local lower = group(tube, "LowerMechanicalAssembly")
	octagon(lower, tubeCFrame, "OctagonBase_Low", 12, 1.1, .55, C.iron)
	octagon(lower, tubeCFrame, "BevelBase_Upper", 10.4, .9, 1.55, C.steel)
	octagon(lower, tubeCFrame, "BottomLockCollar", 10.2, .35, 2.175, C.edge)
	for index = 1, 8 do
		local angle = (index - 1) * TAU / 8
		local radial = V(math.sin(angle), 0, math.cos(angle))
		local a, b = radial * 5.46 + V(0, .65, 0), radial * 4.82 + V(0, 3.25, 0)
		local delta = b - a
		part(lower, tubeCFrame, "MechanicalButtress_" .. index, V(.6, .72, delta.Magnitude),
			aimFrame((a + b) * .5, b), C.steel, nil, false)
		part(lower, tubeCFrame, "ButtressFoot_" .. index, V(.9, .3, .72),
			CFrame.new(radial * 5.33 + V(0, .25, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0), C.iron, nil, false)
		if index % 2 == 0 then
			part(lower, tubeCFrame, "LowerStatusLight_" .. index, V(.52, .13, .13),
				CFrame.new(radial * 5.67 + V(0, .85, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0), C.glow, Enum.Material.Neon, false)
		end
	end
	-- Six straight sections per pipe follow a curved return path; they are
	-- intentionally kept behind the side braces, away from the front specimen.
	for _, side in {-1, 1} do
		local pipeName = if side < 0 then "CoolantPipe_L" else "CoolantPipe_R"
		local path = {V(side * 3.6, 1.1, 3.0), V(side * 4.5, 1.65, 3.0),
			V(side * 5.2, 2.4, 2.7), V(side * 5.35, 3.15, 2.1),
			V(side * 5.1, 3.75, 1.4), V(side * 4.7, 3.95, .9), V(side * 4.4, 3.8, .6)}
		for index = 1, #path - 1 do
			beam(lower, tubeCFrame, pipeName .. "_" .. index, path[index], path[index + 1], .28, C.black, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
		end
		for _, index in {1, #path - 1} do
			local a, b = path[index], path[index + 1]
			local center = a:Lerp(b, .5)
			local direction = (b - a).Unit
			beam(lower, tubeCFrame, pipeName .. "_Coupling_" .. index, center - direction * .16,
				center + direction * .16, .4, C.edge, Enum.Material.Metal)
		end
	end

	local chamber = group(tube, "ContainmentChamber")
	local bottomDisc = cylinder(chamber, tubeCFrame, "BottomGlowDisc", 9, .18,
		CFrame.new(0, 2.36, 0), Color3.fromRGB(185, 255, 205), Enum.Material.Neon, false)
	-- A hollow wall keeps the body visible without the two broad flat caps of
	-- a transparent solid cylinder. It is also the physical containment shell.
	local glass = ring(chamber, tubeCFrame, "GlassOuterWall", 4.84, 8.7, 13, .08, 24, C.glass, Enum.Material.Glass)
	for _, pane in glass:GetChildren() do
		pane.Transparency = .62
		pane.Reflectance = .03
		pane.CanCollide = true
		pane.CanQuery = true
	end
	local fluid = cylinder(chamber, tubeCFrame, "BioFluidColumn", 9.2, 12.7,
		CFrame.new(0, 8.65, 0), C.green, Enum.Material.Neon, false)
	fluid.Transparency = .84 -- Preserve the actual specimen silhouette through both layers.
	for index = 1, 4 do
		local angle = math.pi / 4 + (index - 1) * math.pi / 2
		part(chamber, tubeCFrame, "GlassSeamRail_" .. index, V(.12, 12.6, .12),
			CFrame.new(math.sin(angle) * 4.94, 8.7, math.cos(angle) * 4.94), C.steel, nil, false)
	end
	local emitterAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	emitterAttachment.Name = "BioBubblesOrigin"
	-- BottomGlowDisc is rotated; this converts the world-up emitter frame into
	-- that disc's local frame, preventing sidewards bubbles on rotated bases.
	emitterAttachment.CFrame = bottomDisc.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(tubeCFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2.5, 0))
	emitterAttachment.Parent = bottomDisc
	local bubbles = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	bubbles.Name = "BioBubbles"
	bubbles.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds"
	bubbles.Color = ColorSequence.new(C.glow)
	bubbles.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, .1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.8, .17), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, .11)})
	bubbles.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, .75), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.85, .83), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
	bubbles.Speed = NumberRange.new(1.4, 2.6)
	bubbles.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(4.2, 5.2)
	bubbles.Rate = 14
	bubbles.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
	bubbles.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(14, 14)
	bubbles.LightEmission = .65
	bubbles.LightInfluence = 0
	bubbles.LockedToPart = true
	bubbles.Parent = emitterAttachment
	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Name = "ContainmentGlow"
	light.Color = C.green
	light.Brightness = .35
	light.Range = 11
	light.Shadows = false
	light.Parent = bottomDisc

	local head = group(tube, "MultiTieredMechanicalDome")
	ring(head, tubeCFrame, "OuterRecessedShroud", 5.43, 16.4, 1.6, .7, 16, C.iron, Enum.Material.Metal)
	ring(head, tubeCFrame, "CeilingNeonRing_Outer", 4.8, 15.55, .13, .15, 16, C.glow, Enum.Material.Neon)
	ring(head, tubeCFrame, "CeilingNeonRing_Inner", 3.6, 15.55, .13, .13, 16, C.glow, Enum.Material.Neon)
	cylinder(head, tubeCFrame, "RibbedCoolingCore", 6.8, 1.1, CFrame.new(0, 15.35, 0), C.steel, nil, false)
	for index = 1, 24 do
		local angle = (index - 1) * TAU / 24
		part(head, tubeCFrame, "CoolingFin_" .. index, V(.12, .95, .45),
			CFrame.new(math.sin(angle) * 3.48, 15.35, math.cos(angle) * 3.48) * CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0),
			C.edge, nil, false)
	end
	for index = 1, 4 do
		local angle = math.pi / 4 + (index - 1) * math.pi / 2
		local radial = V(math.sin(angle), 0, math.cos(angle))
		local a, b = radial * 5.2 + V(0, 15.85, 0), radial * 2.7 + V(0, 15.1, 0)
		local frame = aimFrame((a + b) * .5, b)
		local length = (b - a).Magnitude
		part(head, tubeCFrame, "AngledMechanicalStrut_" .. index, V(.45, .22, length), frame, C.steel, nil, false)
		for _, side in {-1, 1} do
			part(head, tubeCFrame, "StrutChannel_" .. index .. "_" .. side, V(.1, .55, length),
				frame * CFrame.new(side * .225, .1, 0), C.iron, nil, false)
		end
	end
	-- The specimen supplies a rotary collar at Y14.58..14.68 and its cable
	-- ports at Y14.385..14.615. Leave that whole central sweep unobstructed.
	-- Eight stationary feed valves are outboard of the rotating port envelope.
	cylinder(head, tubeCFrame, "CentralInjectorHub", 3.8, .4, CFrame.new(0, 14.925, 0), C.steel, nil, false)
	cylinder(head, tubeCFrame, "InjectorHubLowerCollar", 3.0, .1, CFrame.new(0, 14.75, 0), C.iron, nil, false)
	for index = 1, 8 do
		local angle = (index - 1) * TAU / 8
		local x, z = math.sin(angle) * 1.55, math.cos(angle) * 1.55
		cylinder(head, tubeCFrame, "InjectorValveStem_" .. index, .1, .55,
			CFrame.new(x, 14.525, z), C.steel, nil, false)
		cylinder(head, tubeCFrame, "InjectorNozzle_" .. index, .2, .3,
			CFrame.new(x, 14.1, z), C.glow, Enum.Material.Neon, false)
	end
	-- These five upper tiers close the shroud from above and make the complete
	-- authored silhouette reach Y=19.2, rather than ending at the old 17.2 cap.
	for _, tier in {
		{"UpperArmorDeck", 10.8, .7, 17.55, C.iron},
		{"RaisedBevelPlate", 9.6, .3, 18.05, C.steel},
		{"UpperLockRing", 7.7, .3, 18.35, C.edge},
		{"PowerCrown", 5.4, .4, 18.7, C.iron},
		{"CrownCap", 4.3, .3, 19.05, C.steel},
	} do
		cylinder(head, tubeCFrame, tier[1], tier[2], tier[3], CFrame.new(0, tier[4], 0), tier[5], nil, false)
	end

	local panel = part(lower, tubeCFrame, "TubeControlPanel", V(2.3, 1.3, .25),
		CFrame.new(0, 2.95, -5.23), C.black, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, false)
	label(panel, slot)
	marker(tube, tubeCFrame, "SpecimenAnchor", V(0, 8.7, 0))
	marker(tube, tubeCFrame, "InjectorAnchor", V(0, 14.5, 0))
	local interaction = marker(tube, tubeCFrame, "Interaction", V(0, 3.1, -6.8))
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.Name = "SpecimenTubePrompt"
	prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.G
	prompt.ActionText = "Chọn khủng long"
	prompt.ObjectText = if slot == 5 then "Ống #5 · Trung tâm" else "Ống #" .. slot
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 11
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0
	prompt:SetAttribute("DisplaySlot", slot)
	prompt.Parent = interaction
	local partCount = 0
	for _, object in tube:GetDescendants() do
		if object:IsA("BasePart") then partCount += 1 end
	end
	tube:SetAttribute("StaticPartCount", partCount)
	return tube
end

return Geometry

-- StarterPlayerScripts.HunDinoAdminFly to remove the feature completely.

local function finite(n) return type(n)=="number" and n==n and math.abs(n)<1e7 end

local function landing(player,s)
	local root=s.root

	local ignore={s.character}
	for _,name in {"TrainingPets","Dinosaur01_TRex_Visual"} do
		local object=workspace:FindFirstChild(name);if object then table.insert(ignore,object) end
	end
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances=ignore;params.RespectCanCollide=true;params.IgnoreWater=false
	local hit=workspace:Raycast(root.Position+Vector3.new(0,2048,0),Vector3.new(0,-4096,0),params)

	if player:GetAttribute("InHunting")==true then
		local map=workspace:FindFirstChild("HuntingRainforest")
		local offset=map and map:GetAttribute("WorldOffset") or Vector3.new(0,0,6500)
		local p=root.Position-offset
		inArea=math.abs(p.X)<=2000 and math.abs(p.Z)<=2250
	end
	if inArea and hit and hit.Material~=Enum.Material.Water and hit.Normal.Y>.5 then
		local p=hit.Position+Vector3.new(0,math.max(3,s.humanoid.HipHeight+root.Size.Y*.5)+.15,0)
		local look=Vector3.new(root.CFrame.LookVector.X,0,root.CFrame.LookVector.Z)

local function stop(player,land)

		if s.added then s.added:Disconnect() end
		for p,collide in s.collisions do if p.Parent then p.CanCollide=collide end end

	local s={character=c,humanoid=h,root=r,attachment=a,velocity=lv,orientation=orientation,

local function setSpeed(player,value)

local function control(player,action,value)

	if action=="Toggle" then
		if states[player] then stop(player,true) else start(player) end
	elseif action=="SetEnabled" and typeof(value)=="boolean" then
		if value then start(player) else stop(player,true) end

remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,action,value,look,boost)
	-- The server policy is checked on every request; client attributes are UI only.
	if not allowed(player) or type(action)~="string" then return end
	local now=os.clock();local p=packets[player]
	if not p or now-p.window>=1 then p={window=now,count=0,lastControl=-math.huge};packets[player]=p end
	p.count+=1;if p.count>60 then return end
	if action=="Move" then
		local s=states[player];if not s or not vector(value) or value.Magnitude>4 then return end
		s.direction=if value.Magnitude>1 then value.Unit else value
		if vector(look) then
			local horizontal=Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
			if horizontal.Magnitude>.01 then s.look=horizontal.Unit end
		end
		s.boost=boost==true;s.lastMove=now

		if now-p.lastControl<.18 then return end;p.lastControl=now

end)

local heartbeat=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	local now=os.clock()
	for player,s in states do
		if not allowed(player) or player.Character~=s.character or not s.root.Parent or s.humanoid.Health<=0 then
			stop(player,s.humanoid.Health>0);continue
		end
		local dir=if now-s.lastMove<.4 then s.direction else Vector3.zero
		local selected=player:GetAttribute("AdminFlySpeed")
		local speed=if Policy.ValidateSpeed(selected) then selected else Policy.DefaultSpeed
		local wanted=dir*speed*(if s.boost then Policy.BoostMultiplier else 1)
		local p=s.root.Position
		if p.Y>Policy.MaxAltitude or math.abs(p.X)>Policy.MaxHorizontal or math.abs(p.Z)>Policy.MaxHorizontal then
			local point=Vector3.new(math.clamp(p.X,-Policy.MaxHorizontal,Policy.MaxHorizontal),math.min(p.Y,Policy.MaxAltitude),math.clamp(p.Z,-Policy.MaxHorizontal,Policy.MaxHorizontal))
			s.character:PivotTo(s.character:GetPivot()+point-p);wanted=Vector3.zero
		end
		if p.Y< -30 then s.character:PivotTo(s.character:GetPivot()+Vector3.new(0,-30-p.Y,0));wanted=Vector3.zero end
		s.currentVelocity=s.currentVelocity:Lerp(wanted,1-math.exp(-12*math.min(dt,.1)))
		s.velocity.VectorVelocity=s.currentVelocity
		if Vector3.new(s.look.X,0,s.look.Z).Magnitude>.01 then s.orientation.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero,Vector3.new(s.look.X,0,s.look.Z)) end

-- Feet follow the collision surface rather than the old body's height offset.
local Placement = {}

function Placement.position(character: Model, point: Vector3, pets: Instance?): Vector3
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = if pets then { character, pets } else { character }
	params.RespectCanCollide = true
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local height = if root then root.Position.Y else point.Y
	local result = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(point.X, height + 6, point.Z), Vector3.new(0, -128, 0), params)
	local fallback = height - (if hum then hum.HipHeight else 2) - (if root then root.Size.Y / 2 else 1)
	return Vector3.new(point.X, (if result then result.Position.Y else fallback) + 0.03, point.Z)
end

function Placement.place(pet: Model, character: Model, cf: CFrame, pets: Instance?)
	local goal = Placement.position(character, cf:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(3, 0, 3)), pets)
	pet:PivotTo(CFrame.new(goal) * cf.Rotation)
end

return Placement

-- Server-side jaw motion. This module only moves the mouth; it deals no damage.
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local JawController = {}
JawController.__index = JawController
local controllers = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local function setting(model, name, default, minimum, maximum)
	local value = model:GetAttribute(name)
	if typeof(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value or math.abs(value) == math.huge then
		value = default
	end
	return math.clamp(value, minimum, maximum)
end

function JawController.new(model)
	if controllers[model] then
		return controllers[model]
	end
	local motor = assert(model:FindFirstChild("JawMotor", true), "Missing JawMotor")
	assert(motor:IsA("Motor6D") and motor.Part0 and motor.Part1, "Invalid jaw rig")
	local closedC0 = assert(motor:GetAttribute("ClosedC0"), "Missing closed jaw pose")
	local self = setmetatable({
		Model = model,
		Motor = motor,
		ClosedC0 = closedC0,
		_angle = Instance.new("NumberValue"),
		_generation = 0,
		_busy = false,
		_destroyed = false,
		_lastBite = -math.huge,
	}, JawController)
	self._changed = self._angle.Changed:Connect(function(angle)
		-- The hinge's X axis crosses the skull. Negative rotation opens downward.
		motor.C0 = closedC0 * CFrame.Angles(-math.rad(angle), 0, 0)
		model:SetAttribute("JawOpenDegrees", angle)
	end)
	motor.C0 = closedC0
	model:SetAttribute("JawOpenDegrees", 0)
	model:SetAttribute("BitePhase", "Idle")
	controllers[model] = self
	return self
end

function JawController:_limit(angle)
	return math.clamp(angle, 0, setting(self.Model, "JawMaxOpenDegrees", 30, 0, 35))
end

-- Manual posing for previews; returns false while a bite is already running.
function JawController:SetOpenAngle(angle)
	if self._busy or self._destroyed then
		return false
	end
	assert(typeof(angle) == "number" and angle == angle, "Angle must be a number")
	self._angle.Value = self:_limit(angle)
	return true
end

function JawController:_move(angle, duration, style, direction, generation)
	if self._destroyed or generation ~= self._generation then
		return false
	end
	self._tween = TweenService:Create(self._angle, TweenInfo.new(duration, style, direction), {
		Value = self:_limit(angle),
	})
	self._tween:Play()
	local state = self._tween.Completed:Wait()
	return not self._destroyed and generation == self._generation
		and state == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed
end

-- Yields until the bite finishes. BindableEvent callbacks can call this directly.
function JawController:Bite()
	if self._destroyed or self._busy then
		return false, "Busy"
	end
	local model = self.Model
	local cooldown = setting(model, "BiteCooldown", 1, 0, 10)
	if os.clock() - self._lastBite < cooldown then
		return false, "Cooldown"
	end
	self._lastBite = os.clock()
	self._busy = true
	self._generation += 1
	local generation = self._generation
	model:SetAttribute("BitePhase", "Opening")
	if not self:_move(setting(model, "JawMaxOpenDegrees", 30, 0, 35),
		setting(model, "JawOpenTime", 0.32, 0.05, 3), Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,
		Enum.EasingDirection.Out, generation) then
		return false, "Cancelled"
	end
	model:SetAttribute("BitePhase", "Holding")
	task.wait(setting(model, "JawHoldTime", 0.12, 0, 3))
	if self._destroyed or generation ~= self._generation then
		return false, "Cancelled"
	end
	model:SetAttribute("BitePhase", "Closing")
	if not self:_move(0, setting(model, "JawCloseTime", 0.14, 0.05, 3),
		Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In, generation) then
		return false, "Cancelled"
	end
	self._busy = false
	model:SetAttribute("BitePhase", "Idle")
	return true
end

function JawController:Cancel()
	self._generation += 1
	if self._tween then
		self._tween:Cancel()
	end
	self._angle.Value = 0
	self.Motor.C0 = self.ClosedC0
	self._busy = false
	self.Model:SetAttribute("JawOpenDegrees", 0)
	self.Model:SetAttribute("BitePhase", "Idle")
end

function JawController:Destroy()
	if self._destroyed then
		return
	end
	self:Cancel()
	self._destroyed = true
	self._changed:Disconnect()
	self._angle:Destroy()
	controllers[self.Model] = nil
end

return JawController

-- the two presentation pivots; no character, physics joint or source art changes.
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local Specimen = {}
local TAG = "HunDinoBioSpecimen"
local GREEN = Color3.fromRGB(90, 255, 140)
local STEEL = Color3.fromRGB(83, 105, 108)
local BLACK = Color3.fromRGB(16, 24, 25)
local MAX_RADIUS, MAX_HEIGHT, CENTER_Y, INJECTOR_Y = 3.8, 10.5, 8.7, 14.5

-- These are landmarks of the shipped T-Rex, not a replacement dinosaur.
-- Offset is a fraction of the selected real mesh's aligned half extents.
-- Normal is the direction from the skin toward the cable.
local SOCKETS = {
	{Name = "SkullTop", Part = "head_geom", Offset = Vector3.new(0, 0, .20), Normal = Vector3.yAxis, Width = .13},
	{Name = "Neck_L", Part = "body_geom", Offset = Vector3.new(0, .24, -.48), Normal = -Vector3.xAxis, Width = .12, Fluid = true},
	{Name = "Neck_R", Part = "body_geom", Offset = Vector3.new(0, .24, -.48), Normal = Vector3.xAxis, Width = .12, Fluid = true},
	{Name = "Spine_Upper", Part = "body_geom", Offset = Vector3.new(0, 0, -.34), Normal = Vector3.yAxis, Width = .18},
	{Name = "Spine_Mid", Part = "body_geom", Offset = Vector3.new(0, 0, .04), Normal = Vector3.yAxis, Width = .18},
	{Name = "Spine_Lower", Part = "body_geom", Offset = Vector3.new(0, 0, .40), Normal = Vector3.yAxis, Width = .17},
	{Name = "Shoulder_L", Part = "body_geom", Offset = Vector3.new(0, .22, -.30), Normal = -Vector3.xAxis, Width = .15},
	{Name = "Shoulder_R", Part = "body_geom", Offset = Vector3.new(0, .22, -.30), Normal = Vector3.xAxis, Width = .15},
	{Name = "Sternum", Part = "body_geom", Offset = Vector3.new(0, -.10, 0), Normal = -Vector3.zAxis, Width = .16, Fluid = true},
	{Name = "Rib1_L", Part = "body_geom", Offset = Vector3.new(0, -.06, -.06), Normal = -Vector3.xAxis, Width = .12},
	{Name = "Rib1_R", Part = "body_geom", Offset = Vector3.new(0, -.06, -.06), Normal = Vector3.xAxis, Width = .12},
	{Name = "Rib2_L", Part = "body_geom", Offset = Vector3.new(0, -.21, .28), Normal = -Vector3.xAxis, Width = .11},
	{Name = "Rib2_R", Part = "body_geom", Offset = Vector3.new(0, -.21, .28), Normal = Vector3.xAxis, Width = .11},
	{Name = "Pelvis", Part = "body_geom", Offset = Vector3.new(0, 0, .64), Normal = Vector3.yAxis, Width = .14, Fluid = true},
}

local function eachCorner(part: BasePart, callback)
	local half = part.Size * .5
	for _, x in {-1, 1} do
		for _, y in {-1, 1} do
			for _, z in {-1, 1} do
				callback(part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(half.X * x, half.Y * y, half.Z * z)))
			end
		end
	end
end

local function bounds(parts: {BasePart}, frame: CFrame?): (Vector3, Vector3)
	local low = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
	local high = -low
	for _, part in parts do
		eachCorner(part, function(world)
			local point = if frame then frame:PointToObjectSpace(world) else world
			low = Vector3.new(math.min(low.X, point.X), math.min(low.Y, point.Y), math.min(low.Z, point.Z))
			high = Vector3.new(math.max(high.X, point.X), math.max(high.Y, point.Y), math.max(high.Z, point.Z))
		end)
	end
	return low, high
end

local function realParts(model: Model): {BasePart}
	local parts = {}
	for _, object in model:GetDescendants() do
		if object:IsA("BasePart") then
			object.Anchored = true
			object.CanCollide, object.CanTouch, object.CanQuery = false, false, false
			object.AssemblyLinearVelocity, object.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
			if object.Transparency < 1 then table.insert(parts, object) end
		end
	end
	assert(#parts > 0, "The real specimen visual has no visible geometry")
	return parts
end

local function namedPart(model: Model, name: string): BasePart
	local part = model:FindFirstChild(name, true)
	assert(part and part:IsA("BasePart"), "Missing real specimen anatomy: " .. name)
	return part
end

local function fit(model: Model, origin: CFrame)
	local parts = realParts(model)
	model:PivotTo(CFrame.new())
	-- Imported mesh art faces diagonally relative to its rig root. Derive the
	-- anatomy's forward direction before centering; otherwise a fixed #5 turns away.
	local forward = namedPart(model, "head_geom").Position - namedPart(model, "body_geom").Position
	forward = Vector3.new(forward.X, 0, forward.Z)
	assert(forward.Magnitude > .001, "Cannot determine the specimen's forward direction")
	local heading = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, forward.Unit)
	model:PivotTo(heading:Inverse() * model:GetPivot())
	local low, high = bounds(parts)
	local center, radius = (low + high) * .5, 0
	for _, part in parts do
		eachCorner(part, function(point)
			local offset = point - center
			radius = math.max(radius, Vector2.new(offset.X, offset.Z).Magnitude)
		end)
	end
	-- Radius of every part corner includes the entire tail at every yaw angle.
	-- Checking only width and depth would clip the glass midway through rotation.
	local factor = math.min(MAX_RADIUS / math.max(radius, .001), MAX_HEIGHT / math.max(high.Y - low.Y, .001))
	model:ScaleTo(model:GetScale() * factor)
	low, high = bounds(parts)
	center = (low + high) * .5
	model:PivotTo(origin * CFrame.new(0, CENTER_Y, 0) * CFrame.new(-center) * model:GetPivot())
	return factor, radius * factor, (high.Y - low.Y)
end

local function axisFrame(position: Vector3, axis: Vector3): CFrame
	local reference = if math.abs(axis:Dot(Vector3.yAxis)) > .95 then Vector3.zAxis else Vector3.yAxis
	local up = (reference - axis * reference:Dot(axis)).Unit
	return CFrame.fromMatrix(position, axis, up, axis:Cross(up))
end

local function cylinder(parent: Instance, name: string, size: Vector3, frame: CFrame, color: Color3, neon: boolean?): Part
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name, part.Shape, part.Size, part.CFrame = name, Enum.PartType.Cylinder, size, frame
	part.Color, part.Material = color, if neon then Enum.Material.Neon else Enum.Material.Metal
	part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanTouch, part.CanQuery = true, false, false, false
	part.CastShadow = false
	part.TopSurface, part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth, Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.Parent = parent
	return part
end

local function surfacePoint(part: BasePart, socket, origin: CFrame): (Vector3, Vector3, boolean)
	local low, high = bounds({part}, origin)
	local center, half = (low + high) * .5, (high - low) * .5
	local offset = socket.Offset
	local target = origin:PointToWorldSpace(center + Vector3.new(half.X * offset.X, half.Y * offset.Y, half.Z * offset.Z))
	local normal = origin:VectorToWorldSpace(socket.Normal).Unit
	local reach = part.Size.Magnitude * 2 + 2
	local parameters = RaycastParams.new()
	parameters.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	parameters.FilterDescendantsInstances = {part}
	parameters.IgnoreWater = true
	-- Only this clone is made queryable, only while sampling its actual collision
	-- surface. This never changes the original rig or broadens gameplay queries.
	local previous = part.CanQuery
	part.CanQuery = true
	local ok, hit = pcall(function()
		local result = Workspace:Raycast(target + normal * reach, -normal * reach * 2, parameters)
		if not result then
			result = Workspace:Raycast(part.Position + normal * reach, -normal * reach * 2, parameters)
		end
		return result
	end)
	part.CanQuery = previous
	if ok and hit and hit.Instance == part then return hit.Position, hit.Normal, true end
	-- ServerStorage / isolated inspection has no Workspace collision world. A
	-- genuine part-surface fallback keeps the attachment on the mesh's bounds;
	-- production mounts in Workspace normally use the surface raycast above.
	local localTarget = part.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(target)
	local localNormal = part.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(normal)
	local h = part.Size * .5
	local ratios = {
		{math.abs(localNormal.X), "X"}, {math.abs(localNormal.Y), "Y"}, {math.abs(localNormal.Z), "Z"},
	}
	table.sort(ratios, function(a, b) return a[1] > b[1] end)
	local x, y, z = math.clamp(localTarget.X, -h.X, h.X), math.clamp(localTarget.Y, -h.Y, h.Y), math.clamp(localTarget.Z, -h.Z, h.Z)
	local side = ratios[1][2]
	local n
	if side == "X" then x = h.X * (if localNormal.X >= 0 then 1 else -1); n = Vector3.new(math.sign(x), 0, 0)
	elseif side == "Y" then y = h.Y * (if localNormal.Y >= 0 then 1 else -1); n = Vector3.new(0, math.sign(y), 0)
	else z = h.Z * (if localNormal.Z >= 0 then 1 else -1); n = Vector3.new(0, 0, math.sign(z)) end
	return part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(x, y, z)), part.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(n), false
end

function Specimen.mount(tube: Model, template: Model, record: table): Model
	assert(tube and tube:IsA("Model"), "A BioTube model is required")
	assert(template and template:IsA("Model"), "The real TRex specimen visual is required")
	assert(type(record) == "table" and record.SpeciesId == "TRex", "Unsupported specimen species")
	local slot = tube:GetAttribute("DisplaySlot")
	assert(type(slot) == "number" and slot >= 1 and slot <= 5 and slot % 1 == 0, "BioTube requires DisplaySlot 1..5")
	local configuredOrigin = tube:GetAttribute("StaticOrigin")
	local origin = if typeof(configuredOrigin) == "CFrame" then configuredOrigin else tube:GetPivot()
	local previous = tube:FindFirstChild("SpecimenAssembly")
	local assembly = Instance.new("Model")
	assembly.Name = "SpecimenAssembly_Pending"
	assembly.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Atomic
	assembly:PivotTo(origin)
	assembly.Parent = tube
	local ok, result = xpcall(function()
		local model = template:Clone()
		assert(model, "The sanitized TRex template is not archivable")
		model.Name, model.Parent = "Specimen", assembly
		local factor, radius, height = fit(model, origin)
		local implants = Instance.new("Folder")
		implants.Name, implants.Parent = "ImplantSockets", model
		local rotor = Instance.new("Model")
		rotor.Name, rotor.Parent = "RotatingInjector", assembly
		rotor:PivotTo(origin)
		cylinder(rotor, "InjectorRotaryCollar", Vector3.new(.10, 2.60, 2.60), origin * axisFrame(Vector3.new(0, INJECTOR_Y + .13, 0), Vector3.yAxis), STEEL)
		local cables = Instance.new("Folder")
		cables.Name, cables.Parent = "BioTetherCables", assembly
		local raycastCount = 0
		for index, socket in SOCKETS do
			local part = namedPart(model, socket.Part)
			local point, normal, sampled = surfacePoint(part, socket, origin)
			if sampled then raycastCount += 1 end
			local pierce = Instance.new("Attachment")
			pierce.Name = "Pierce_" .. socket.Name
			pierce.CFrame = part.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(axisFrame(point, normal))
			pierce:SetAttribute("SurfaceSampled", sampled)
			pierce.Parent = part
			local implant = cylinder(implants, "ImplantSocket_" .. socket.Name, Vector3.new(.26, .26, .26), axisFrame(point + normal * .02, normal), STEEL)
			implant:SetAttribute("BodyPartName", part.Name)
			cylinder(implants, "ImplantGlow_" .. socket.Name, Vector3.new(.05, .28, .28), axisFrame(point + normal * .09, normal), GREEN, true)
			local endpoint = Instance.new("Attachment")
			endpoint.Name = "CableEnd_" .. socket.Name
			endpoint.CFrame = implant.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(axisFrame(point + normal * .15, -normal))
			endpoint.Parent = implant
			local angle = (index - 1) * math.pi * 2 / #SOCKETS
			local portRadius = if index % 2 == 0 then .80 else 1.14
			local portPosition = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * portRadius, INJECTOR_Y, math.sin(angle) * portRadius)
			local port = cylinder(rotor, "InjectorPort_" .. index, Vector3.new(.23, .24, .24), origin * axisFrame(portPosition, -Vector3.yAxis), STEEL)
			cylinder(rotor, "InjectorPortGlow_" .. index, Vector3.new(.05, .255, .255), origin * axisFrame(portPosition - Vector3.new(0, .07, 0), -Vector3.yAxis), GREEN, true)
			local start = Instance.new("Attachment")
			start.Name = "CableStart_" .. socket.Name
			local radial = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle))
			local tangent = (radial * .7 - Vector3.yAxis).Unit
			start.CFrame = port.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(origin * axisFrame(portPosition - Vector3.new(0, .12, 0), tangent))
			start.Parent = port
			local cable = Instance.new("Beam")
			cable.Name = "BioCable_" .. socket.Name
			cable.Attachment0, cable.Attachment1 = start, endpoint
			cable.FaceCamera, cable.Segments = true, 16
			cable.Width0, cable.Width1 = socket.Width, socket.Width * .86
			cable.CurveSize0 = if socket.Name:find("Rib", 1, true) then 2.20 else 1.55
			cable.CurveSize1 = if socket.Normal.Y == 1 then .55 else 1.18
			cable.Color = ColorSequence.new(if socket.Fluid then GREEN else BLACK)
			cable.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(if socket.Fluid then .16 else 0)
			cable.LightEmission = if socket.Fluid then .65 else .04
			cable.LightInfluence = if socket.Fluid then .25 else .75
			cable:SetAttribute("PierceName", pierce.Name)
			cable:SetAttribute("FluidLine", socket.Fluid == true)
			cable.Parent = cables
		end
		assembly:SetAttribute("StaticOrigin", origin)
		assembly:SetAttribute("SpecimenRestPivot", model:GetPivot())
		assembly:SetAttribute("InjectorRestPivot", rotor:GetPivot())
		assembly:SetAttribute("DisplaySlot", slot)
		assembly:SetAttribute("AngularSpeedDegrees", if slot == 5 then 0 else 10)
		assembly:SetAttribute("BobAmplitude", .12)
		assembly:SetAttribute("BobFrequency", .22)
		assembly:SetAttribute("SpecimenId", tostring(record.Id or ""))
		assembly:SetAttribute("SpeciesId", "TRex")
		assembly:SetAttribute("FittedRadius", radius)
		assembly:SetAttribute("FittedHeight", height)
		assembly:SetAttribute("ScaleFactor", factor)
		assembly:SetAttribute("TetherCount", #SOCKETS)
		assembly:SetAttribute("SurfaceRaycastCount", raycastCount)
		assembly:SetAttribute("Ready", true)
		return assembly
	end, function(exception) return debug.traceback(tostring(exception), 2) end)
	if not ok then assembly:Destroy(); error(result, 2) end
	if previous then previous:Destroy() end
	assembly.Name = "SpecimenAssembly"
	CollectionService:AddTag(assembly, TAG)
	return assembly
end

return Specimen

function Theme.button(item)

	stroke.Color = Theme.Colors.Border; stroke.Thickness = 1; stroke.Transparency = .55
	stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border; stroke.Parent = item
	local tween
	local function highlight(active)
		if tween then tween:Cancel() end
		tween = TweenService:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Color = if active then Theme.Colors.Gold else Theme.Colors.Border, Transparency = if active then 0 else .55})
		tween:Play()
	end
	item.MouseEnter:Connect(function() highlight(item.Active) end)
	item.MouseLeave:Connect(function() highlight(false) end)
	item.SelectionGained:Connect(function() highlight(true) end)
	item.SelectionLost:Connect(function() highlight(false) end)
	item.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() if item.Active then item.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(53, 49, 39) end end)
	item.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() item.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Colors.Card end)
	return stroke
end
function Theme.Ring(parent, name, size, thickness, color)
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = name; frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size); frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5)
	frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(.5, .5); frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1; frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.ZIndex = if parent:IsA("GuiObject") then parent.ZIndex + 1 else 2; frame.Parent = parent
	local segments = {}; local total = 72; local radius = (size - thickness) / 2
	for index = 1, total do
		local angle = (index - 1) / total * math.pi * 2
		local segment = Instance.new("Frame")
		segment.Name = string.format("Arc%02d", index); segment.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5)
		segment.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(thickness, math.max(2, radius * math.pi * 2 / total + .8))
		segment.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(size / 2 + math.sin(angle) * radius, size / 2 - math.cos(angle) * radius)
		segment.Rotation = math.deg(angle); segment.BorderSizePixel = 0; segment.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Colors.Card
		segment.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex; segment.Parent = frame; Theme.round(segment, math.min(2, thickness / 2))
		segments[index] = segment
	end
	local lastCount, lastColor
	local api = {Frame = frame}
	function api:Set(progress, tint)
		progress = if type(progress) == "number" and progress == progress then math.clamp(progress, 0, 1) else 0
		local count = math.floor(progress * total + .5); tint = tint or color or Theme.Colors.Gold
		if count == lastCount and tint == lastColor then return end
		for index, segment in segments do
			segment.BackgroundColor3 = if index <= count then tint else Theme.Colors.Card
			segment.BackgroundTransparency = if index <= count then 0 else .15
		end
		lastCount, lastColor = count, tint
	end
	function api:Destroy() frame:Destroy() end
	api:Set(0); return api
end
return Theme

-- Server health, weapon hurtboxes, and retaliation for the route-driven prototype.
-- The route controller is the only writer of root placement and gait. No remote
-- accepts damage numbers, target identities, or a claimed hit from the client.
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Defaults = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("DinosaurCombatConfig"))

local Combat = {}
Combat.__index = Combat

local function flat(v) return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z) end
local function finite(n) return type(n) == "number" and n == n and math.abs(n) < math.huge end
local function vector(v) return typeof(v) == "Vector3" and finite(v.X) and finite(v.Y) and finite(v.Z) end
local function nearestPoint(part, position)
	local p, h = part.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position), part.Size * .5
	return part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(math.clamp(p.X, -h.X, h.X), math.clamp(p.Y, -h.Y, h.Y), math.clamp(p.Z, -h.Z, h.Z)))
end
local function inside(part, position, tolerance)
	local p, h = part.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position), part.Size * .5 + Vector3.one * (tolerance or 0)
	return math.abs(p.X) <= h.X and math.abs(p.Y) <= h.Y and math.abs(p.Z) <= h.Z
end
local function settings(overrides)
	local result = table.clone(Defaults)
	for key, value in overrides or {} do
		if result[key] ~= nil and typeof(result[key]) == typeof(value) then result[key] = value end
	end
	return result
end
local function newPart(folder, name, size, cf, attachTo)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name; part.Size = size; part.CFrame = cf
	part.Transparency = 1; part.CanCollide = false; part.CanTouch = false
	part.CanQuery = false; part.CastShadow = false; part.Massless = true
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon; part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 180, 255)
	part:SetAttribute("CombatHitbox", true)
	part.Parent = folder
	local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
	weld.Name = "FollowRig"; weld.Part0 = attachTo; weld.Part1 = part
	weld.C0 = attachTo.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(cf); weld.Parent = part
	return part, weld
end

function Combat.new(model, forest, mapConfig, session, options)
	assert(not owners[model], "Dinosaur already has a combat controller")
	options = options or {}
	local root = assert(model.PrimaryPart, "Dinosaur needs a PrimaryPart")
	local self = setmetatable({
		Model = model, Forest = forest, MapConfig = mapConfig, Session = session,
		Root = root, Settings = settings(options.Settings),
		_health = 0, _state = "Idle", _time = 0, _target = nil, _tokens = {}, _lastHits = {}, _petLastHits = {},
		_attackSequence = 0, _attackHits = 0, _lastAttack = -math.huge,
		_phase = "Idle", _phaseUntil = 0, _lastDamaged = -math.huge,
		_autoConnect = options.AutoConnect ~= false, _running = false, _destroyed = false,
		_original = {}, _hurtboxes = {}, _damagePlayer = options.DamagePlayer, _damagePets = options.DamagePets,
		_blockedFor = 0, _publishElapsed = 0,
	}, Combat)
	assert(finite(self.Settings.MaxHealth) and self.Settings.MaxHealth > 0, "MaxHealth must be positive")
	for _, key in {"Health", "MaxHealth", "CombatState", "CombatTargetUserId", "AttackReady", "AttackSequence", "AttackPhase", "AttackHits", "DinosaurDead", "Weak", "Trapped", "Captured", "TrapUntil", "CapturePoint"} do
		self._original[key] = { value = model:GetAttribute(key) }
	end
	if model:GetAttribute("ShowCombatHitboxes") == nil then model:SetAttribute("ShowCombatHitboxes", false) end
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder"); folder.Name = "CombatHitboxes"; folder.Parent = model; self._folder = folder
	-- The lower-leg volumes reach the feet. A player can hit the animal from the
	-- ground rather than having to jump to its 30-stud-high torso.
	for _, definition in {
		{"BodyHurtbox", "body", "body_geom", Vector3.new(.9, .9, .9)},
		{"HeadHurtbox", "head", "head_geom", Vector3.new(.9, .9, .9)},
		{"LeftLegHurtbox", "left leg", "left leg_geom", Vector3.new(.94, .99, .94)},
		{"RightLegHurtbox", "right leg", "right leg_geom", Vector3.new(.94, .99, .94)},
	} do
		local group = assert(model:FindFirstChild(definition[2]), "Missing " .. definition[2])
		local source = assert(group:FindFirstChild(definition[3], true), "Missing " .. definition[3])
		local box = newPart(folder, definition[1], source.Size * definition[4], source.CFrame, source)
		box.CanQuery = true; box:SetAttribute("DinosaurHurtbox", true)
		table.insert(self._hurtboxes, box)
	end
	self._attackBox, self._attackWeld = newPart(folder, "BiteAttackHitbox", self.Settings.BiteHitboxSize, root.CFrame, root)
	self._attackBox:SetAttribute("DinosaurAttackHitbox", true)
	local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
	highlight.Name = "CombatWarning"; highlight.Adornee = model
	highlight.FillTransparency = .85; highlight.OutlineTransparency = .15
	highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded; highlight.Enabled = false
	highlight.Parent = folder; self._highlight = highlight
	self:_createHealthbar()
	local jawModule = model:FindFirstChild("JawController")
	if jawModule then self._jaw = require(jawModule).new(model) end
	self._debugConnection = model:GetAttributeChangedSignal("ShowCombatHitboxes"):Connect(function() self:_showBoxes() end)
	owners[model] = self
	self:Reset()
	return self
end

	gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(260, 64); gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 23, 0)
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true; gui.MaxDistance = self.Settings.HealthbarDistance; gui.Parent = self.Model

function Combat:GetClosestHitPoint(origin, range, direction, arc)

function Combat:CanHit(player, point, maxRange)

	if self._captured then return false, "Captured" end

	local character, _, root = self:_character(player)
	if not character then return false, "NotHunting" end
	if not vector(point) or not finite(maxRange) or maxRange < 0 then return false, "InvalidHit" end
	if (point - root.Position).Magnitude > math.min(maxRange, self.Settings.MaxWeaponRange) + 2.5 then return false, "OutOfRange" end

	for _, box in self._hurtboxes do if inside(box, point, 1.5) then inBox = true; break end end

	-- remains visual rather than silently granting a hit outside these volumes.
	if not inBox then return false, "OutsideHurtbox" end

function Combat:Damage(player, damage, point, token, source)

	if token ~= nil and (type(token) ~= "string" or #token == 0 or #token > 160) then return 0, "InvalidToken" end

	local tokens = self._tokens[player]
	if not tokens then tokens = {}; self._tokens[player] = tokens end
	if token and tokens[token] and tokens[token] > self._time then return 0, "DuplicateHit" end

	if token then tokens[token] = self._time + self.Settings.AttackTokenLifetime end
