-- Server patrol for the existing segmented prototype. This controller owns both
-- root placement and the six-joint gait; keep the old circular MotionRuntime disabled.
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Controller = {}
Controller.__index = Controller
local owners = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local Y = Vector3.yAxis
local function flat(v) return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z) end
local function finite(v)
	return typeof(v) == "Vector3" and v.X == v.X and v.Y == v.Y and v.Z == v.Z
		and math.abs(v.X) < 1e6 and math.abs(v.Y) < 1e6 and math.abs(v.Z) < 1e6
end
local function number(value, fallback, minimum, maximum)
	if type(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value then return fallback end
	return math.clamp(value, minimum, maximum)
end
local function approach(current, target, distance)
	return current + math.clamp(target - current, -distance, distance)
end
local function angleDelta(a, b) return (b - a + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi end
local function reverse(points)
	local result = {}
	for i = #points, 1, -1 do table.insert(result, points[i]) end
	return result
end
local function buildNetwork(map, config)
	local report = {ok = true, errors = {}, paths = 0, routes = 0}
	local network = {}
	local function failure(message) report.ok = false; table.insert(report.errors, message) end
	local paths = map:FindFirstChild("Paths")
	if not paths then failure("Missing map Paths"); return network, report end
	for _, path in paths:GetChildren() do
		if not path:IsA("Model") or path:GetAttribute("HumanOnly") == true then continue end
		local a, b = path:GetAttribute("FromZone"), path:GetAttribute("ToZone")
		if type(a) ~= "string" or type(b) ~= "string" then failure(path.Name .. " has no endpoints"); continue end
		local segments = {}
		for _, part in path:GetChildren() do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name == "WalkSurface" then table.insert(segments, part) end
		end
		table.sort(segments, function(x, z) return (x:GetAttribute("SampleIndex") or 0) < (z:GetAttribute("SampleIndex") or 0) end)
		local points = {}
		for _, part in segments do
			local start, finish = part:GetAttribute("RouteStart"), part:GetAttribute("RouteEnd")
			if typeof(start) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(finish) ~= "Vector3" then failure(path.Name .. " has invalid surface samples"); continue end
			if #points == 0 then table.insert(points, start)
			elseif (points[#points] - start).Magnitude > 2 then failure(path.Name .. " has a gap") end
			if (flat(finish) - flat(points[#points])).Magnitude > .01 then table.insert(points, finish) end
		end
		if #points < 2 then failure(path.Name .. " has no traversable samples"); continue end
		network[a] = network[a] or {}; network[b] = network[b] or {}
		network[a][b] = points
		if path:GetAttribute("Bidirectional") == true then network[b][a] = reverse(points) end
		report.paths += 1
	end
	for home, routes in config.Routes do
		for index, route in routes do
			report.routes += 1
			if route[1] ~= home or route[#route] ~= home then failure(home .. "/" .. index .. " does not return home") end
			for i = 1, #route - 1 do
				if not (network[route[i]] and network[route[i]][route[i + 1]]) then failure(route[i] .. " -> " .. route[i + 1] .. " missing") end
				if not (network[route[i + 1]] and network[route[i + 1]][route[i]]) then failure(route[i + 1] .. " -> " .. route[i] .. " missing") end
			end
		end
	end
	return network, report
end
function Controller.ValidateNetwork(map, config)
	local _, report = buildNetwork(map, config)
	return report
end
function Controller.new(model, map, config, options)
	assert(not owners[model], "Dinosaur already has a route controller")
	options = options or {}
	local root = assert(model.PrimaryPart, "Dinosaur requires a PrimaryPart")
	assert(root.Anchored, "Route prototype requires its anchored body root")
	local oldRuntime = model:FindFirstChild("MotionRuntime")
	assert(not oldRuntime or oldRuntime.Disabled, "Disable old MotionRuntime before installing route movement")
	local network, report = buildNetwork(map, config)
	assert(report.ok, table.concat(report.errors, "; "))
	local home = options.HomeZone or model:GetAttribute("HuntingZone") or "A"
	assert(config.Routes[home] and #config.Routes[home] > 0, "No routes for home " .. tostring(home))
	local localForward = model:GetAttribute("ForwardInRoot")
	assert(typeof(localForward) == "Vector3" and flat(localForward).Magnitude > .1, "Missing dinosaur ForwardInRoot")
	local worldForward = flat(root.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(localForward)).Unit
	local heading = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, worldForward)
	local offset = heading:ToObjectSpace(root.CFrame.Rotation)
	local motors, footSum, footCount, footLow = {}, Vector3.zero, 0, math.huge
	for _, joint in model:GetDescendants() do
		if not joint:IsA("Motor6D") or joint.Name == "JawMotor" then continue end
		local rest = joint:GetAttribute("RestC0")
		assert(typeof(rest) == "CFrame", joint.Name .. " missing RestC0")
		local data = {joint = joint, rest = rest}
		local encoded = joint:GetAttribute("FootSamples")
		if encoded then
			data.foot = HttpService:JSONDecode(encoded)
			for _, sample in data.foot do
				local point = rest:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(sample[1], sample[2], sample[3]))
				footSum += point; footCount += 1; footLow = math.min(footLow, point.Y)
			end
		end
		motors[joint.Name] = data
	end
	for _, name in {"LeftHip", "RightHip", "LeftShoulder", "RightShoulder", "Tail", "Neck"} do assert(motors[name], "Missing gait joint " .. name) end
	assert(footCount > 0 and motors.LeftHip.foot and motors.RightHip.foot, "Missing foot samples")
	-- A foot-based anchor follows the corridor center, even though the mesh root
	-- is offset about seven studs from the animal's actual support footprint.
	local supportLocal = Vector3.new(footSum.X / footCount, footLow, footSum.Z / footCount)
	local supportWorld = root.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(supportLocal)
	local groundParams = RaycastParams.new()
	groundParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	groundParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {workspace.Terrain, map:WaitForChild("Paths"), map:WaitForChild("Zones")}
	groundParams.RespectCanCollide = true; groundParams.IgnoreWater = true
	local decorParams = RaycastParams.new()
	decorParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	decorParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {map:WaitForChild("Decor")}
	decorParams.RespectCanCollide = true
	local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
	overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {map.Decor}
	overlapParams.RespectCanCollide = true
	local low, high = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge), Vector3.new(-math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge)
	local anatomy = CFrame.lookAt(supportWorld, supportWorld + worldForward)
	for _, part in model:GetDescendants() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and part:GetAttribute("CombatHitbox") ~= true then
			for _, x in {-1, 1} do for _, y in {-1, 1} do for _, z in {-1, 1} do
				local p = anatomy:PointToObjectSpace(part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(part.Size * Vector3.new(x, y, z) * .5))
				low, high = low:Min(p), high:Max(p)
			end end end
		end
	end
	local restSeconds = number(config.RestSeconds, 60, 0, 600)
	local self = setmetatable({Model = model, Root = root, Map = map, Config = config, HomeZone = home,
		_network = network, _motors = motors, _supportLocal = supportLocal, _headingOffset = offset,
		_position = flat(supportWorld), _groundY = supportWorld.Y, _yaw = math.atan2(worldForward.X, worldForward.Z), _up = Y,
		_groundParams = groundParams, _originalRoot = root.CFrame, _originalAttributes = {},
		_decorParams = decorParams, _overlapParams = overlapParams,
		_collisionSize = high - low + Vector3.new(2, 1, 2), _collisionCenter = (high + low) * .5,
		_combatLeash = number(options.CombatLeashStuds or options.CombatLeash or config.CombatLeashStuds, 260, 20, 400),
		_campSafeRadius = number(options.CampSafeRadius or config.CampSafeRadius, 110, 50, 400),
		_combatSpeed = number(options.CombatSpeed, 16, 1, 24),
		_combatSlope = math.rad(number(options.CombatSlopeDegrees, 28, 5, 35)), _combatBlocked = false,
		_speed = 0, _phase = 0, _blend = 0, _nod = 0, _attributeElapsed = 0,
		_state = "Stopped", _currentZone = home, _targetZone = home, _restRemaining = 0,
		_routeIndex = number(options.InitialRouteIndex, 1, 1, #config.Routes[home]),
		_reversed = options.InitialReverse == true, _fixedRouteIndex = options.FixedRouteIndex,
		_reverseEachCycle = options.ReverseEachCycle ~= false,
		_maxSpeed = number(options.Speed, 12, 1, 24), _acceleration = number(options.Acceleration, 6, 1, 30),
		_turnSpeed = math.rad(number(options.TurnSpeedDegrees, 65, 10, 180)),
		_initialRest = number(options.InitialRestSeconds, restSeconds, 0, 600),
		_homeRest = number(options.HomeRestSeconds, restSeconds, 0, 600),
		_rest = number(options.RestSeconds, restSeconds, 0, 600), _mainRest = number(options.MainRestSeconds, restSeconds, 0, 600),
		_autoConnect = options.AutoConnect ~= false, _running = false, _destroyed = false,
		_cycles = 0, _legs = 0, _travelled = 0, _groundMisses = 0, _visited = {home}}, Controller)
	self._routeIndex = math.floor(self._routeIndex)
	if self._fixedRouteIndex then self._routeIndex = math.floor(number(self._fixedRouteIndex, 1, 1, #config.Routes[home])) end
	for _, key in {"RouteEnabled", "RouteState", "RouteCurrentZone", "RouteTargetZone", "RouteHomeZone", "RouteIndex",
		"RouteReversed", "RouteCyclesCompleted", "RouteLegsCompleted", "RouteDistanceTravelled", "RouteSpeed",
		"RouteWalking", "RouteGroundMisses", "RouteRestRemaining", "RouteMotionMode", "RouteCombatBlocked",
		"HuntingZone", "MapRole", "PreviewWalking"} do self._originalAttributes[key] = {value = model:GetAttribute(key)} end
	model:SetAttribute("PreviewWalking", false)
	model:SetAttribute("MapRole", "HuntingPrototype_RoutePatrol")
	model:SetAttribute("RouteHomeZone", home)
	if model:GetAttribute("RouteEnabled") == nil then model:SetAttribute("RouteEnabled", true) end
	owners[model] = self
	self:_publish()
	return self
end
function Controller:_publish()
	local m = self.Model
	m:SetAttribute("RouteState", self._state); m:SetAttribute("RouteCurrentZone", self._currentZone)
	m:SetAttribute("RouteTargetZone", self._targetZone); m:SetAttribute("RouteIndex", self._routeIndex)
	m:SetAttribute("RouteReversed", self._reversed); m:SetAttribute("RouteCyclesCompleted", self._cycles)
	m:SetAttribute("RouteLegsCompleted", self._legs); m:SetAttribute("RouteDistanceTravelled", self._travelled)
	m:SetAttribute("RouteSpeed", self._speed); m:SetAttribute("RouteWalking", self._blend > .05)
	m:SetAttribute("RouteGroundMisses", self._groundMisses)
	m:SetAttribute("RouteRestRemaining", math.max(0, self._restRemaining))
	m:SetAttribute("RouteMotionMode", self._motionMode or "Patrol")
	m:SetAttribute("RouteCombatBlocked", self._combatBlocked)
	m:SetAttribute("HuntingZone", self._currentZone)
end
function Controller:GetSnapshot()
	return {State = self._state, CurrentZone = self._currentZone, TargetZone = self._targetZone,
		RouteIndex = self._routeIndex, Reversed = self._reversed, CompletedCycles = self._cycles,
		CompletedLegs = self._legs, VisitedZones = table.clone(self._visited), DistanceTravelled = self._travelled,
		GroundMisses = self._groundMisses, Speed = self._speed, RestRemaining = self._restRemaining,
		SupportPosition = self._position + Y * self._groundY, FootSupportLocal = self._supportLocal,
		MotionMode = self._motionMode or "Patrol", CombatBlocked = self._combatBlocked,
		PatrolAnchor = self._combatSnapshot and self._combatSnapshot.anchor or nil,
		FacingDirection = Vector3.new(math.sin(self._yaw), 0, math.cos(self._yaw))}
end
function Controller:_ground(position)
	return workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(position.X, self.Config.TerrainMax + 100, position.Z),
		Vector3.new(0, -(self.Config.TerrainMax - self.Config.TerrainMin + 200), 0), self._groundParams)
end
function Controller:_outsideCombatBounds(position)
	local camp = self.Config.position(self.Config.zone("Camp"))
	local offset = self.Config.WorldOffset or self.Map:GetAttribute("WorldOffset") or Vector3.zero
	local localPosition = position - offset
	return math.abs(localPosition.X) > (self.Config.MapWidth or self.Config.MapSize) * .5 - 36
		or math.abs(localPosition.Z) > (self.Config.MapDepth or self.Config.MapSize) * .5 - 36
		or (flat(position) - flat(camp)).Magnitude < self._campSafeRadius
end
function Controller:BeginCombat()
	if self._destroyed or not self._running or self._dead or self.Model:GetAttribute("RouteEnabled") == false then return false end
	if not self._combatSnapshot then
		self._combatSnapshot = {state = self._state, rest = self._restRemaining,
			anchor = self._position + Y * self._groundY}
		self._combatTrail = {self._combatSnapshot.anchor}
		self._combatTravel = 0
	elseif self._motionMode == "Returning" then
		-- Returning uses the existing trail backwards. Discard the already
		-- traversed tail before a new hit starts another chase from this point.
		while #self._combatTrail > self._returnIndex do table.remove(self._combatTrail) end
		table.insert(self._combatTrail, self._position + Y * self._groundY)
	end
	self._motionMode = "Combat"; self._combatGoal = nil; self._combatFace = nil
	self._combatBlocked = false; self._speed = 0; self._state = "Combat"
	self:_publish()
	return true
end
function Controller:SetCombatGoal(position, options)
	if self._motionMode ~= "Combat" or self._dead or not finite(position) then return false end
	if self:_outsideCombatBounds(position)
		or (flat(position) - flat(self._combatSnapshot.anchor)).Magnitude > self._combatLeash then
		self._combatGoal = nil; self._speed = 0; self._combatBlocked = true
		return false
	end
	options = options or {}
	self._combatGoal = flat(position)
	self._combatStop = number(options.StopDistance, 18, 0, 40)
	self._combatGoalSpeed = number(options.Speed, self._combatSpeed, 1, 24)
	return true
end
function Controller:FaceCombat(position)
	if self._motionMode ~= "Combat" or not finite(position) then return false end
	self._combatFace = flat(position)
	return true
end
function Controller:_resumePatrol()
	local saved = self._combatSnapshot
	if not saved then return end
	self._state = saved.state; self._restRemaining = saved.rest; self._speed = 0
	self._motionMode = nil; self._combatSnapshot = nil; self._combatGoal = nil; self._combatFace = nil
	self._combatTrail = nil; self._returnIndex = nil; self._combatBlocked = false
	self:_publish()
end
function Controller:EndCombat()
	if not self._combatSnapshot or self._dead then return end
	if self._motionMode == "Returning" then return end
	self._combatGoal = nil; self._combatFace = nil; self._speed = 0; self._combatBlocked = false
	self._motionMode = "Returning"; self._state = "ReturningToPatrol"
	self._returnIndex = #self._combatTrail
	if (self._position - flat(self._combatSnapshot.anchor)).Magnitude < .02 then self:_resumePatrol()
	else self:_publish() end
end
function Controller:SetDead(dead)
	if self._destroyed or self._dead == (dead == true) then return end
	self._dead = dead == true; self._speed = 0
	if self._dead then
		self._deadState = self._state; self._deadMotion = self._motionMode
		self._state = "Dead"; self._motionMode = "Dead"
	else
		self._state = self._deadState or "RestingHome"; self._motionMode = self._deadMotion
		self._deadState = nil; self._deadMotion = nil
		if self._combatSnapshot then self:EndCombat() end
	end
	self:_publish()
end
function Controller:_safeCombatGround(candidate, direction, dt)
	local distance = (candidate - self._position).Magnitude
	local hit = self:_ground(candidate)
	if not hit or hit.Normal.Y < math.cos(self._combatSlope)
		or math.abs(hit.Position.Y - self._groundY) > math.tan(self._combatSlope) * distance + .65 then return nil end
	local yaw = self._yaw + math.clamp(angleDelta(self._yaw, math.atan2(direction.X, direction.Z)), -self._turnSpeed * dt, self._turnSpeed * dt)
	local forward = Vector3.new(math.sin(yaw), 0, math.cos(yaw))
	local right = forward:Cross(Y)
	-- Both feet need nearby support, even when the central ray is still on a
	-- road lip. A full body sweep prevents clipping through trees and dividers.
	for _, offset in {right * 7, -right * 7, forward * 8, -forward * 8} do
		local footHit = self:_ground(candidate + offset)
		if not footHit or math.abs(footHit.Position.Y - hit.Position.Y) > math.tan(self._combatSlope) * offset.Magnitude + 1.4 then return nil end
	end
	local ground = candidate + Y * hit.Position.Y
	local frame = CFrame.lookAt(ground, ground + forward) * CFrame.new(self._collisionCenter)
	if #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(frame, self._collisionSize, self._overlapParams) > 0 then return nil end
	if distance > .001 then
		local oldGround = self._position + Y * self._groundY
		local start = CFrame.lookAt(oldGround, oldGround + forward) * CFrame.new(self._collisionCenter)
		if workspace:Blockcast(start, self._collisionSize, ground - oldGround, self._decorParams) then return nil end
	end
	return hit
end
function Controller:_combatStep(dt)
	local returning = self._motionMode == "Returning"
	local target = if returning then flat(self._combatTrail[self._returnIndex]) else self._combatGoal
	local direction = Vector3.new(math.sin(self._yaw), 0, math.cos(self._yaw))
	local distance = if target then (target - self._position).Magnitude else 0
	local stop = if returning then 0 else self._combatStop or 18
	if target and distance > .02 then direction = (target - self._position).Unit end
	if not returning and distance <= stop and self._combatFace and (self._combatFace - self._position).Magnitude > .02 then
		direction = (self._combatFace - self._position).Unit
	end
	local turning = math.abs(angleDelta(self._yaw, math.atan2(direction.X, direction.Z))) > math.rad(45)
	local desiredSpeed = if target and distance > stop and not turning then (if returning then self._maxSpeed * (if self.Model:GetAttribute("Weak") then .6 else 1) else self._combatGoalSpeed) else 0
	self._speed = if desiredSpeed == 0 then 0 else approach(self._speed, desiredSpeed, self._acceleration * dt)
	local step = math.min(math.max(0, distance - stop), self._speed * dt)
	local candidate = self._position + direction * step
	local blocked = self:_outsideCombatBounds(candidate)
	if not returning and ((candidate - flat(self._combatSnapshot.anchor)).Magnitude > self._combatLeash
		or self._combatTravel + step > 320) then blocked = true end
	local hit = if not blocked then self:_safeCombatGround(candidate, direction, dt) else nil
	self._combatBlocked = hit == nil
	if hit then
		self._position = candidate
		if step > 0 and not returning then
			self._combatTravel += step
			local point = candidate + Y * hit.Position.Y
			if (point - self._combatTrail[#self._combatTrail]).Magnitude >= 2 then table.insert(self._combatTrail, point) end
		end
		self._state = if returning then "ReturningToPatrol" else "Combat"
		local bob = self:_gait(dt, step > 0)
		self:_place(dt, hit, direction, bob)
	else
		self._speed = 0
		self._state = if returning then "ReturnBlocked" else "CombatBlocked"
		local stationary = self:_ground(self._position)
		local bob = self:_gait(dt, false)
		if stationary then self:_place(dt, stationary, Vector3.new(math.sin(self._yaw), 0, math.cos(self._yaw)), bob) end
	end
	if returning and (self._position - target).Magnitude < .02 then
		if self._returnIndex > 1 then self._returnIndex -= 1
		else self:_resumePatrol() end
	end
end
function Controller:_beginCycle()
	local source = self.Config.Routes[self.HomeZone][self._routeIndex]
	self._route = if self._reversed then reverse(source) else table.clone(source)
	self._legIndex = 1
	self:_beginLeg()
end
function Controller:_beginLeg()
	local a, b = self._route[self._legIndex], self._route[self._legIndex + 1]
	self._points = self._network[a][b]
	self._sampleIndex = 2
	self._targetZone = b; self._state = "Walking"
	self:_publish()
end
function Controller:_arrive()
	self._currentZone = self._targetZone; self._legs += 1; self._speed = 0
	table.insert(self._visited, self._currentZone)
	if #self._visited > 40 then table.remove(self._visited, 1) end
	if self._legIndex == #self._route - 1 then
		self._cycles += 1; self._state = "RestingHome"; self._restRemaining = self._homeRest
	else
		local zone = self.Config.zone(self._currentZone)
		self._state = "Resting"; self._restRemaining = if zone.kind == "Rest" then self._rest else self._mainRest
	end
	self:_publish()
end
local function footOffset(data, angle, lift, bob)
	local restMinimum, minimum = math.huge, math.huge
	for _, point in data.foot do
		restMinimum = math.min(restMinimum, point[2])
		minimum = math.min(minimum, point[2] * math.cos(angle) - point[3] * math.sin(angle))
	end
	return restMinimum - minimum + lift - bob
end
function Controller:_gait(dt, moving)
	local target = if moving then math.clamp(self._speed / self._maxSpeed, 0, 1) else 0
	self._blend += (target - self._blend) * math.min(1, dt * 7)
	if self._blend < .0001 then self._blend = 0 end
	local blend = self._blend
	self._phase += dt * math.pi * 2 * .66 * math.clamp(self._maxSpeed / 6, .5, 1.5) * blend
	local phase = self._phase
	local bob = .18 * (1 - math.cos(phase * 2)) * .5 * blend
	for name, sign in {LeftHip = 1, RightHip = -1} do
		local data = self._motors[name]
		local angle = math.sin(phase) * sign * math.rad(11) * blend * (if self.Model:GetAttribute("Weak") and name == "LeftHip" then .5 else 1)
		local lift = math.max(0, math.cos(phase) * sign) * .8 * blend
		data.joint.C0 = data.rest * CFrame.new(0, footOffset(data, angle, lift, bob), 0) * CFrame.Angles(angle, 0, 0)
	end
	for name, sign in {LeftShoulder = -1, RightShoulder = 1} do
		local data = self._motors[name]
		data.joint.C0 = data.rest * CFrame.Angles(math.sin(phase) * sign * .065 * blend, 0, 0)
	end
	self._motors.Tail.joint.C0 = self._motors.Tail.rest * CFrame.Angles(0, math.sin(phase - .4) * .035 * blend, 0)
	local bite = self.Model:GetAttribute("BitePhase")
	local nod = if self.Model:GetAttribute("Trapped") then -math.rad(14) elseif bite == "Closing" then -math.rad(5) elseif bite == "Opening" or bite == "Holding" then math.rad(1.5) else 0
	self._nod += (nod - self._nod) * math.min(1, dt * 15)
	self._motors.Neck.joint.C0 = self._motors.Neck.rest * CFrame.Angles(self._nod + math.sin(phase * 2) * .012 * blend, 0, 0)
	return bob
end
function Controller:_place(dt, hit, direction, bob)
	self._yaw += math.clamp(angleDelta(self._yaw, math.atan2(direction.X, direction.Z)), -self._turnSpeed * dt, self._turnSpeed * dt)
	-- Ground normals come only from authored roads/clearings or Terrain. Smooth
	-- the pitch/roll at road joins without allowing a steep wall to flip the rig.
	local normal = if hit.Normal.Y >= .85 then hit.Normal else Y
	self._up = self._up:Lerp(normal, math.min(1, dt * 7)).Unit
	local forward = Vector3.new(math.sin(self._yaw), 0, math.cos(self._yaw))
	forward = (forward - self._up * forward:Dot(self._up)).Unit
	local rotation = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, forward, self._up) * self._headingOffset
	local ground = Vector3.new(self._position.X, hit.Position.Y, self._position.Z)
	self._groundY = hit.Position.Y
	local position = ground - rotation:VectorToWorldSpace(self._supportLocal) + self._up * bob
	self.Root.CFrame = CFrame.new(position) * rotation
end
function Controller:Step(dt)
	if not self._running or self._destroyed then return end
	if not self.Model.Parent or not self.Root.Parent then self:Stop(); return end
	local elapsed = number(dt, 0, 0, 60)
	dt = math.min(elapsed, .12)
	if dt <= 0 then return end
	local enabled = self.Model:GetAttribute("RouteEnabled") ~= false
	if self._dead then
		self._speed = 0; self._state = "Dead"
		local hit = self:_ground(self._position)
		local bob = self:_gait(dt, false)
		if hit then self:_place(dt, hit, Vector3.new(math.sin(self._yaw), 0, math.cos(self._yaw)), bob) end
	elseif not enabled then
		self._speed = 0
		local bob = self:_gait(dt, false)
		local hit = self:_ground(self._position)
		if hit then self:_place(dt, hit, Vector3.new(math.sin(self._yaw), 0, math.cos(self._yaw)), bob) end
		self._pausedState = self._pausedState or self._state; self._state = "Paused"
	else
		if self._pausedState then self._state = self._pausedState; self._pausedState = nil end
		if self._motionMode == "Combat" or self._motionMode == "Returning" then
			self:_combatStep(dt)
		else
		local walking = self._state == "Walking" or self._state == "Turning" or self._state == "GroundBlocked"
		if not walking then
			self._restRemaining = math.max(0, self._restRemaining - elapsed)
			if self._restRemaining <= 0 then
				if not self._route then self:_beginCycle()
				elseif self._state == "RestingHome" then
					if not self._fixedRouteIndex then self._routeIndex = self._routeIndex % #self.Config.Routes[self.HomeZone] + 1 end
					if self._reverseEachCycle then self._reversed = not self._reversed end
					self:_beginCycle()
				else self._legIndex += 1; self:_beginLeg() end
			end
			local bob = self:_gait(dt, false)
			local hit = self:_ground(self._position)
			if hit then self:_place(dt, hit, Vector3.new(math.sin(self._yaw), 0, math.cos(self._yaw)), bob) end
		else
			local target = flat(self._points[self._sampleIndex])
			local delta = target - self._position
			local distance = delta.Magnitude
			if distance < .02 then
				if self._sampleIndex < #self._points then self._sampleIndex += 1 else self:_arrive() end
			else
				local remaining = distance
				for i = self._sampleIndex, #self._points - 1 do remaining += (flat(self._points[i + 1]) - flat(self._points[i])).Magnitude end
				local desiredSpeed = math.min(self._maxSpeed * (if self.Model:GetAttribute("Weak") then .6 else 1), math.sqrt(2 * self._acceleration * remaining))
				local turning = math.abs(angleDelta(self._yaw, math.atan2(delta.X, delta.Z))) > math.rad(45)
				-- Turn toward a newly selected road before advancing. This avoids
				-- walking backwards out of a rest stop when reversing an itinerary.
				self._speed = if turning then 0 else approach(self._speed, desiredSpeed, self._acceleration * dt)
				local step = if turning then 0 else math.min(distance, self._speed * dt)
				local candidate = self._position + delta.Unit * step
				local hit = self:_ground(candidate)
				if not hit then
					self._state = "GroundBlocked"; self._speed = 0; self._groundMisses += 1
					self:_gait(dt, false)
				else
					self._state = if turning then "Turning" else "Walking"; self._position = candidate; self._travelled += step
					local bob = self:_gait(dt, not turning)
					self:_place(dt, hit, delta.Unit, bob)
					if step >= distance - .001 then
						if self._sampleIndex < #self._points then self._sampleIndex += 1 else self:_arrive() end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		end
	end
	self._attributeElapsed += elapsed
	if self._attributeElapsed >= .2 then self._attributeElapsed = 0; self:_publish() end
end
function Controller:Start()
	assert(not self._destroyed, "Controller destroyed")
	if self._running then return self end
	self._running = true
	if self._stoppedState then self._state = self._stoppedState; self._stoppedState = nil
	elseif self._state == "Stopped" then self._state = "RestingHome"; self._restRemaining = self._initialRest end
	if self._autoConnect then self._connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt) self:Step(dt) end) end
	self:_publish(); return self
end
function Controller:Stop()
	if self._connection then self._connection:Disconnect(); self._connection = nil end
	if self._state ~= "Stopped" then self._stoppedState = self._state end
	self._running = false; self._speed = 0; self._state = "Stopped"; self._blend = 0
	for _, data in self._motors do data.joint.C0 = data.rest end
	self:_publish()
end
function Controller:Destroy(restore)
	if self._destroyed then return end
	self:Stop(); self._destroyed = true; owners[self.Model] = nil
	if restore then
		self.Root.CFrame = self._originalRoot
		for key, original in self._originalAttributes do self.Model:SetAttribute(key, original.value) end
	end
end
return Controller

-- P1-C prototype numbers. Runtime ownership, distance and line-of-sight checks
-- belong to the server controller; this module has no Roblox dependencies.
local Rules = {}

Rules.Config = table.freeze({
	MaxHealth = 100,
	AttackDamage = 12,
	AttackInterval = 4,
	AttackRange = 6,
	StunSeconds = 30,
	HealFraction = 0.7,
	HealCooldown = 119,
	HealCastSeconds = 0.8,
	HealRange = 3.8,
	MoveSpeed = 18,
})
local Config = Rules.Config

local function finite(value)
	return type(value) == "number" and value == value
		and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge
end

local function validTime(value)
	return finite(value) and value >= 0
end

local function validMemory(memory)
	return type(memory) == "table" and finite(memory.Health)
		and memory.Health >= 1 and memory.Health <= Config.MaxHealth
		and validTime(memory.StunnedUntil) and validTime(memory.HealReadyAt)
		and validTime(memory.NextAttackAt)
end

local function validOwnerHealth(currentHealth, maxHealth)
	return finite(currentHealth) and finite(maxHealth) and maxHealth > 0
		and currentHealth > 0 and currentHealth <= maxHealth
end

-- Initial timers are ready immediately. An optional clock argument lets callers
-- construct memory alongside their other timed state without starting cooldowns.
function Rules.new(_now)
	return {
		Health = Config.MaxHealth,
		StunnedUntil = 0,
		HealReadyAt = 0,
		NextAttackAt = 0,
	}
end

function Rules.tick(memory, now)
	if not validMemory(memory) or not validTime(now) then return false end
	if memory.StunnedUntil > 0 and now >= memory.StunnedUntil then
		memory.Health = Config.MaxHealth
		memory.StunnedUntil = 0
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function Rules.damage(memory, amount, now)
	if not validMemory(memory) or not validTime(now)
		or not finite(amount) or amount <= 0 then return 0, false end
	Rules.tick(memory, now)
	if memory.StunnedUntil > now then return 0, false end
	local previous = memory.Health
	memory.Health = math.max(1, previous - amount)
	local enteredStun = memory.Health <= 1
	if enteredStun then memory.StunnedUntil = now + Config.StunSeconds end
	return previous - memory.Health, enteredStun
end

function Rules.canHeal(memory, now, currentHealth, maxHealth)
	if not validMemory(memory) then return false, "InvalidMemory" end
	if not validTime(now) then return false, "InvalidTime" end
	if not validOwnerHealth(currentHealth, maxHealth) then return false, "InvalidHealth" end
	if memory.StunnedUntil > now then return false, "Stunned" end
	if now < memory.HealReadyAt then return false, "Cooldown" end
	if currentHealth >= maxHealth then return false, "FullHealth" end
	return true, nil
end

-- Returns the amount for the controller to apply to the owner's Humanoid.
-- A cancelled cast never calls this method, so it consumes no cooldown.
function Rules.commitHeal(memory, now, currentHealth, maxHealth)
	local allowed, reason = Rules.canHeal(memory, now, currentHealth, maxHealth)
	if not allowed then return 0, reason end
	Rules.tick(memory, now)
	local applied = math.min(maxHealth - currentHealth, maxHealth * Config.HealFraction)
	if applied <= 0 then return 0, "FullHealth" end
	memory.HealReadyAt = now + Config.HealCooldown
	return applied, nil
end

function Rules.canAttack(memory, now)
	return validMemory(memory) and validTime(now)
		and memory.StunnedUntil <= now and now >= memory.NextAttackAt
end

function Rules.beginAttack(memory, now)
	if not Rules.canAttack(memory, now) then return false end
	Rules.tick(memory, now)
	memory.NextAttackAt = now + Config.AttackInterval
	return true
end

return Rules

	self._pathGoal = nil
	self._waypointIndex = nil
end
function Controller:_clearMedicine()
	if self._medicineOrb then self._medicineOrb:Destroy(); self._medicineOrb = nil end
end
function Controller:Cancel(reason)
	if self._destroyed then return end
	-- Each hunt restarts the dinosaur's bite counter. Ordinary interruption must
	-- keep its token, so a stun or a fly toggle cannot duplicate the current bite.
	if reason == "Travel" or reason == "SessionReset" then table.clear(self._biteTokens) end
	self._healing = nil
	self:_clearAttack()
	self:_clearPath()
	self:_clearMedicine()
	self:_moving(false)
	self:_setState(if self:_stunned(self:_now()) then "Stunned" else "Following")
end

-- Ignore the visual pet/owner and the dinosaur for floor sampling. Their feet
-- must not become accidental bridges over a lake or a gap in the real ground.
function Controller:_navigationParams()
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local ignored = {self.Character, self.PetFolder or self.Pet}
	if self.Combat.Model then table.insert(ignored, self.Combat.Model) end
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored
	params.RespectCanCollide = true
	params.IgnoreWater = false
	return params
end
function Controller:_ground(point, referenceY, params)
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(point.X, referenceY + 3, point.Z), Vector3.new(0, -8, 0), params)
	if not hit or hit.Material == Enum.Material.Water or hit.Normal.Y < .65 then return nil end
	return Vector3.new(point.X, hit.Position.Y + .03, point.Z)
end
function Controller:_segment(from, to, params)
	local delta = flat(to - from)
	if delta.Magnitude < .01 then return nil end
	local ground = self:_ground(to, from.Y, params)
	if not ground or math.abs(ground.Y - from.Y) > math.min(2.2, 1 + delta.Magnitude * .7) then return nil end
	local side = Vector3.new(-delta.Z, 0, delta.X).Unit * .65
	for _, offset in {side, -side} do
		local edge = self:_ground(ground + offset, from.Y, params)
		if not edge or math.abs(edge.Y - ground.Y) > 1.2 then return nil end
	end
	-- Sweep the pet's width, rather than a single thin ray that can slip through
	-- a tree trunk or the corner of one of the valley's cliff walls.
	local rise = math.max(0, ground.Y - from.Y)
	local origin = CFrame.lookAt(from + Vector3.new(0, 2.25 + rise, 0), from + delta + Vector3.new(0, 2.25 + rise, 0))
	local obstacle = workspace:Blockcast(origin, NAV_SIZE, ground - from, params)
	if obstacle then return nil end
	return ground
end
function Controller:_requestPath(goal, now)
	if self._destroyed or self._pathPending or now < self._pathReadyAt then return end
	self._pathReadyAt = now + 1.5
	self._pathPending = true
	local generation = self._generation
	local origin = self.Pet.PrimaryPart.Position
	-- Path computation yields, so it never runs in the game's Heartbeat loop.
	task.spawn(function()
		local path
		local ok = pcall(function()
			path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({AgentRadius = 2, AgentHeight = 4, AgentCanJump = false,
				AgentCanClimb = false, WaypointSpacing = 3, Costs = {Water = math.huge}})
			path:ComputeAsync(origin + UP, goal + UP)
		end)
		self._pathPending = false
		if self._destroyed or generation ~= self._generation or not self:_canAct()
			or not self.Pet.PrimaryPart or (self.Pet.PrimaryPart.Position - origin).Magnitude > 10 then
			if path then path:Destroy() end
			return
		end
		if ok and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
			if self._path then self._path:Destroy() end
			self._path, self._pathGoal = path, goal
			self._waypoints = path:GetWaypoints()
			self._waypointIndex = 2
		else
			if path then path:Destroy() end
		end
	end)
end
function Controller:_walk(goal, now, dt, stopDistance)
	local from = self.Pet.PrimaryPart.Position
	local delta = flat(goal - from)
	if delta.Magnitude <= (stopDistance or .3) then self:_moving(false); return false end
	local params = self:_navigationParams()
	if self._pathGoal and (flat(goal - self._pathGoal)).Magnitude > 7 then self:_clearPath() end
	local direction = delta
	if self._waypoints then
		local waypoint = self._waypoints[self._waypointIndex]
		while waypoint and (flat(waypoint.Position - from)).Magnitude < 1.2 do
			self._waypointIndex += 1
			waypoint = self._waypoints[self._waypointIndex]
		end
		if waypoint and waypoint.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then
			self:_clearPath()
			self:_moving(false)
			return false
		elseif waypoint then direction = flat(waypoint.Position - from) else self:_clearPath() end
	end
	local distance = math.min(direction.Magnitude, self.Rules.Config.MoveSpeed * math.clamp(dt, 0, .25))
	if distance < .01 then self:_moving(false); return false end
	local nextPosition = self:_segment(from, from + direction.Unit * distance, params)
	if not nextPosition then
		if self._waypoints then self:_clearPath() end
		self:_requestPath(goal, now)
		self:_moving(false)
		return false
	end
	self.Pet:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(nextPosition, nextPosition + direction.Unit))
	self:_moving(true)
	return true
end
function Controller:_face(point)
	local origin = self.Pet.PrimaryPart.Position
	local direction = flat(point - origin)
	if direction.Magnitude > .01 then self.Pet:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(origin, origin + direction.Unit)) end
end
function Controller:_lineOfSight(origin, point, target)
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {self.Character, self.PetFolder or self.Pet}
	params.RespectCanCollide = true
	params.IgnoreWater = false
	local delta = point - origin
	if delta.Magnitude < .01 then return true end
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, delta, params)
	return not hit or hit.Distance >= delta.Magnitude - .35 or (target and hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(target))
end
function Controller:_attackAllowed(now)
	return self:_canAct() and self:_hunting() and self.IsEngaged() == true and not self:_stunned(now)
		and not self._healing and (self.Pet.PrimaryPart.Position - self.Root.Position).Magnitude <= CHASE_LIMIT
end
function Controller:_attackPoint(range)
	local center = self.Pet.PrimaryPart.Position + BODY_OFFSET
	local point = self.Combat:GetClosestHitPoint(center, range)
	if not point or (point - self.Root.Position).Magnitude > CHASE_LIMIT then return nil end
	return point
end
function Controller:_startAttack(now)
	if self._attack or self.Animator:IsAttacking() or not self:_attackAllowed(now)
		or not self.Rules.canAttack(self.Memory, now) then return end
	local point = self:_attackPoint(self.Rules.Config.AttackRange)
	local center = self.Pet.PrimaryPart.Position + BODY_OFFSET
	if not point or not self:_lineOfSight(center, point, self.Combat.Model) then return end
	local count = self.Animator:GetHitCount()
	if count < 1 then return end
	self._attackSerial += 1
	local serial = self._attackSerial
	local attack = {Serial = serial, HitCount = count, Fired = {},
		TokenPrefix = string.format("pet:%d:%.6f:%d", self.Player.UserId, now, serial)}
	self._attack = attack
	self.Animator.OnHit = function(index)
		if self._destroyed or self._attack ~= attack or serial ~= self._attackSerial or attack.Fired[index] then return end
		attack.Fired[index] = true
		local hitNow = self:_now()
		if not self:_attackAllowed(hitNow) then return end
		local hitPoint = self:_attackPoint(self.Rules.Config.AttackRange)
		local origin = self.Pet.PrimaryPart.Position + BODY_OFFSET
		if not hitPoint or not self:_lineOfSight(origin, hitPoint, self.Combat.Model) then return end
		-- Dual daggers have two animation marks but still deal one 12-damage total.
		local total = self.Rules.Config.AttackDamage
		local amount = math.floor(total / count) + (if index <= total % count then 1 else 0)
		local token = string.format("%s:%d", attack.TokenPrefix, index)
		local applied = self.Combat:Damage(self.Player, amount, hitPoint, token, "Pet")
		if applied > 0 then
			if self.OnDamage then self.OnDamage(applied, hitPoint) end
			if self.Remote then
				self.Remote:FireAllClients("Hit", hitPoint, applied, true)
				if self.Pet:GetAttribute("PetWeaponId") == "Bow" then self.Remote:FireAllClients("Shot", origin, hitPoint, false) end
			end
		end
	end
	self:_face(point)
	if self.Animator:Attack() then
		self.Rules.beginAttack(self.Memory, now)
		setAttribute(self.Pet, "PetAttackStarted", now)
		setAttribute(self.Pet, "PetAttackSequence", (self.Pet:GetAttribute("PetAttackSequence") or 0) + 1)
		self:_moving(false)
		self:_setState("Attacking")
	else
		self._attack = nil
		self.Animator.OnHit = nil
	end
end

function Controller:_updateMedicine(now)
	if not self._medicineOrb then
		local orb = Instance.new("Part")
		orb.Name = "PetMedicineOrb"
		orb.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		orb.Size = Vector3.new(1.05, 1.05, 1.05)
		orb.Color = Color3.fromRGB(98, 255, 135)
		orb.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		orb.Anchored = true
		orb.CanCollide, orb.CanTouch, orb.CanQuery = false, false, false
		orb.Parent = self.Pet
		self._medicineOrb = orb
	end
	local carried = self.Pet.PrimaryPart.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(1.2, 2.4, -.2))
	local healing = self._healing
	if healing and healing.StartedAt then
		local t = math.clamp((now - healing.StartedAt) / self.Rules.Config.HealCastSeconds, 0, 1)
		local destination = self.Root.Position + Vector3.new(0, .2, 0)
		carried = carried:Lerp(destination, t) + UP * math.sin(t * math.pi) * 1.8
	end
	self._medicineOrb.Position = carried
end
function Controller:RequestHeal(now)
	if self._destroyed then return false, "Unavailable" end
	now = now or self:_now()
	self.Rules.tick(self.Memory, now)
	if not self:_canAct() then return false, "Unavailable" end
	if self._healing then return false, "Healing" end
	local allowed, reason = self.Rules.canHeal(self.Memory, now, self.Humanoid.Health, self.Humanoid.MaxHealth)
	if not allowed then self:_publish(); return false, reason end
	self:_clearAttack()
	self:_clearPath()
	self._healing = {RequestedAt = now}
	self:_updateMedicine(now)
	self:_setState("HealApproach")
	return true
end
function Controller:_stepHeal(now, dt)
	local healing = self._healing
	if not healing then return false end
	local allowed = self.Rules.canHeal(self.Memory, now, self.Humanoid.Health, self.Humanoid.MaxHealth)
	if not self:_canAct() or self:_stunned(now) or not allowed or now - healing.RequestedAt > 12 then
		self:Cancel("HealInterrupted")
		return false
	end
	local center = self.Pet.PrimaryPart.Position + BODY_OFFSET
	local ownerPoint = self.Root.Position
	local distance = (center - ownerPoint).Magnitude
	local visible = self:_lineOfSight(center, ownerPoint, self.Character)
	if distance > self.Rules.Config.HealRange or not visible then
		healing.StartedAt, healing.FinishAt = nil, nil
		local desired = self.Root.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(2.4, 0, 1))
		self:_walk(desired, now, dt, .25)
		self:_setState("HealApproach")
	elseif not healing.StartedAt then
		healing.StartedAt, healing.FinishAt = now, now + self.Rules.Config.HealCastSeconds
		self:_moving(false)
		self:_face(ownerPoint)
		self:_setState("Healing")
	elseif now >= healing.FinishAt then
		-- Recheck owner life/range/LOS at the commit frame; the cooldown begins
		-- only after a real heal, never merely for requesting or interrupting one.
		local currentHealth = self.Humanoid.Health
		local amount = self.Rules.commitHeal(self.Memory, now, currentHealth, self.Humanoid.MaxHealth)
		if amount > 0 then self.Humanoid.Health = math.min(self.Humanoid.MaxHealth, currentHealth + amount) end
		self._healing = nil
		self:_clearMedicine()
		self:_setState("Following")
		return true
	end
	self:_updateMedicine(now)
	self:_publish()
	return true
end

function Controller:Damage(amount, now)
	if self._destroyed or not self:_canAct() then return 0 end
	now = now or self:_now()
	local applied = self.Rules.damage(self.Memory, amount, now)
	if applied > 0 then
		if self:_stunned(now) then self:Cancel("Stunned"); self:_setState("Stunned") end
		self:_publish()
	end
	return applied
end
function Controller:DamageInBite(cf, size, sequence, damage, sourceModel, now)
	if not self:_canAct() or not self:_hunting() or not finite(damage) or damage <= 0
		or typeof(cf) ~= "CFrame" or not vector(size) or size.X <= 0 or size.Y <= 0 or size.Z <= 0
		or (type(sequence) ~= "number" and type(sequence) ~= "string") then return 0 end
	now = now or self:_now()
	local sourceKey = sourceModel or self.Combat.Model
	local token = self._biteTokens[sourceKey]
	if token and token.Sequence == sequence then return 0 end
	local center = self.Pet.PrimaryPart.Position + BODY_OFFSET
	local localPoint = cf:PointToObjectSpace(center)
	if math.abs(localPoint.X) > size.X * .5 or math.abs(localPoint.Y) > size.Y * .5
		or math.abs(localPoint.Z) > size.Z * .5 then return 0 end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local ignored = {self.Character, self.PetFolder or self.Pet}
	if sourceKey then table.insert(ignored, sourceKey) end
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored
	params.RespectCanCollide = true
	params.IgnoreWater = false
	local delta = center - cf.Position
	local obstruction = workspace:Raycast(cf.Position, delta, params)
	if obstruction and obstruction.Distance < delta.Magnitude - .2 then return 0 end
	self._biteTokens[sourceKey] = {Sequence = sequence, At = now}
	for model, entry in self._biteTokens do if now - entry.At > 60 then self._biteTokens[model] = nil end end
	return self:Damage(damage, now)
end

-- The old training dummy follower remains authoritative when this returns false.
-- Animator:Update is still called once by Training.server after either mover.
function Controller:Step(now, dt)
	if self._destroyed then return false end
	now = now or self:_now()
	self.Rules.tick(self.Memory, now)
	if not self:_canAct() then
		local handled = self:_hunting() or self.Player:GetAttribute("AdminFlying") == true
			or self:_stunned(now) or self._healing ~= nil or not self:_alive()
		if self._attack or self._healing or self._waypoints then self:Cancel("Inactive") end
		self:_moving(false)
		self:_setState(if self:_stunned(now) then "Stunned" elseif handled then "Waiting" else "Following")
		return handled
	end
	if self:_stunned(now) then
		if self._attack or self._healing then self:Cancel("Stunned") end
		self:_moving(false)
		self:_setState("Stunned")
		return true
	end
	if self:_stepHeal(now, dt) then return true end
	if not self:_hunting() then
		if self._attack then self:_clearAttack() end
		if self._waypoints then self:_clearPath() end
		self:_setState("Following")
		return false
	end
	if self._attack then
		if not self:_attackAllowed(now) then self:_clearAttack()
		elseif not self.Animator:IsAttacking() then self._attack = nil; self.Animator.OnHit = nil
		else self:_moving(false); self:_setState("Attacking"); return true end
	end
	local engaged = self:_attackAllowed(now)
	local point = if engaged then self:_attackPoint(CHASE_LIMIT) else nil
	if point then
		local center = self.Pet.PrimaryPart.Position + BODY_OFFSET
		if (point - center).Magnitude <= self.Rules.Config.AttackRange and self:_lineOfSight(center, point, self.Combat.Model) then
			self:_moving(false)
			self:_face(point)
			self:_startAttack(now)
			if not self._attack then self:_setState("Following") end
		else
			self:_walk(point, now, dt, 2.8)
			self:_setState("Following")
		end
	else
		self:_walk(self.Root.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(3, 0, 4)), now, dt, 1)
		self:_setState("Following")
	end
	self:_publish()
	return true
end
function Controller:GetSnapshot()
	return {
		Health = self.Memory.Health,
		MaxHealth = self.Rules.Config.MaxHealth,
		State = self._state,
		StunnedUntil = self.Memory.StunnedUntil or 0,
		HealReadyAt = self.Memory.HealReadyAt or 0,
		NextAttackAt = self.Memory.NextAttackAt or 0,
		Healing = self._healing ~= nil,
		HealingUntil = if self._healing then self._healing.FinishAt or 0 else 0,
		Position = if self.Pet.PrimaryPart then self.Pet.PrimaryPart.Position else nil,
		AttackSerial = self._attackSerial,
		PathPending = self._pathPending,
		PathFollowing = self._waypoints ~= nil,
		Destroyed = self._destroyed,
	}
end
function Controller:Destroy()
	if self._destroyed then return end
	self:Cancel("Destroyed")
	self._destroyed = true
	table.clear(self._biteTokens)
end

return Controller

local function availableToken()
	local token = snapshot.OperationToken
	return type(token) == "string" and token ~= "" and token or nil
end
local function requestMutation(action)
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local hum = characterParts()
	local token = availableToken()
	if not panel.Visible or not token or now < nextMutationAt or not hum or hum.Health <= 0
		or player:GetAttribute("AdminFlying") == true or otherMenuOpen() then return end
	if pendingToken == token and pendingUntil and now < pendingUntil then return end
	if (action == "MerchantBuyTrap" or action == "MerchantBuyPotion") and context ~= "Merchant" then return end
	if (action == "CraftIronTrap" or action == "UpgradeHammer") and context ~= "Craft" then return end
	nextMutationAt = now + .35; pendingToken = token; pendingUntil = now + 2
	notice.Text = "Đang xử lý..."
	remote:FireServer(action, token) -- A receipt token is issued/rotated only by the server.
end

 saveStatus.Text=player:GetAttribute("ProfileStatusText") or "Đang tải tiến trình…"

	buyTrap.Visible = merchant; buyPotion.Visible = merchant; craftTrap.Visible = crafting; upgrade.Visible = crafting

	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()

	enabled(upgrade, ready and level < 2 and count(materials.Bone) >= 2 and count(materials.Iron) >= 2)
	if level >= 2 then upgrade.Text = "BÚA ĐÃ ĐẠT CẤP 2 · +15% SÁT THƯƠNG" end
end
local function applySnapshot(dto)
	if type(dto) ~= "table" then return end
	local revision = if finite(dto.Revision) then dto.Revision else snapshot.Revision
	if revision < snapshot.Revision then return end
	local previousToken = snapshot.OperationToken
	for _, key in {"Coins", "Materials", "Stored", "HammerLevel", "ActiveRun", "OperationToken"} do
		snapshot[key] = dto[key]
	end
	snapshot.Revision = revision
	if snapshot.OperationToken ~= previousToken then pendingToken = nil; pendingUntil = nil end
	if type(dto.Notice) == "string" then showNotice(dto.Notice) end
	updatePanel()
end
local function refresh()
	if not alive then return end
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local hum = characterParts()
	local state = player:GetAttribute("QuestState")
	local inHunting = player:GetAttribute("InHunting") == true
	local flying = player:GetAttribute("AdminFlying") == true
	local live = hum ~= nil and hum.Health > 0
	toast.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, if inHunting then 306 else 164)
	toast.Visible = toastUntil ~= nil and now < toastUntil and live and not panel.Visible and not otherMenuOpen()
	if panel.Visible and (not live or flying or state == "Preparing" or state == "Returning"
		or otherMenuOpen() or ((context == "Merchant" or context == "Craft") and inHunting)) then hidePanel() end
	if ownedHold then
		if currentAction() then ownedHold.Observed = true end
		if not canCarve() or ownedHold.RunId ~= player:GetAttribute("QuestRunId") then cancelHold()
		elseif ownedHold.Observed and not currentAction() then ownedHold = nil end
	end
	if panel.Visible then updatePanel() end
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if camera then
		local size = gui.AbsoluteSize
		panelScale.Scale = math.min(1, math.max(.45, (size.X - 32) / 580), math.max(.45, (size.Y - 48) / 460))
		local scale = math.min(1, (size.X - 32) / 420, (size.Y - 48) / 460)
		harvestScale.Scale = scale
		local compact=size.X<1000 or size.Y<560
		harvest.AnchorPoint = if compact then Vector2.new(.5,1) else Vector2.new(1,1)
		harvest.Position = if compact then UDim2.new(.5,0,1,-12) else UDim2.new(1,-20,1,-24)
	end
	harvest.Visible = live and inHunting and state == "Harvest" and player:GetAttribute("QuestResult") == "Defeated"
		and not flying and not panel.Visible and not otherMenuOpen()
	if not harvest.Visible then return end
	local completed = math.clamp(count(player:GetAttribute("HuntCarves")), 0, 3)
	carved.Text = string.format("Đã mổ %d / 3", completed)
	local action = currentAction()
	local left = math.max(0, numberAttribute("HuntHarvestEnds", now) - now)
	local duration = math.max(.01, numberAttribute("HuntHarvestDuration", 1.5))
	carveButton.Text = if action then string.format("GIỮ G · ĐANG MỔ %.1fs", left)
		elseif completed >= 3 then "ĐÃ MỔ ĐỦ 3 LƯỢT" else "GIỮ G · MỔ XÁC (1,5s)"
	enabled(carveButton, canCarve() and completed < 3 and (action or player:GetAttribute("HuntCarveAvailable") == true))
	fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(if action then math.clamp(1 - left / duration, 0, 1) else 0, 1)
	harvestHint.Text = if completed >= 3 then "Đã nhận đủ nguyên liệu mổ. Có thể tiếp tục nhặt đồ hoặc về sảnh."
		elseif player:GetAttribute("Drawn") == true then "Nhấn R cất vũ khí trước khi mổ xác."
		elseif action then "Giữ G/nút · đứng yên; thả để hủy."
		elseif player:GetAttribute("HuntCarveAvailable") == true then "Giữ G 1,5 giây để nhận một phần nguyên liệu."
		else "Đến gần xác và cất vũ khí để mổ."
end

local function aimDirection(ranged, dodge)
	local character = player.Character
	local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local dir = lastDirection
	if ranged and root then
		local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera; local size=camera.ViewportSize
		local ray=camera:ViewportPointToRay(size.X/2,size.Y/2)
		local params=RaycastParams.new(); params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances={character,workspace:FindFirstChild("TrainingPets")}
		local result=workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin,ray.Direction*250,params)
		local target=if result then result.Position else ray.Origin+ray.Direction*250
		local vector=target-(root.Position+Vector3.new(0,.8,0))
		return if vector.Magnitude>.01 then vector.Unit else camera.CFrame.LookVector
	end
	if (locked or aiming) and not dodge then dir = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
	elseif hum and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.1 then dir = hum.MoveDirection
	elseif root then dir = lastDirection end
	dir = Vector3.new(dir.X, 0, dir.Z)
	return if dir.Magnitude > 0.01 then dir.Unit else Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
end

		and camera.CameraType==Enum.CameraType.Custom

	if want and not bowView then
		bowView={Humanoid=hum,Camera=camera,Offset=hum.CameraOffset,AutoRotate=hum.AutoRotate,FOV=camera.FieldOfView,
			MinZoom=player.CameraMinZoomDistance,MaxZoom=player.CameraMaxZoomDistance,
			Distance=math.clamp((camera.CFrame.Position-camera.Focus.Position).Magnitude,player.CameraMinZoomDistance,player.CameraMaxZoomDistance),
			Sensitivity=UIS.MouseDeltaSensitivity,MouseIcon=UIS.MouseIconEnabled}
	end

local KatanaPro = {}

local c = Color3.fromRGB
local WD_DARK   = c(35, 25, 22)    -- Gỗ mun đen (Cán kiếm)
local WRAP_RED  = c(185, 35, 45)   -- Dây quấn cán đỏ (Tsuka-maki)
local GOLD      = c(232, 183, 95)  -- Vàng kim (Tsuba, Habaki, Kashira)
local STEEL     = c(195, 210, 220) -- Thép sáng (Sống kiếm)
local EDGE_NEON = c(120, 245, 255) -- Ánh sáng xanh ngọc (Lưỡi kiếm & Hiệu ứng)

local function makePart(className: string, name: string, size: Vector3, color: Color3, mat: Enum.Material?): BasePart
	local p = Instance.new(className) :: BasePart
	p.Name = name
	p.Size = size
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = mat or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	p.Anchored = false
	p.CanCollide = false
	p.CanTouch = false
	p.CanQuery = false
	p.Massless = true
	return p
end

function KatanaPro.buildMain(parent: Instance?): Model
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "Main"

	local origin = CFrame.new()

	-- 1. Cán kiếm gốc (PrimaryPart)
	local handle = makePart("Part", "Handle", Vector3.new(0.2, 1.35, 0.26), WD_DARK)
	handle.CFrame = origin
	handle.Parent = model
	model.PrimaryPart = handle

	local function addPart(className: string, name: string, size: Vector3, offset: CFrame, color: Color3, mat: Enum.Material?)
		local p = makePart(className, name, size, color, mat)
		p.CFrame = origin * offset
		p.Parent = model
		local w = Instance.new("Weld")
		w.Part0 = handle
		w.Part1 = p
		w.C0 = offset
		w.Name = "KatanaWeld"
		w.Parent = p
		return p
	end

	-- 2. Đế cán kiếm (Kashira) & Vòng cổ cán (Fuchi)
	addPart("Part", "Kashira", Vector3.new(0.24, 0.12, 0.3), CFrame.new(0, -0.7, 0), GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal)
	addPart("Part", "Fuchi", Vector3.new(0.24, 0.1, 0.29), CFrame.new(0, 0.65, 0), GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal)

	-- 3. Dây quấn cán kiếm hình thoi (Tsuka-maki - 4 vòng đan chéo)
	for i = -2, 1 do
		local yPos = i * 0.28 + 0.1
		addPart("Part", "Wrap_" .. i, Vector3.new(0.23, 0.14, 0.28), CFrame.new(0, yPos, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0.35, 0, 0), WRAP_RED, Enum.Material.Fabric)
	end

	-- 4. Chắn tay (Tsuba) 2 lớp sang trọng + Khâu kiếm (Habaki)
	addPart("Part", "TsubaCore", Vector3.new(0.75, 0.1, 0.45), CFrame.new(0, 0.74, 0), WD_DARK, Enum.Material.Metal)
	addPart("Part", "TsubaRim", Vector3.new(0.85, 0.06, 0.52), CFrame.new(0, 0.74, 0), GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal)
	addPart("Part", "Habaki", Vector3.new(0.26, 0.28, 0.18), CFrame.new(0, 0.92, 0), GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal)

	-- 5. Thân lưỡi kiếm dưới (Thẳng từ chắn tay lên)
	addPart("Part", "BladeLower", Vector3.new(0.24, 1.9, 0.08), CFrame.new(0, 1.95, 0), STEEL, Enum.Material.Metal)
	addPart("Part", "EdgeLower", Vector3.new(0.05, 1.9, 0.09), CFrame.new(0.13, 1.95, 0), EDGE_NEON, Enum.Material.Neon)

	-- 6. Thân lưỡi kiếm trên (Hơi uốn cong về phía lưng kiếm -X để tạo dáng Katana)
	local upperOffset = CFrame.new(-0.08, 3.75, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0.08)
	addPart("Part", "BladeUpper", Vector3.new(0.22, 1.8, 0.075), upperOffset, STEEL, Enum.Material.Metal)
	addPart("Part", "EdgeUpper", Vector3.new(0.05, 1.8, 0.085), upperOffset * CFrame.new(0.12, 0, 0), EDGE_NEON, Enum.Material.Neon)

	-- 7. Mũi kiếm vát nhọn (Kissaki dùng WedgePart)
	local tipOffset = upperOffset * CFrame.new(0.01, 1.15, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0)

-- Cosmetic only: no hitbox, damage, physics or remote requests.
function KatanaPro.spawnSlashWave(rootCF: CFrame, height: number?)
	local waveModel = Instance.new("Model")
	waveModel.Name = "KatanaSlashWave"
	local startCF = rootCF * CFrame.new(0, height or 2.3, -1.8) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-25))
	local core = makePart("Part", "WaveCore", Vector3.new(0.18, 3.6, 0.9), EDGE_NEON, Enum.Material.Neon)
	core.Anchored = true
	core.CFrame = startCF
	core.Parent = waveModel
	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color, light.Brightness, light.Range = EDGE_NEON, 3, 10
	light.Parent = core
	waveModel.Parent = workspace
	local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	TweenService:Create(core, tweenInfo, {
		CFrame = startCF * CFrame.new(0, 0, -14),
		Size = Vector3.new(0.05, 5.2, 1.4),
		Transparency = 1,
	}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(light, tweenInfo, {Brightness = 0}):Play()
	Debris:AddItem(waveModel, 0.4)
	return waveModel
end

function KatanaPro.effects(weapon: Instance)
	local out = {}
	for _,item in weapon:GetDescendants() do
		if (item:IsA("Trail") and item.Name == "SlashTrail")
			or (item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") and item.Name == "SlashSparks") then
			table.insert(out, item)
		end
	end
	return out
end

function KatanaPro.setEffects(effects, enabled: boolean)
	for _,effect in effects do
		if effect.Parent then effect.Enabled = enabled end
	end
end

function KatanaPro.burst(effects)
	for _,effect in effects do
		if effect.Parent and effect:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then effect:Emit(10) end
	end
end

return KatanaPro

	return character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"), character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local function otherMenuOpen()
	if GuiService.MenuIsOpen or Input:GetFocusedTextBox() then return true end
	local economy=playerGui:FindFirstChild("HunDinoEconomy")
	if economy and economy:FindFirstChild("Panel") and economy.Panel.Visible then return true end
	local training = playerGui:FindFirstChild("HunDinoTrainingHUD")
	if training and training.Enabled then
		for _, name in {"WeaponSelection", "HubPanel", "BaseTransitMenu"} do
			local menu = training:FindFirstChild(name)
			if menu and menu:IsA("GuiObject") and menu.Visible then return true end
		end
	end

	return viewer ~= nil and viewer.Enabled and picker ~= nil and picker.Visible
end
local function cancelHold()
	if not ownedHold then return end
	ownedHold = nil
	if alive then remote:FireServer("QuestActionCancel") end
end
local function canAct()
	local hum = characterParts()
	return alive and hum ~= nil and hum.Health > 0 and player:GetAttribute("QuestState") == "Hunting"
		and player:GetAttribute("InHunting") == true and player:GetAttribute("AdminFlying") ~= true
		and player:GetAttribute("Drawn") ~= true and not board.Visible and not result.Visible and not otherMenuOpen()
end
local function captureRange()
	local point = player:GetAttribute("HuntCapturePoint")
	if typeof(point) ~= "Vector3" and target then point = target:GetAttribute("CapturePoint") end
	local _, root = characterParts()
	if typeof(point) ~= "Vector3" or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then return math.huge end
	return (point - root.Position).Magnitude
end
local function captureReady()
	if player:GetAttribute("SpecimenFull")==true then return false end
	if player:GetAttribute("HuntCaptureAvailable") == true then return true end
	return target ~= nil and target:GetAttribute("Weak") == true and target:GetAttribute("Trapped") == true
		and target:GetAttribute("Captured") ~= true and captureRange() <= 4
end
local function startHold(action, owner)
	if ownedHold or not canAct() or currentAction() ~= nil then return end
	if action == "Place" and numberAttribute("HuntTraps", 0) <= 0 then return end
	if action == "Capture" and (numberAttribute("HuntPotions", 0) <= 0 or not captureReady()) then return end
	ownedHold = {Action = action, Owner = owner, Observed = false}
	remote:FireServer(if action == "Place" then "TrapPlaceStart" else "CaptureStart")
end

local function refreshBoss(now, visible, harvest)
	boss.Visible = visible and target ~= nil
	if not boss.Visible then return false end
	title.Text = player:GetAttribute("QuestTarget") or "T-REX · KHÔNG HỆ"
	local maximum = target:GetAttribute("MaxHealth")
	local hp = target:GetAttribute("Health")
	local weak = false
	if finite(maximum) and maximum > 0 and finite(hp) then
		local ratio = math.clamp(hp / maximum, 0, 1)
		weak = hp > 0 and ratio <= .1
		health.Text = string.format("%d / %d HP", math.ceil(math.max(0, hp)), math.ceil(maximum))
		hpFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(ratio, 1); hpFill.BackgroundColor3 = if weak then RED else GREEN
	else
		health.Text = "Mục tiêu ở ngoài tầm quan sát"; hpFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
	end
	weakBadge.Visible = weak and not harvest
	weakBadge.TextTransparency = if weak then .08 + .48 * ((math.sin(now * 6) + 1) / 2) else 0
	local trapLeft = math.max(0, numberAttribute("HuntTrapEnds", now) - now)
	local trapped = player:GetAttribute("HuntTrapState") == "Holding" and trapLeft > 0
	local urgent = trapped and trapLeft <= 3
	bossTrap.Text = if harvest then (if player:GetAttribute("QuestResult") == "Captured" then "ĐÃ BẮT SỐNG · CUỘC SĂN HOÀN THÀNH" else "ĐÃ HẠ GỤC · CUỘC SĂN HOÀN THÀNH")
		elseif trapped then string.format("GIỮ BẪY: %.1fs", trapLeft) else "BẪY SẮT · GIỮ MỤC TIÊU 13 GIÂY"
	bossTrap.TextColor3 = if harvest then GREEN elseif urgent then RED elseif trapped then AMBER else MUTED
	bossTrap.TextTransparency = if urgent and not harvest then .4 * ((math.sin(now * 13) + 1) / 2) else 0
	-- Only the countdown label moves; the health bar and camera remain steady.
	bossTrap.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16 + (if urgent and not harvest then math.sin(now * 39) * 1.5 else 0), 78)
	trapTrack.Visible = trapped and not harvest
	trapFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(trapLeft / 13, 0, 1), 1)
	trapFill.BackgroundColor3 = if urgent then RED else AMBER
	return weak
end

	if not alive then return end
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local size = gui.AbsoluteSize

		boardScale.Scale = math.min(1, math.max(.5, (size.X - 32) / 500), math.max(.5, (size.Y - 48) / 400))

			hud.Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 132)

			boss.Position = UDim2.new(.5, 0, 0, 66)

			hud.Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, if size.Y < 650 then 174 else 220)
			bossScale.Scale = math.min(1, math.max(.5, (size.X - 40) / 700))
			boss.Position = UDim2.new(.5, 0, 0, 82)
		end
	end
	local state = player:GetAttribute("QuestState")
	local runId = tostring(player:GetAttribute("QuestRunId") or "")
	local inHunting = player:GetAttribute("InHunting") == true
	local hum = characterParts()
	openBoard.Visible = not inHunting and player:GetAttribute("InTraining") ~= true and player:GetAttribute("AdminFlying") ~= true
		and hum ~= nil and hum.Health > 0 and state ~= "Preparing" and state ~= "Returning"
	if state == "Preparing" or inHunting then board.Visible = false end
	if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then board.Visible = false end
	local outcome = player:GetAttribute("QuestResult")
	local failed = outcome == "Failed" or outcome == "Abandoned"
	if state == "Returning" and not failed then result.Visible = false end
	if (state == "Failed" or (state == "Closed" and failed)) and runId ~= resultShownFor and runId ~= dismissedFor then
		resultShownFor = runId; result.Visible = true; cancelHold()
	end
	if board.Visible and (player:GetAttribute("AdminFlying") == true or player:GetAttribute("InTraining") == true) then board.Visible = false end
	if state == "Hunting" then result.Visible = false end
	hud.Visible = inHunting and (state == "Hunting" or state == "Harvest")
	refreshResult()
	if not target or not target.Parent then
		if now >= nextTargetAt then
			nextTargetAt = now + 1
			local candidate = workspace:FindFirstChild("Dinosaur01_TRex_Visual")
			target = if candidate and candidate:IsA("Model") then candidate else nil
		end
	end
	if ownedHold then
		local action = currentAction()
		if action == ownedHold.Action then ownedHold.Observed = true end
		if not canAct() then cancelHold()
		elseif ownedHold.Observed and action ~= ownedHold.Action then ownedHold = nil end
	end
	local harvest = state == "Harvest"
	local weak = refreshBoss(now, inHunting and hum ~= nil and hum.Health > 0, harvest)
	if not hud.Visible then return end
	remaining.Text = clock(numberAttribute(if harvest then "QuestHarvestUntil" else "QuestDeadline", now) - now)
	remaining.TextColor3 = if harvest or numberAttribute("QuestDeadline", now) - now <= 60 then AMBER else CREAM
	local hours = numberAttribute("GameClockHours", numberAttribute("HuntEntryClockHours", 14)) % 24
	local minutes = math.floor(hours * 60) % 1440
	environment.Text = string.format("%s  %02d:%02d · GIỜ RỪNG UTC+7 ×%g", if hours >= 6 and hours < 18 then "☀" else "☾", math.floor(minutes / 60), minutes % 60, numberAttribute("HuntTimeScale", 30))
	local deaths = math.clamp(math.floor(numberAttribute("QuestDeaths", 0)), 0, 4)
	resources.Text = string.format("HỒI SINH\n%d / 3", math.max(0, 3 - deaths))
	resources.TextColor3 = if deaths >= 2 then AMBER else CREAM
	place.Visible = not harvest; capture.Visible = not harvest
	earlyReturn.Visible = harvest; details.Visible = harvest
	if harvest then
		objective.Text = if player:GetAttribute("QuestResult") == "Captured" then "Bắt sống thành công · nhiệm vụ hoàn thành" else "Đã hạ gục T-Rex · nhiệm vụ hoàn thành"
		objective.TextColor3 = GREEN
		trapStatus.Text = "Tự động về sảnh sau " .. remaining.Text; trapStatus.TextColor3 = AMBER
		hint.Text = "Bạn có thể tiếp tục di chuyển, xem hiện trường hoặc về sảnh ngay."
		return
	end
	objective.Text = if weak then "Quái đủ yếu để bắt · ≤10% HP" else "Hạ gục hoặc bắt sống mục tiêu"
	objective.TextColor3 = if weak then RED else CREAM
	local trap = player:GetAttribute("HuntTrapState")
	local trapLeft = math.max(0, numberAttribute("HuntTrapEnds", now) - now)
	trapStatus.TextColor3 = if trap == "Holding" and trapLeft <= 3 then RED elseif trap == "Holding" then AMBER else MUTED
	trapStatus.Text = if trap == "Holding" then string.format("MẮC BẪY · còn %.1fs để cho uống thuốc", trapLeft)
		elseif trap == "Waiting" then "Bẫy đã đặt · dụ quái bước vào bẫy"
		elseif trap == "Expired" then "Bẫy đã hết hạn · cần đặt bẫy khác"
		elseif trap == "Escaped" then "Quái đã thoát bẫy" else "Chưa có bẫy · cất vũ khí, giữ B để đặt"
	local available = canAct()
	local action = currentAction()
	local placing, capturing = action == "Place", action == "Capture"
	local left = math.max(0, numberAttribute("HuntActionEnds", now) - now)
	place.Text = if placing then string.format("[Giữ B] Đang đặt · %.1fs", left) else string.format("[Giữ B] Đặt Bẫy Sắt (%d/3)", math.max(0, numberAttribute("HuntTraps", 0)))
	capture.Text = if capturing then string.format("[Giữ G] Đang cho uống · %.1fs", left) else string.format("[Giữ G] Thuốc Ngủ / Tương tác (%d/3)", math.max(0, numberAttribute("HuntPotions", 0)))
	enabled(place, available and (placing or action == nil) and numberAttribute("HuntTraps", 0) > 0)
	enabled(capture, available and (capturing or action == nil) and numberAttribute("HuntPotions", 0) > 0 and captureReady())
	hint.Text = if player:GetAttribute("AdminFlying") == true then "Đáp xuống đất trước khi dùng bẫy hoặc thuốc."
		elseif player:GetAttribute("SpecimenFull")==true then "Kho cá thể đầy. Chưa dùng thuốc; bạn vẫn có thể săn tiêu diệt."
		elseif player:GetAttribute("Drawn") == true then "Nhấn R cất vũ khí trước khi đặt bẫy hoặc cho uống thuốc."
		elseif capturing then "Tiếp tục giữ G/nút · không di chuyển, rút vũ khí hoặc nhận đòn."
		elseif placing then "Tiếp tục giữ B/nút · thả để hủy đặt bẫy."
		elseif weak and target:GetAttribute("Trapped") == true and captureRange() > 4 then "Đến gần miệng quái (≤4 studs), giữ G 3 giây."
		elseif captureReady() then "Giữ G 3 giây để cho uống thuốc · thả để hủy."
		else "Bắt sống: ≤10% HP → mắc bẫy → đến miệng, giữ G 3 giây."
	local respawnLeft = numberAttribute("QuestRespawnAt", 0) - now
	if respawnLeft > 0 then hint.Text = string.format("Bạn đã ngã · hồi sinh tại trại sau %.0f giây.", math.ceil(respawnLeft)) end
end
