-- Runtime geometry for one server-owned quest. Rules owns quantities, clocks and
-- the final result; this controller supplies real ground, movement and target checks.
local Controller = {}
Controller.__index = Controller

local UP = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
local TRAP_RADIUS = 4
local TRIGGER_RADIUS = 10
local PLACE_REACH = 5
local CAPTURE_REACH = 4
local MESSAGES = {
	NotHunting = "Chỉ dùng vật dụng trong lượt săn đang diễn ra.",
	NoTraps = "Đã hết Iron Trap. Bạn vẫn có thể tiêu diệt mục tiêu.",
	NoPotions = "Đã hết thuốc ngủ. Bạn vẫn có thể tiêu diệt mục tiêu.",
	Busy = "Hãy hoàn tất hoặc hủy thao tác hiện tại trước.",
	TrapActive = "Bẫy hiện tại vẫn đang chờ hoặc đang giữ mục tiêu.",
	NotTrapped = "Hãy dẫn mục tiêu vào Iron Trap trước.",
	NotWeak = "Mục tiêu cần còn sống và có không quá 10% máu.",
	TrapEscaped = "Bẫy đã hết hiệu lực; chưa dùng thuốc ngủ.",
	TrapExpired = "Bẫy đã hết thời gian chờ.",
	InvalidHealth = "Mục tiêu đã bị hạ hoặc không thể bắt.",
	ItemsBlocked = "Cất vũ khí và dừng đánh, né hoặc bay trước khi dùng vật dụng.",
	InvalidGround = "Không đặt được bẫy ở đây. Cần mặt đất phẳng, trống và ngoài trại.",
	Moved = "Đã hủy đặt bẫy vì bạn di chuyển. Chưa trừ bẫy.",
	Damaged = "Thao tác bị ngắt vì bạn bị đánh. Chưa dùng vật dụng.",
	TooFar = "Đến gần dấu miệng mục tiêu trong 4 studs để cho uống.",
	Obstructed = "Có vật cản giữa bạn và miệng mục tiêu.",
	SpecimenCapacity = "Kho cá thể đã đầy. Chưa dùng thuốc; bạn vẫn có thể tiêu diệt mục tiêu.",
}

local function flat(v) return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z) end
local function finite(n) return type(n) == "number" and n == n and math.abs(n) < math.huge end
local function vector(v)
	return typeof(v) == "Vector3" and finite(v.X) and finite(v.Y) and finite(v.Z)
end
local function attribute(object, key, value)
	if object and object.Parent and object:GetAttribute(key) ~= value then object:SetAttribute(key, value) end
end
local function decorate(part, name, size, cf, color, parent)
	part.Name = name; part.Size = size; part.CFrame = cf
	part.Anchored = true; part.CanCollide = false; part.CanTouch = false
	part.CanQuery = false; part.CastShadow = false; part.Color = color
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Metal; part.Parent = parent
	return part
end

function Controller.new(options)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Controller)
	for key, value in options do self[key] = value end
	assert(self.Player and self.Run and self.Rules and self.Combat and self.Forest, "Missing capture services")
	assert(type(self.Character) == "function" and type(self.CanUseItems) == "function", "Missing capture owner")
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "HuntItems_" .. tostring(self.Player.UserId)
	folder:SetAttribute("QuestRunId", self.Run.Id)
	folder:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", self.Player.UserId)
	folder.Parent = workspace
	self._folder = folder
	self._destroyed = false
	self._captureAvailable = false
	self:_publish()
	return self
end

function Controller:_message(reason)
	local text = MESSAGES[reason]
	if text and self.OnMessage then self.OnMessage(text) end
end
function Controller:_reject(reason)
	self:_message(reason)
	return false, reason
end
function Controller:_capacity()
	if type(self.CanCapture)~="function" then return true end
	local ok,allowed,reason=pcall(self.CanCapture)
	return ok and allowed==true,if ok then reason or "ItemsBlocked" else "ItemsBlocked"
end
function Controller:_actor()
	if self._destroyed or self.Run.State ~= "Hunting" or not self.Player.Parent
		or self.Player:GetAttribute("AdminFlying") == true or not self.CanUseItems() then return nil end
	local character = self.Character()
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not character or not character.Parent or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0
		or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") or not vector(root.Position) then return nil end
	return character, humanoid, root
end
function Controller:_queryParams(character, overlap)
	local params = if overlap then OverlapParams.new() else RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local ignored = {self._folder}
	if character then table.insert(ignored, character) end
	if self.PetFolder then table.insert(ignored, self.PetFolder) end
	if self.Combat.Model then table.insert(ignored, self.Combat.Model) end
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored
	params.RespectCanCollide = true
	if not overlap then params.IgnoreWater = false end
	return params
end
function Controller:_insideMap(point)
	local offset = self.Forest:GetAttribute("WorldOffset") or Vector3.new(0, 0, 6500)
	local width = self.Forest:GetAttribute("MapWidth") or 4000
	local depth = self.Forest:GetAttribute("MapDepth") or 4500
	if not vector(offset) or not finite(width) or not finite(depth) then return false end
	local localPoint = point - offset
	if math.abs(localPoint.X) + TRAP_RADIUS > width * .5
		or math.abs(localPoint.Z) + TRAP_RADIUS > depth * .5 then return false end
	local config = self.Combat.MapConfig
	if config and ((finite(config.TerrainMin) and point.Y < config.TerrainMin - 4)
		or (finite(config.TerrainMax) and point.Y > config.TerrainMax + 10)) then return false end
	local zones = self.Forest:FindFirstChild("Zones")
	local camp = zones and zones:FindFirstChild("Camp")
	local node = camp and camp:FindFirstChild("Node")
	local safeRadius = self.Forest:GetAttribute("CampSafeRadius") or 250
	return not node or flat(point - node.Position).Magnitude > safeRadius + TRAP_RADIUS
end

-- Sample the complete ring, not just its centre: an edge over water, an incline,
-- a nearby trunk or a gap invalidates the placement before an item is consumed.
function Controller:_ground(point, character, humanoid, root)
	if not vector(point) or not self:_insideMap(point) or flat(root.Position - point).Magnitude > PLACE_REACH then return nil end
	if math.abs(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y) > 5 then return nil end
	local state = humanoid:GetState()
	if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then return nil end
	local params = self:_queryParams(character, false)
	local centre = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(point.X, root.Position.Y + 2, point.Z), -UP * 12, params)
	if not centre or centre.Material == Enum.Material.Water or centre.Normal.Y < .94 then return nil end
	local height = centre.Position.Y
	if root.Position.Y - height > math.max(5, humanoid.HipHeight + root.Size.Y * .5 + 1.5) then return nil end
	for index = 0, 15 do
		local angle = index * math.pi / 8
		local edge = centre.Position + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle)) * TRAP_RADIUS
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(edge + UP * 3, -UP * 6, params)
		if not hit or hit.Material == Enum.Material.Water or hit.Normal.Y < .94 or math.abs(hit.Position.Y - height) > .65 then return nil end
		if workspace:Raycast(centre.Position + UP * .8, flat(edge - centre.Position), params) then return nil end
	end
	local overlap = self:_queryParams(character, true)
	local obstacles = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(centre.Position + UP * 1.05), Vector3.new(8.2, 1.3, 8.2), overlap)
	if #obstacles > 0 then return nil end
	return Vector3.new(point.X, height + .05, point.Z)
end

function Controller:_remember(character, humanoid, root, serial, point)
	self:_clearAction()
	local action = {
		Character = character, Humanoid = humanoid, Root = root, Serial = serial,
		Origin = root.Position, Point = point, LastHealth = humanoid.Health, Damaged = false,
	}
	action.HealthConnection = humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(health)
		if health < action.LastHealth then action.Damaged = true end
		action.LastHealth = health
	end)
	self._action = action
end
function Controller:_clearAction()
	if self._action and self._action.HealthConnection then self._action.HealthConnection:Disconnect() end
	self._action = nil
	if self._preview then self._preview:Destroy(); self._preview = nil end
end
function Controller:Cancel(reason)
	if self._destroyed then return end
	local hadAction = self.Run.Action ~= nil or self._action ~= nil
	self.Rules.cancelAction(self.Run)
	self:_clearAction()
	if hadAction then self:_message(reason) end
	self:_publish()
end

function Controller:RequestPlace(now)
	local character, humanoid, root = self:_actor()
	if not character then return self:_reject("ItemsBlocked") end
	-- Refuse repeated requests before the ring's ground/obstacle queries.
	if self.Run.Action then return self:_reject("Busy") end
	if self.Run.ActiveTrap then return self:_reject("TrapActive") end
	if self.Run.Traps <= 0 then return self:_reject("NoTraps") end
	local look = flat(root.CFrame.LookVector)
	if look.Magnitude < .01 then return self:_reject("InvalidGround") end
	local point = self:_ground(root.Position + look.Unit * 4.25, character, humanoid, root)
	if not point then return self:_reject("InvalidGround") end
	local accepted, reason, serial = self.Rules.beginPlace(self.Run, now)
	if not accepted then return self:_reject(reason) end
	self:_remember(character, humanoid, root, serial or self.Run.Action.Serial, point)
	local preview = decorate(Instance.new("Part"), "TrapPlacement", Vector3.new(8, .07, 8), CFrame.new(point), Color3.fromRGB(211, 173, 86), self._folder)
	preview.Transparency = .7; preview.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	self._preview = preview
	self:_publish()
	return true
end

function Controller:_mouth(character, root)
	local point = self.Combat:GetCapturePoint()
	if not vector(point) then return nil, "NotTrapped" end
	if (root.Position - point).Magnitude > CAPTURE_REACH then return nil, "TooFar" end
	local delta = point - (root.Position + UP * .5)
	if delta.Magnitude > .01 and workspace:Raycast(root.Position + UP * .5, delta, self:_queryParams(character, false)) then
		return nil, "Obstructed"
	end
	return point
end
function Controller:RequestCapture(now)
	local character, humanoid, root = self:_actor()
	if not character then return self:_reject("ItemsBlocked") end
	local space,spaceReason=self:_capacity();if not space then return self:_reject(spaceReason) end
	local point, reason = self:_mouth(character, root)
	if not point then return self:_reject(reason) end
	local health = self.Combat:GetSnapshot()
	local accepted, ruleReason, serial = self.Rules.beginCapture(self.Run, now, health.Health, health.MaxHealth)
	if not accepted then return self:_reject(ruleReason) end
	self:_remember(character, humanoid, root, serial or self.Run.Action.Serial, point)
	self:_publish() -- Pause the owner's pet as soon as the drinking action begins.
	return true
end

function Controller:_createTrap(trap, point)
	self:_clearTrap()
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "IronTrap"
	model:SetAttribute("QuestRunId", self.Run.Id)
	model:SetAttribute("TrapId", trap.Id)
	model:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", self.Player.UserId)
	model.Parent = self._folder
	local copper = Color3.fromRGB(189, 126, 66)
	for index = 0, 15 do
		local angle = index * math.pi / 8
		local at = point + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * TRAP_RADIUS, .11, math.sin(angle) * TRAP_RADIUS)
		local bar = decorate(Instance.new("Part"), "IronRing", Vector3.new(.24, .16, 1.64), CFrame.lookAt(at, point + UP * .11) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi * .5, 0), copper, model)
		bar.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		local tooth = decorate(Instance.new("WedgePart"), "IronTooth", Vector3.new(.4, .65, .7), CFrame.lookAt(at + UP * .22, point + UP * .33), Color3.fromRGB(92, 103, 104), model)
		tooth.Material = Enum.Material.DiamondPlate
	end
	decorate(Instance.new("Part"), "TriggerPlate", Vector3.new(2.2, .15, 2.2), CFrame.new(point + UP * .1), Color3.fromRGB(80, 89, 91), model)
	self._trapModel, self._trapPoint, self._trapId = model, point, trap.Id
end
function Controller:_clearTrap()
	if self._trapModel then self._trapModel:Destroy(); self._trapModel = nil end
	self._trapPoint, self._trapId = nil, nil
	if self._held then self.Combat:ReleaseTrap(self.Run.Id); self._held = false end
	if self._mouthMarker then self._mouthMarker:Destroy(); self._mouthMarker = nil end
end
function Controller:_marker(point)
	if not self._mouthMarker then
		local part = decorate(Instance.new("Part"), "CaptureMouth", Vector3.new(.65, .65, .65), CFrame.new(point), Color3.fromRGB(122, 221, 194), self._folder)
		part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball; part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui"); gui.Name = "MouthHint"
		gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(232, 55); gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = UP * 2.3
		gui.AlwaysOnTop = false; gui.MaxDistance = 70; gui.Adornee = part; gui.Parent = part
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel"); label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 43, 37); label.BackgroundTransparency = .18
		label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(228, 250, 222); label.TextSize = 14
		label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold; label.Text = "MIỆNG MỤC TIÊU\nCất vũ khí • Giữ G để cho uống"; label.Parent = gui
		local corner = Instance.new("UICorner"); corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8); corner.Parent = label
		self._mouthMarker = part
	end
	self._mouthMarker.Position = point
end

function Controller:_publish()
	local run, action, trap = self.Run, self.Run.Action, self.Run.ActiveTrap
	local hunting = not self._destroyed and run.State == "Hunting"
	attribute(self.Player, "HuntAction", if hunting and action then action.Kind else "")
	attribute(self.Player, "HuntActionEnds", if hunting and action then action.FinishAt else 0)
	attribute(self.Player, "HuntCaptureActive", hunting and action ~= nil and action.Kind == "Capture")
	attribute(self.Player, "HuntTrapState", if hunting and trap then trap.State else "")
	attribute(self.Player, "HuntTrapEnds", if hunting and trap then trap.HeldUntil or trap.ExpiresAt else 0)
	attribute(self.Player, "HuntTraps", run.Traps or 0)
	attribute(self.Player, "HuntPotions", run.Potions or 0)
	attribute(self.Player, "HuntCaptureAvailable", hunting and self._captureAvailable == true)
	attribute(self.Player, "HuntCapturePoint", if hunting then self._capturePoint else nil)
end

function Controller:Step(now, _dt)
 if self._pendingTrap then
  if not self.OnItemsChanged or self.OnItemsChanged() then
   local pending=self._pendingTrap;self._pendingTrap=nil
   if not self._destroyed and self.Run.State=="Hunting" then self:_createTrap(pending.Trap,pending.Point) end
  end
  return
 end
	if self._destroyed then return end
	if self.Run.State ~= "Hunting" then
		self:Cancel()
		self:_clearTrap()
		self._captureAvailable, self._capturePoint = false, nil
		self:_publish()
		return
	end
	local trap = self.Run.ActiveTrap
	if self._trapId and (not trap or trap.Id ~= self._trapId) then self:_clearTrap() end
	if trap and self._trapPoint and trap.State == "Waiting" and now <= trap.ExpiresAt then
		local support = self.Combat:GetSupportPoint()
		local health = self.Combat:GetSnapshot()
		if health.Health > 0 and vector(support) and flat(support - self._trapPoint).Magnitude <= TRIGGER_RADIUS
			and math.abs(support.Y - self._trapPoint.Y) <= 5 then
			local accepted = self.Rules.triggerTrap(self.Run, now)
			if accepted then
				self._held = self.Combat:TrapFor(self.Run.Id, trap.HeldUntil) == true
				if self._held then
					self._trapModel:SetAttribute("Triggered", true)
					if self.OnMessage then self.OnMessage("Iron Trap đã giữ mục tiêu trong 13 giây. Còn sống và máu ≤10% mới cho uống được.") end
				else
					-- Another terminal change can win before acquisition. Never leave a
					-- fictitious Holding state from which a potion could capture it.
					self.Run.ActiveTrap = nil
					self:Cancel()
					self:_clearTrap()
				end
			end
		end
	end
	trap = self.Run.ActiveTrap
	if trap and trap.State == "Holding" and now <= trap.HeldUntil and self._held then
		local point = self.Combat:GetCapturePoint()
		self._capturePoint = if vector(point) then point else nil
		if self._capturePoint then self:_marker(self._capturePoint)
		elseif self._mouthMarker then self._mouthMarker:Destroy(); self._mouthMarker = nil end
	else
		self._capturePoint = nil
		if self._mouthMarker then self._mouthMarker:Destroy(); self._mouthMarker = nil end
	end
	local character, humanoid, root = self:_actor()
	self._captureAvailable = false
	if character and self._capturePoint then
		local health = self.Combat:GetSnapshot()
		self._captureAvailable = self:_capacity() and health.Health > 0 and health.Health <= health.MaxHealth * .1
			and self.Run.Potions > 0 and (root.Position - self._capturePoint).Magnitude <= CAPTURE_REACH
			and self:_mouth(character, root) ~= nil
	end
	local action, remembered = self.Run.Action, self._action
	if not action then
		self:_clearAction()
	elseif not remembered or remembered.Serial ~= action.Serial then
		self:Cancel()
	elseif not character or character ~= remembered.Character or humanoid ~= remembered.Humanoid or root ~= remembered.Root then
		self:Cancel("ItemsBlocked")
	elseif remembered.Damaged or humanoid.Health < remembered.LastHealth then
		self:Cancel("Damaged")
	elseif action.Kind == "Place" then
		if (root.Position - remembered.Origin).Magnitude > 1.6 then
			self:Cancel("Moved")
		elseif now >= action.FinishAt then
			local point = self:_ground(remembered.Point, character, humanoid, root)
			if not point or (point - remembered.Point).Magnitude > .7 then
				self:Cancel("InvalidGround")
			else
				local placed, reason = self.Rules.commitPlace(self.Run, now, remembered.Serial)
				self:_clearAction()
				if placed then
     self._pendingTrap={Trap=placed,Point=point}
     if not self.OnItemsChanged or self.OnItemsChanged() then
      self._pendingTrap=nil;self:_createTrap(placed,point)
     end
				else self.Rules.cancelAction(self.Run); self:_message(reason) end
			end
		end
	elseif action.Kind == "Capture" then
		local point, reason = self:_mouth(character, root)
		local space,spaceReason=self:_capacity()
		if not space then self:Cancel(spaceReason)
		elseif not point or not self._held or not trap or trap.State ~= "Holding" or now > trap.HeldUntil then
			self:Cancel(reason or "TrapEscaped")
		else
			local health = self.Combat:GetSnapshot()
			if health.Health <= 0 or health.Health > health.MaxHealth * .1 then
				self:Cancel(if health.Health <= 0 then "InvalidHealth" else "NotWeak")
			elseif now >= action.FinishAt then
				local captured, result = self.Rules.commitCapture(self.Run, now, health.Health, health.MaxHealth, remembered.Serial)
				self:_clearAction()
				if captured then
					self._captureAvailable, self._capturePoint = false, nil
					if self.OnCapture then self.OnCapture() end
					self:_clearTrap()
				else
					self.Rules.cancelAction(self.Run)
					self:_message(result)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	self:_publish()
end

function Controller:GetSnapshot()
	local action, trap = self.Run.Action, self.Run.ActiveTrap
	return {
		Action = if action then action.Kind else "", ActionEnds = if action then action.FinishAt else 0,
		TrapState = if trap then trap.State else "", TrapEnds = if trap then trap.HeldUntil or trap.ExpiresAt else 0,
		TrapPoint = self._trapPoint, CapturePoint = self._capturePoint, CaptureAvailable = self._captureAvailable,
		Traps = self.Run.Traps, Potions = self.Run.Potions, Held = self._held == true,
	}
end
function Controller:Destroy()
	if self._destroyed then return end
	self:Cancel()
	self:_clearTrap()
	self._destroyed = true
	self._captureAvailable, self._capturePoint = false, nil
	if self._folder then self._folder:Destroy() end
	self:_publish()
end

return Controller

-- A slow procedural walk for the current segmented dinosaur mesh.
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local MotionController = {}
MotionController.__index = MotionController
local controllers = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

function MotionController.new(model)
	if controllers[model] then return controllers[model] end
	local root = assert(model.PrimaryPart, "Missing dinosaur root")
	local motors = {}
	for _, part in model:GetDescendants() do
		if part:IsA("Motor6D") and part.Name ~= "JawMotor" then
			motors[part.Name] = { joint = part, rest = part:GetAttribute("RestC0") }
			local encoded = part:GetAttribute("FootSamples")
			if encoded then motors[part.Name].foot = HttpService:JSONDecode(encoded) end
		end
	end
	local forward = root.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(model:GetAttribute("ForwardInRoot"))
	forward = Vector3.new(forward.X, 0, forward.Z).Unit
	local heading = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + forward)
	local self = setmetatable({ Model = model, Root = root, Motors = motors,
		Home = root.CFrame, Heading = heading, Offset = heading:ToObjectSpace(root.CFrame),
		_phase = 0, _pathAngle = 0, _blend = 0, _walking = false,
		_nod = 0, _elapsed = 0, _accumulator = 0 }, MotionController)
	self._center = root.Position - heading.RightVector * 50
	self._connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt) self:_step(dt) end)
	controllers[model] = self
	model:SetAttribute("PreviewWalking", false)
	return self
end

local function footOffset(data, angle, lift, bob)
	local restMinimum, minimum = math.huge, math.huge
	for _, point in data.foot do
		restMinimum = math.min(restMinimum, point[2])
		minimum = math.min(minimum, point[2] * math.cos(angle) - point[3] * math.sin(angle))
	end
	return restMinimum - minimum + lift - bob
end

function MotionController:_step(dt)
	self._accumulator += dt
	if self._accumulator < 1 / 30 then return end
	dt = math.min(self._accumulator, .12)
	self._accumulator = 0
	self._elapsed += dt
	local target = self._walking and 1 or 0
	self._blend += (target - self._blend) * math.min(1, dt * 6)
	if self._blend < .0001 then self._blend = 0 end
	local blend = self._blend
	self._phase += dt * math.pi * 2 * .66 * blend
	local phase = self._phase
	local bob = .18 * (1 - math.cos(phase * 2)) * .5 * blend
	if blend > 0 then
		local speed = math.clamp(self.Model:GetAttribute("WalkSpeed") or 6, 0, 12)
		self._pathAngle += dt * speed * blend / 50
		local angle = self._pathAngle
		local side, forward = self.Heading.RightVector, self.Heading.LookVector
		local position = self._center + (side * math.cos(angle) + forward * math.sin(angle)) * 50
		local direction = -side * math.sin(angle) + forward * math.cos(angle)
		self.Root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position + Vector3.new(0, bob, 0), position + direction + Vector3.new(0, bob, 0))
			* CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.sin(phase) * .006 * blend) * self.Offset
	end
	for name, sign in { LeftHip = 1, RightHip = -1 } do
		local data = self.Motors[name]
		local angle = math.sin(phase) * sign * math.rad(11) * blend
		local lift = math.max(0, math.cos(phase) * sign) * .8 * blend
		local offset = footOffset(data, angle, lift, bob)
		data.joint.C0 = data.rest * CFrame.new(0, offset, 0) * CFrame.Angles(angle, 0, 0)
	end
	for name, sign in { LeftShoulder = -1, RightShoulder = 1 } do
		local data = self.Motors[name]
		data.joint.C0 = data.rest * CFrame.Angles(math.sin(phase) * sign * .065 * blend, 0, 0)
	end
	local tail = self.Motors.Tail
	tail.joint.C0 = tail.rest * CFrame.Angles(0, math.sin(phase - .4) * .035 * blend, 0)
	local bite = self.Model:GetAttribute("BitePhase")
	local nodTarget = bite == "Closing" and -math.rad(5)
		or ((bite == "Opening" or bite == "Holding") and math.rad(1.5) or 0)
	self._nod += (nodTarget - self._nod) * math.min(1, dt * 15)
	local neck = self.Motors.Neck
	neck.joint.C0 = neck.rest * CFrame.Angles(self._nod + math.sin(phase * 2) * .012 * blend, 0, 0)
end

function MotionController:SetWalking(enabled)
	self._walking = enabled == true
	self.Model:SetAttribute("PreviewWalking", self._walking)
end

function MotionController:Reset()
	self:SetWalking(false)
	self._blend, self._phase, self._pathAngle, self._nod = 0, 0, 0, 0
	self.Root.CFrame = self.Home
	for _, data in self.Motors do data.joint.C0 = data.rest end
end

function MotionController:Destroy()
	if self._connection then self._connection:Disconnect() end
	self:Reset()
	controllers[self.Model] = nil
end

return MotionController

-- Logic thuần: dùng chung với bài kiểm tra ngoài Studio.
local Rules = {}
function Rules.attack(config, state, action, now)
	if action ~= "Light" and action ~= "Heavy" and action ~= "Skill" then return nil end
	if not state.Drawn or now < state.BusyUntil or state.Sprinting then return nil end
	local step = if now <= state.ComboUntil then state.ComboStep else 0
	local kind = if action == "Skill" and step == 2 then "Finisher" else action
	local attack = config.Attacks[kind]
	if state.Stamina < attack.Cost then return nil end
	state.Stamina -= attack.Cost
	state.BusyUntil = now + attack.Duration
	state.LastSpend = state.BusyUntil
	state.ComboStep = if action == "Light" then 1 elseif action == "Heavy" and step == 1 then 2 else 0
	state.ComboUntil = state.BusyUntil + config.ComboWindow
	return kind, attack
end
function Rules.regenerate(config, state, now, dt)
	if not state.Sprinting and now >= state.BusyUntil and now - state.LastSpend >= config.RegenDelay then
		state.Stamina = math.min(config.MaxStamina, state.Stamina + config.StaminaRegen * dt)
	end
end
return Rules

-- Server-owned, disposable P1-E resources. Inventory changes go through Grant;
-- this module never grants an item merely because a target died or a node spawned.
local Controller = {}
Controller.__index = Controller

local UP = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
local CARVE_SECONDS, CARVE_LIMIT, REACH = 1.5, 3, 8
local function finite(n) return type(n) == "number" and n == n and math.abs(n) < math.huge end
local function vector(v) return typeof(v) == "Vector3" and finite(v.X) and finite(v.Y) and finite(v.Z) end
local function flat(v) return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z) end
local function set(object, key, value)
	if object and object.Parent and object:GetAttribute(key) ~= value then object:SetAttribute(key, value) end
end
local function nearest(box, origin)
	local p, half = box.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(origin), box.Size * .5
	return box.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(math.clamp(p.X, -half.X, half.X), math.clamp(p.Y, -half.Y, half.Y), math.clamp(p.Z, -half.Z, half.Z)))
end
local function part(name, size, position, color, material, parent)
	local item = Instance.new("Part"); item.Name = name; item.Size = size; item.Position = position
	item.Anchored = true; item.CanCollide = false; item.CanTouch = false; item.CanQuery = false
	item.Color = color; item.Material = material; item.Parent = parent
	return item
end

function Controller.new(options)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Controller)
	for key, value in options do self[key] = value end
	assert(self.Player and self.Run and self.Combat and self.Forest, "Missing harvest services")
	assert(type(self.Character) == "function" and type(self.CanInteract) == "function" and type(self.Grant) == "function", "Missing harvest owner or economy")
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder"); folder.Name = "HuntHarvest_" .. tostring(self.Player.UserId)
	folder:SetAttribute("QuestRunId", self.Run.Id); folder:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", self.Player.UserId)
	folder.Parent = workspace; self._folder = folder
	self._connections, self._nodes = {}, {}
	self.Run.HarvestProgress = self.Run.HarvestProgress or {Carves = 0, OreCollected = {}, DropConsidered = false, DropSpawned = false, DropCollected = false}
	self.Progress = self.Run.HarvestProgress
	self._lastHealth = self.Combat:GetSnapshot().Health
	local ok, failure = pcall(function() self:_createOre() end)
	if not ok then self:Destroy(); error(failure, 2) end
	self:_publish()
	return self
end
function Controller:_message(text)
	if self.OnMessage then self.OnMessage(text) end
end
function Controller:_visit(now)
	local run = self.Run
	if self._destroyed or run.Closed or run.Returned then return false end
	if run.State == "Hunting" then return not finite(run.Deadline) or now <= run.Deadline end
	return run.State == "Harvest" and finite(run.HarvestUntil) and now <= run.HarvestUntil
end
function Controller:_actor(now)
	if not finite(now) or not self:_visit(now) or not self.Player.Parent
		or self.Player:GetAttribute("AdminFlying") == true or not self.CanInteract() then return nil end
	local character = self.Character()
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not character or not character.Parent or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0
		or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") or not vector(root.Position) then return nil end
	return character, humanoid, root
end
function Controller:_groundParams()
	local params = RaycastParams.new(); params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	local support = {workspace.Terrain}
	for _, name in {"Paths", "Zones"} do
		local group = self.Forest:FindFirstChild(name); if group then table.insert(support, group) end
	end
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = support; params.RespectCanCollide = true; params.IgnoreWater = false
	return params
end
function Controller:_obstacles()
	local params = OverlapParams.new(); params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {self.Forest}; params.RespectCanCollide = true
	return params
end
function Controller:_insideMap(point)
	local offset = self.Forest:GetAttribute("WorldOffset") or Vector3.new(0, 0, 6500)
	local width, depth = self.Forest:GetAttribute("MapWidth") or 4000, self.Forest:GetAttribute("MapDepth") or 4500
	return vector(point) and vector(offset) and finite(width) and finite(depth)
		and math.abs(point.X - offset.X) + 4 < width * .5 and math.abs(point.Z - offset.Z) + 4 < depth * .5
end
function Controller:_ground(point)
	if not self:_insideMap(point) then return nil end
	local params = self:_groundParams()
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(point + UP * 128, -UP * 256, params)
	if not hit or hit.Material == Enum.Material.Water or hit.Normal.Y < .82 then return nil end
	for _, delta in {Vector3.new(1.7, 0, 0), Vector3.new(-1.7, 0, 0), Vector3.new(0, 0, 1.7), Vector3.new(0, 0, -1.7)} do
		local edge = workspace:Raycast(hit.Position + delta + UP * 3, -UP * 6, params)
		if not edge or edge.Material == Enum.Material.Water or edge.Normal.Y < .82 or math.abs(edge.Position.Y - hit.Position.Y) > .85 then return nil end
	end
	if #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(hit.Position + UP * 2.3), Vector3.new(4, 3.2, 4), self:_obstacles()) > 0 then return nil end
	return hit.Position
end
function Controller:_lineClear(character, origin, point)
	local delta = point - origin
	if delta.Magnitude < .01 then return true end
	local params = RaycastParams.new(); params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local ignored = {character, self._folder}
	if self.Combat.Model then table.insert(ignored, self.Combat.Model) end
	if self.PetFolder then table.insert(ignored, self.PetFolder) end
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored; params.RespectCanCollide = true; params.IgnoreWater = false
	return workspace:Raycast(origin, delta, params) == nil
end
function Controller:_standing(humanoid, root)
	local state = humanoid:GetState()
	if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall or math.abs(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y) > 7 then return false end
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(root.Position + UP, -UP * 8, self:_groundParams())
	return hit ~= nil and hit.Material ~= Enum.Material.Water and hit.Normal.Y > .6
		and root.Position.Y - hit.Position.Y <= math.max(5.5, humanoid.HipHeight + root.Size.Y * .5 + 2)
end
function Controller:_pickup(record, player, now)
	if player ~= self.Player or record.Collected or record.Busy or self._action or self._committing then return false end
	local character, humanoid, root = self:_actor(now)
	if not character or not self:_standing(humanoid, root) or (root.Position - record.Point).Magnitude > REACH
		or not self:_lineClear(character, root.Position + UP * .5, record.Point + UP * .7) then return false end
	record.Busy = true
	local called, granted, result = pcall(self.Grant, record.Kind, record.Id, record.Index)
	record.Busy = false
	if self._destroyed then return called and granted == true end
	if not called or granted ~= true then self:_message("Chưa ghi nhận được vật phẩm; hãy thử lại tại đúng điểm này."); return false end
	record.Collected = true
	if record.Kind == "Ore" then self.Progress.OreCollected[record.Index] = true
	else self.Progress.DropCollected = true end
	if record.Model then record.Model:Destroy(); record.Model = nil end
	self._lootText = if record.Kind == "Ore" then "+1 sắt · đã vào kho thử của phiên" else "+1 vảy · đã vào kho thử của phiên"
	self:_message(self._lootText); self:_publish()
	return true, result
end
function Controller:_resource(kind, id, index, point)
	local record = {Kind = kind, Id = id, Index = index, Point = point, Collected = false}
	local model = Instance.new("Model"); model.Name = if kind == "Ore" then "IronOre_" .. index else "ScaleDrop"
	model:SetAttribute("QuestRunId", self.Run.Id); model:SetAttribute("SourceInstanceId", id)
	model:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", self.Player.UserId); model:SetAttribute("ResourceKind", kind)
	local base = part("Pickup", if kind == "Ore" then Vector3.new(3.1, 1.8, 2.5) else Vector3.new(1.7, .5, 1.25), point + UP * .9,
		if kind == "Ore" then Color3.fromRGB(70, 83, 91) else Color3.fromRGB(128, 194, 141),
		if kind == "Ore" then Enum.Material.Slate else Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, model)
	base.CFrame *= CFrame.Angles(0, index * .7, .13)
	if kind == "Ore" then
		for n = 1, 3 do
			local crystal = part("IronSeam", Vector3.new(.35, .9 + n * .1, 1.45), point + Vector3.new((n - 2) * .72, 1.35, 0), Color3.fromRGB(171, 179, 167), Enum.Material.Metal, model)
			crystal.CFrame *= CFrame.Angles(.2, n * .55, .2)
		end
	end
	local light = Instance.new("PointLight"); light.Color = base.Color; light.Brightness = .5; light.Range = 9; light.Parent = base
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt"); prompt.Name = "CollectResource"
	prompt.ActionText = if kind == "Ore" then "Đào +1 sắt" else "Nhặt +1 vảy"
	prompt.ObjectText = if kind == "Ore" then "Quặng sắt · một lần / lượt săn" else "Vảy rơi · giữ dù thắng hay thua"
	prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.G; prompt.MaxActivationDistance = REACH - .5
	-- A scale may be beneath the dinosaur's visible body. The server still
	-- checks walls from the actor; the creature must not hide its own prompt.
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0; prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = kind == "Ore"; prompt.Parent = base
	record.Model, record.Prompt = model, prompt
	table.insert(self._connections, prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player) self:_pickup(record, player, workspace:GetServerTimeNow()) end))
	model.PrimaryPart = base; model.Parent = self._folder
	table.insert(self._nodes, record)
	return record
end
function Controller:_createOre()
	local zones = self.Forest:FindFirstChild("Zones")
	local camp = zones and zones:FindFirstChild("Camp")
	local node = camp and camp:FindFirstChild("Node")
	assert(node and node:IsA("BasePart"), "Harvest requires the real Camp node")
	local safe = self.Forest:GetAttribute("CampSafeRadius") or 250
	local points = {}
	for index = 1, 6 do
		local angle = math.rad(25 + (index - 1) * 26)
		local selected
		for _, radiusExtra in {55, 75, 95, 115, 135} do
			for _, twist in {0, -.07, .07, -.14, .14} do
				local candidate = node.Position + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle + twist), 0, math.sin(angle + twist)) * (safe + radiusExtra)
				local point = self:_ground(candidate)
				if point and flat(point - node.Position).Magnitude > safe + 20 then
					local separated = true
					for _, other in points do if flat(point - other).Magnitude < 18 then separated = false; break end end
					if separated then selected = point; break end
				end
			end
			if selected then break end
		end
		assert(selected, "No safe walkable ground for ore " .. index .. "; no floating resource was created")
		table.insert(points, selected)
	end
	for index, point in points do
		if not self.Progress.OreCollected[index] then self:_resource("Ore", self.Run.Id .. ":Ore:" .. index, index, point) end
	end
end
function Controller:ObserveDamage(beforeHealth, afterHealth)
	if self._destroyed or self.Progress.DropConsidered or self.Run.State ~= "Hunting"
		or not finite(beforeHealth) or not finite(afterHealth) then return false end
	local maxHealth = self.Combat:GetSnapshot().MaxHealth
	if not finite(maxHealth) or maxHealth <= 0 or beforeHealth <= maxHealth * .5 or afterHealth > maxHealth * .5 then return false end
	self.Progress.DropConsidered = true
	if afterHealth <= 0 then self:_publish(); return false end
	self.Progress.DropSpawned = true -- reserve this crossing before geometry or callbacks
	local support = self.Combat:GetSupportPoint()
	if vector(support) then
		for _, offset in {Vector3.new(12, 0, 0), Vector3.new(-12, 0, 0), Vector3.new(0, 0, 12), Vector3.new(0, 0, -12), Vector3.zero} do
			local point = self:_ground(support + offset)
			if point then
				self.Progress.DropPoint = point
				self:_resource("Drop", self.Run.MonsterId .. ":ScaleDrop", 1, point)
				self:_message("Một vảy đã rơi gần mục tiêu. Đến gần và bấm G để nhặt; chưa nhặt thì chưa vào kho.")
				self:_publish(); return true
			end
		end
	end
	-- An unsafe location never produces a floating or automatically granted item.
	self.Progress.DropSpawned = false; self:_publish(); return false
end
function Controller:_carvePoint(root)
	local boxes = self.Combat.Model and self.Combat.Model:FindFirstChild("CombatHitboxes")
	local best, distance
	if boxes then
		for _, name in {"BodyHurtbox", "LeftLegHurtbox", "RightLegHurtbox"} do
			local box = boxes:FindFirstChild(name)
			if box and box:IsA("BasePart") then
				local point = nearest(box, root.Position)
				local d = (root.Position - point).Magnitude
				if d <= REACH and (not distance or d < distance) then best, distance = point, d end
			end
		end
	end
	-- Ground support also permits approaching between the two feet of a large rig.
	local support = self.Combat:GetSupportPoint()
	if vector(support) then
		local point = support + UP * 2.5
		local d = (root.Position - point).Magnitude
		if d <= REACH and (not distance or d < distance) then best = point end
	end
	return best
end
function Controller:_canCarve(now)
	if self.Run.State ~= "Harvest" or self.Run.Result ~= "Defeated" or self.Progress.Carves >= CARVE_LIMIT
		or self.Combat:GetSnapshot().Health > 0 then return nil end
	local character, humanoid, root = self:_actor(now)
	if not character or not self:_standing(humanoid, root) then return nil end
	local point = self:_carvePoint(root)
	if not point or not self:_lineClear(character, root.Position + UP * .5, point) then return nil end
	return character, humanoid, root, point
end
function Controller:_clearAction()
	if self._action and self._action.Connection then self._action.Connection:Disconnect() end
	self._action = nil
end
function Controller:Cancel(reason)
	if self._destroyed then return end
	local active = self._action ~= nil
	self:_clearAction()
	if active and reason == "Damaged" then self:_message("Bị đánh nên đã ngắt mổ; chưa dùng lượt mổ.") end
	self:_publish()
end
function Controller:RequestCarve(now)
	if self._destroyed or self._action or self._committing then return false, "Busy" end
	local character, humanoid, root, point = self:_canCarve(now)
	if not character then return false, "NotAvailable" end
	local action = {Character = character, Humanoid = humanoid, Root = root, Origin = root.Position, Point = point,
		Index = self.Progress.Carves + 1, FinishAt = now + CARVE_SECONDS, LastHealth = humanoid.Health, Damaged = false}
	action.Connection = humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(health)
		if health < action.LastHealth then action.Damaged = true end
		action.LastHealth = health
	end)
	self._action = action; self:_publish()
	return true
end
function Controller:_publish()
	local remaining = 0
	for index = 1, 6 do if not self.Progress.OreCollected[index] then remaining += 1 end end
	set(self.Player, "HuntCarves", self.Progress.Carves)
	set(self.Player, "HuntHarvestAction", if self._action then "Carve" else "")
	set(self.Player, "HuntHarvestEnds", if self._action then self._action.FinishAt else 0)
	set(self.Player, "HuntHarvestDuration", CARVE_SECONDS)
	set(self.Player, "HuntCarveAvailable", self._carveAvailable == true and not self._destroyed and not self._committing)
	set(self.Player, "HuntCarvePoint", if not self._destroyed then self._carvePointPublished else nil)
	set(self.Player, "HuntLootText", self._lootText or "")
	set(self.Player, "HuntOreRemaining", if self._destroyed then 0 else remaining)
	set(self.Player, "HuntDropSpawned", self.Progress.DropSpawned == true)
	set(self.Player, "HuntDropCollected", self.Progress.DropCollected == true)
end
function Controller:Step(now, _dt)
	if self._destroyed then return end
	local health = self.Combat:GetSnapshot().Health
	self:ObserveDamage(self._lastHealth, health); self._lastHealth = health
	local character, humanoid, root, point = self:_canCarve(now)
	self._carveAvailable, self._carvePointPublished = character ~= nil, point
	for _, node in self._nodes do if node.Prompt and node.Prompt.Parent then node.Prompt.Enabled = self:_visit(now) and not node.Collected end end
	local action = self._action
	if action then
		if not character or character ~= action.Character or humanoid ~= action.Humanoid or root ~= action.Root
			or (root.Position - action.Origin).Magnitude > 1.6 or action.Damaged or humanoid.Health < action.LastHealth then
			self:Cancel(if action.Damaged then "Damaged" else "Interrupted")
		elseif now >= action.FinishAt and not self._committing then
			self._committing = true
			local called, granted, result = pcall(self.Grant, "Carve", self.Run.MonsterId, action.Index)
			self._committing = false; self:_clearAction()
			if not self._destroyed and called and granted == true then
				self.Progress.Carves = action.Index
				self._lootText = "Đã mổ " .. action.Index .. "/3 · nguyên liệu vào kho thử của phiên"
				self:_message(self._lootText)
			elseif not self._destroyed then self:_message("Chưa ghi nhận lượt mổ; có thể thử lại cùng lượt, không cấp trùng.") end
		end
	end
	self:_publish()
end
function Controller:GetSnapshot()
	local resources = {}
	for _, node in self._nodes do table.insert(resources, {Kind = node.Kind, Id = node.Id, Index = node.Index, Point = node.Point, Collected = node.Collected}) end
	return {Carves = self.Progress.Carves, Action = if self._action then "Carve" else "", ActionEnds = if self._action then self._action.FinishAt else 0,
		CarveAvailable = self._carveAvailable == true, CarvePoint = self._carvePointPublished,
		DropConsidered = self.Progress.DropConsidered, DropSpawned = self.Progress.DropSpawned, DropCollected = self.Progress.DropCollected, Resources = resources}
end
function Controller:Destroy()
	if self._destroyed then return end
	self:_clearAction(); self._destroyed = true; self._carveAvailable = false
	for _, connection in self._connections do connection:Disconnect() end
	self._connections = {}
	if self._folder then self._folder:Destroy() end
	self:_publish()
end
return Controller

local function createModel(name: string)
	local m = Instance.new("Model")
	m.Name = name
	local origin = CFrame.new()
	local handle: BasePart? = nil

	local function add(className: string, pName: string, size: Vector3, cf: CFrame, color: Color3, mat: Enum.Material?, shape: Enum.PartType?)
		local p = Instance.new(className) :: BasePart
		p.Name = pName
		p.Size = size
		p.Color = color
		p.Material = mat or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		if shape and p:IsA("Part") then
			p.Shape = shape
		end
		p.Anchored = false
		p.CanCollide = false
		p.CanTouch = false
		p.CanQuery = false
		p.Massless = true
		p.CFrame = origin * cf
		p.Parent = m

		if not handle then
			handle = p
			m.PrimaryPart = p
		else
			local w = Instance.new("Weld")
			w.Name = "WeaponProWeld"
			w.Part0 = handle
			w.Part1 = p
			w.C0 = cf
			w.Parent = p
		end
		return p
	end

	local function addTrail(pos0: Vector3, pos1: Vector3, col: Color3)
		if not handle then return end
		local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
		a0.Name = "Trail0"
		a0.Position = pos0
		a0.Parent = handle

		local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
		a1.Name = "Trail1"
		a1.Position = pos1
		a1.Parent = handle

		local tr = Instance.new("Trail")
		tr.Name = "WeaponTrail"
		tr.Attachment0 = a0
		tr.Attachment1 = a1
		tr.Color = ColorSequence.new(col, c(255, 255, 255))
		tr.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, 0.45),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
		})
		tr.Lifetime = 0.22
		tr.LightEmission = 1
		tr.FaceCamera = true
		tr.Enabled = false
		tr.Parent = handle

		local pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		pe.Name = "WeaponSparks"
		pe.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
		pe.Color = ColorSequence.new(col)
		pe.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.16, 0)
		pe.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 1)
		pe.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.4)
		pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(3, 8)
		pe.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(55, 55)
		pe.LightEmission = 1
		pe.Rate = 35
		pe.Enabled = false
		pe.Parent = a1
	end

	return m, add, addTrail
end

function WeaponsBuilder.build(id: string)

-- Server-only test grant. Eligibility never comes from a client attribute.
local Policy = {}
local CODE = "HUNDINO-ADMIN-500"
local USER_ID = 11605296816
local CODE_ID = "AdminTest20261021"

function Policy.Resolve(userId, rawCode)
	if userId ~= USER_ID then return nil, "NotEligible" end
	if type(rawCode) ~= "string" or #rawCode > 64 then return nil, "InvalidCode" end
	local code = rawCode:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"):upper()
	if code ~= CODE then return nil, "InvalidCode" end
	-- A fresh request prevents any caller from changing the configured reward.
	return {Op="RedeemCode", CodeId=CODE_ID, Coins=500,
		Materials={Skin=10, Tooth=10, Scale=10, Bone=10, Iron=10}}

local localPlayer=Players.LocalPlayer
local entries={}

local function update(model,id,main,off,baseCF,started,duration,marks,sequence,now)
	if not main then return end
	local entry=entries[model]
	if not entry or entry.main~=main or entry.off~=off or entry.id~=id then
		if entry then VFX.set(entry.effects,false) end
		local effects=VFX.effects(model)
		local required=if id=="DualDaggers" then 4 else 2
		if #effects<required then entries[model]=nil; return end
		entry={main=main,off=off,id=id,effects=effects,sequence=-1,fired={},enabled=false}
		entries[model]=entry
	end
	entry.seen=true
	if entry.sequence~=sequence then entry.sequence=sequence;entry.fired={} end
	local elapsed=now-started
	local enabled=localPlayer:GetAttribute("ShowComboFX")~=false and started>0 and elapsed>=0 and elapsed<duration
	if entry.enabled~=enabled then VFX.set(entry.effects,enabled);entry.enabled=enabled end
	for i,mark in marks do
		if started>0 and elapsed>=mark and not entry.fired[i] then
			entry.fired[i]=true
			if enabled then
				-- Bow already receives a green Shot tracer towards the actual target.
				if id~="Bow" then VFX.trigger(id,baseCF,i) end
				VFX.burst(entry.effects)
			end
		end
	end
end

local connection=RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	for _,entry in entries do entry.seen=false end
	local pets=workspace:FindFirstChild("TrainingPets")
	if pets then

			local profile=id and Animator.profile(id)

				update(pet,id,pet:FindFirstChild("WeaponR") or pet:FindFirstChild("WeaponL"),
					pet:FindFirstChild("WeaponL"),pet.PrimaryPart.CFrame,pet:GetAttribute("PetAttackStarted") or -1,
					profile.dur,marks,pet:GetAttribute("PetAttackSequence") or 0,now)

	for _,player in Players:GetPlayers() do

		local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			local marks={}

			local interval=weapon:GetAttribute("WeaponAttackHitInterval") or 0.13
			for i=1,weapon:GetAttribute("WeaponAttackHits") or 1 do table.insert(marks,windup+(i-1)*interval) end
			local feet=root.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,-humanoid.HipHeight-root.Size.Y/2,0)

				weapon:GetAttribute("WeaponAttackStarted") or -1,weapon:GetAttribute("WeaponAttackDuration") or 0,
				marks,weapon:GetAttribute("WeaponAttackSequence") or 0,now)
		end
	end
	for model,entry in entries do
		if not entry.seen then VFX.set(entry.effects,false);entries[model]=nil end
	end
end)

local Geometry = require(script.Parent.BioTubeGeometry)
local Specimen = require(script.Parent.BioTubeSpecimen)
local Service = {}
Service.__index = Service
local OFFSETS = {[1]=Vector3.new(-28,0,-10),[2]=Vector3.new(-15,0,0),
	[3]=Vector3.new(15,0,0),[4]=Vector3.new(28,0,-10),[5]=Vector3.new(0,0,5)}
local ANGLES = {[1]=22,[2]=11,[3]=-11,[4]=-22,[5]=0}

function Service.buildWorld()
	local existing=workspace:FindFirstChild("SpecimenTubeDisplays")
	if existing and existing:GetAttribute("GeometryVersion")==Geometry.Version then return existing end
	if existing then existing:Destroy() end
	local world=Instance.new("Folder");world.Name="SpecimenTubeDisplays"
	world:SetAttribute("GeometryVersion",Geometry.Version)
	world:SetAttribute("SystemVersion","P1-F.2")
	local bases=workspace:WaitForChild("DarkJungle"):WaitForChild("Bases")
	for id=1,12 do
		local base=assert(bases:FindFirstChild("Base"..id),"Missing base "..id)
		local spawn=assert(base:FindFirstChild("SpawnPad"),"Missing SpawnPad")
		local shelter=assert(base:FindFirstChild("ShelterFloor"),"Missing existing shelter")
		local origin=Geometry.clusterFrame(spawn.Position,shelter.Position,id)
		local cluster=Instance.new("Model");cluster.Name="Base"..id
		cluster:SetAttribute("BaseId",id);cluster:SetAttribute("ClusterOrigin",origin);cluster.Parent=world
		for slot=1,5 do
			local tube=Geometry.build(cluster,origin*CFrame.new(OFFSETS[slot])*CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(ANGLES[slot]),0),slot)
			tube:SetAttribute("BaseId",id)
		end
	end
	world.Parent=workspace
	return world
end

function Service.new(economy,template)
	local self=setmetatable({Economy=economy,Template=template,World=Service.buildWorld(),Connections={},Players={}},Service)
	for _,cluster in self.World:GetChildren() do
		local id=cluster:GetAttribute("BaseId")
		-- Authored files never contain a player's specimen. Clear any stale local preview.
		for slot=1,5 do
			local tube=cluster:FindFirstChild("BioTube_"..slot)
			local old=tube:FindFirstChild("SpecimenAssembly");if old then old:Destroy() end
			tube:SetAttribute("SpecimenId",nil);tube:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId",nil)
			local prompt=tube.Interaction.SpecimenTubePrompt
			table.insert(self.Connections,prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
				if player:GetAttribute("BaseId")~=id then economy:_notice(player,"Đây là ống nghiệm của base khác.");return end
				if not self:CanUse(player,slot) then economy:_notice(player,"Đến gần ống nghiệm của bạn, cất vũ khí bằng R và dừng động tác.");return end
				economy:Publish(player,nil,"Inventory")
				economy.Remote:FireClient(player,"OpenSpecimenTube",{Slot=slot})
			end))
		end
	end
	return self
end

function Service:CanUse(player,slot)
	if type(slot)~="number" or slot%1~=0 or slot<1 or slot>5 then return false end
	if not self.Economy:_quiet(player) then return false end
	local state=self.Economy.GetState(player)
	local profile=self.Economy:Profile(player)
	if state.InHunting or state.InTraining or not profile or profile.ActiveRun then return false end
	local cluster=self.World:FindFirstChild("Base"..tostring(player:GetAttribute("BaseId")))
	local tube=cluster and cluster:FindFirstChild("BioTube_"..slot)
	return tube~=nil and (state.Root.Position-tube.Interaction.Position).Magnitude<=13
end

function Service:Clear(player)
	local id=self.Players[player];self.Players[player]=nil
	local cluster=id and self.World:FindFirstChild("Base"..id)
	if not cluster or cluster:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId")~=player.UserId then return end
	cluster:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId",nil)
	for _,tube in cluster:GetChildren() do
		local assembly=tube:FindFirstChild("SpecimenAssembly");if assembly then assembly:Destroy() end
		tube:SetAttribute("SpecimenId",nil);tube:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId",nil)
	end
end

function Service:Sync(player,profile)
	local id=player:GetAttribute("BaseId")
	if self.Players[player] and self.Players[player]~=id then self:Clear(player) end
	local cluster=self.World:FindFirstChild("Base"..tostring(id));if not cluster then return end
	self.Players[player]=id;cluster:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId",player.UserId)
	for slot=1,5 do
		local tube=cluster:FindFirstChild("BioTube_"..slot)
		local specimenId=profile.DisplaySlots and profile.DisplaySlots[slot]
		if tube:GetAttribute("SpecimenId")==specimenId and tube:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId")==player.UserId then continue end
		local old=tube:FindFirstChild("SpecimenAssembly");if old then old:Destroy() end
		tube:SetAttribute("SpecimenId",nil);tube:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId",player.UserId)
		local record=specimenId and profile.OwnedSpecimens[specimenId]
		if record then
			local ok,result=pcall(Specimen.mount,tube,self.Template,record)
			if ok then tube:SetAttribute("SpecimenId",specimenId)
			else warn("[BioTubes] Could not mount specimen",id,slot,result) end
		end
	end
end

function Service:Destroy()
	for _,connection in self.Connections do connection:Disconnect() end
	for player in self.Players do self:Clear(player) end
	self.Connections={}
end
return Service

local function flightAction(_, state, input)
	if state == Enum.UserInputState.End or state == Enum.UserInputState.Cancel then
		held[input.KeyCode] = nil
	elseif state == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
		if blocked() then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
		held[input.KeyCode] = true
	end
	return active and not blocked() and Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink or Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
end

local function restoreLocomotion()
	-- PlatformStand and the player attributes can arrive in adjacent replication updates.
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
	local generation = restoreGeneration
	task.defer(function()
		for _ = 1, 20 do
			if destroyed or active or generation ~= restoreGeneration
				or player.Character ~= character or not humanoid.Parent or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
			if player:GetAttribute("AdminFlying") ~= true and not humanoid.PlatformStand then
				humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
				return
			end
			task.wait(0.05)
		end
	end)
end

local function refresh()
	if destroyed then return end
	local shouldFly = allowed() and player:GetAttribute("AdminFlying") == true and alive()
	if active ~= shouldFly then
		active = shouldFly
		clearHeld()
		sendElapsed = 0
		streamElapsed = 0
		restoreGeneration += 1
		ContextActionService:UnbindAction(ACTION)
		if active then
			ContextActionService:BindActionAtPriority(ACTION, flightAction, false, 4000,
				Enum.KeyCode.W, Enum.KeyCode.A, Enum.KeyCode.S, Enum.KeyCode.D,
				Enum.KeyCode.Space, Enum.KeyCode.E, Enum.KeyCode.Q,
				Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl, Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift)
		else
			restoreLocomotion()
		end
	end
	if allowed() then createGui() else destroyGui() end
	updateText()
end

local function watchCharacter(character)
	restoreGeneration += 1
	for _, connection in characterConnections do connection:Disconnect() end
	table.clear(characterConnections)
	zeroInput()
	refresh()
	if not character then return end
	local function watchHumanoid(humanoid)
		if not humanoid:IsA("Humanoid") then return end
		table.insert(characterConnections, humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
			zeroInput()
			refresh()
		end))
	end
	for _, child in character:GetChildren() do watchHumanoid(child) end
	table.insert(characterConnections, character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
		watchHumanoid(child)
		refresh()
	end))
	table.insert(characterConnections, character.ChildRemoved:Connect(refresh))
end

local function direction()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local look = camera and camera.CFrame.LookVector or (root and root.CFrame.LookVector) or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	look = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
	if look.Magnitude < 0.01 then
		look = root and Vector3.new(root.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, root.CFrame.LookVector.Z) or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	end
	if look.Magnitude < 0.01 then look = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
	look = look.Unit
	if blocked() then return ZERO, look, false end
	local right = look:Cross(UP)
	local forward = (held[Enum.KeyCode.W] and 1 or 0) - (held[Enum.KeyCode.S] and 1 or 0)
	local side = (held[Enum.KeyCode.D] and 1 or 0) - (held[Enum.KeyCode.A] and 1 or 0)
	local rise = (held[Enum.KeyCode.Space] or held[Enum.KeyCode.E] or held.TouchUp) and 1 or 0
	local fall = (held[Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl] or held[Enum.KeyCode.Q] or held.TouchDown) and 1 or 0
	local movement = look * forward + right * side + UP * (rise - fall)
	if movement.Magnitude > 1 then movement = movement.Unit end
	return movement, look, held[Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift] == true
end

	sendElapsed += dt
	if sendElapsed < 0.05 then return end

				end)

		end

end)

function Service:RedeemCode(player, rawCode)
	local function reply(ok, code, message)
		if player.Parent then self.Remote:FireClient(player,"CodeResult",{Ok=ok,Code=code,Message=message}) end
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (self.LastCodeRequest[player] or -math.huge) < 1 then
		reply(false,"RateLimited","Hãy chờ một giây rồi nhập lại.");return
	end
	self.LastCodeRequest[player] = now
	local request, failure = AdminRedeem.Resolve(player.UserId, rawCode)
	if not request then
		reply(false,failure,if failure=="NotEligible" then "Mã này chỉ dành cho tài khoản admin thử nghiệm." else "Mã không hợp lệ. Kiểm tra lại code đã nhập.");return
	end
	-- Refuse memory-only fallback: a one-time account grant needs durable storage.
	if not self.Persistence or not self:IsReady(player) or not self:Profile(player) then
		reply(false,"SavePending","Hồ sơ chưa sẵn sàng để lưu. Hãy chờ hoặc thử tải/lưu lại tiến trình.");return
	end
	request.RedeemedAt = os.time()
	local receipt = self:_apply(player, request)
	if receipt.Ok then
		local destination=if self.Persistence.Mode=="LocalFile" then "trên máy" else "vào tài khoản"
		local message = "Đã nhận 500 xu và 10 mỗi loại: da, răng, vảy, xương, sắt. Đã lưu "..destination.."."
		self:Publish(player,message);reply(true,"CodeRedeemed",message)
	else
		local messages = {AlreadyRedeemed="Bạn đã sử dụng mã này; mỗi mã chỉ nhận được một lần.",
			Capacity="Kho đã đạt giới hạn, chưa nhận thưởng và mã chưa được sử dụng.",
			SavePending="Đang chờ xác nhận lưu. Hãy dùng trạng thái lưu để thử lại, rồi kiểm tra kho trước khi nhập lại."}
		reply(false,receipt.Code,messages[receipt.Code] or "Chưa nhận được thưởng. Hãy thử lại khi hồ sơ sẵn sàng.")
	end
end
function Service:Request(player, action, token)
	if type(action)~="string" or #action>40 then return end
	if action=="RedeemCode" then self:RedeemCode(player,token);return end
 if not self:Profile(player) then return end
	local time=os.clock(); if time-(self.LastRequest[player] or -math.huge)<.12 and action~="CarveCancel" then return end
	self.LastRequest[player]=time
	if action=="GetInventory" then
		if actor(self.GetState(player)) then
			local quest=self.GetQuest();if quest then quest:CancelAction(player,"Menu") end
			self:Publish(player)
		end
		return
	end
	if action=="SetDisplaySlot" then
		local payload=token
		if type(payload)~="table" or not self:IsReady(player) then return end
		local profile=self:Profile(player);local offer=self.Offers[player]
		if not offer or type(payload.OperationToken)~="string" or payload.OperationToken~=offer.Token
			or offer.Revision~=profile.Revision or payload.OperationSerial~=profile.OperationSerial+1 then
			self:Publish(player,"Kho vừa cập nhật; hãy chọn lại cá thể.");return
		end
		if not self.BioTubes:CanUse(player,payload.Slot) then
			self:_notice(player,"Đến gần ống nghiệm đích tại base của bạn và cất vũ khí bằng R.");return
		end
		local receipt=self:_apply(player,{Op="SetDisplaySlot",Slot=payload.Slot,SpecimenId=payload.SpecimenId,
			OperationSerial=profile.OperationSerial+1})
		local text=if receipt.Ok then (if payload.SpecimenId then "Đã đặt cá thể vào ống #"..payload.Slot..". Cá thể vẫn được giữ trong kho."
			else "Đã tháo cá thể khỏi ống #"..payload.Slot.."; cá thể vẫn ở trong kho.")
			else "Chưa thể thay đổi ống nghiệm: "..tostring(receipt.Code)
		self:Publish(player,text);self:_notice(player,text);return
	end
	if action=="CarveStart" or action=="CarveCancel" then
		local quest=self.GetQuest(); if quest then quest:HarvestAction(player,action) end; return
	elseif action=="OpenInventory" then self:Open(player,"Inventory"); return
	elseif action=="OpenMerchant" then self:Open(player,"Merchant"); return
	elseif action=="OpenCraft" then self:Open(player,"Craft"); return end
	local operations={MerchantBuyTrap={"Merchant","Buy","RawTrap"},MerchantBuyPotion={"Merchant","Buy","SleepPotion"},
		CraftIronTrap={"Craft","CraftTrap"},UpgradeHammer={"Craft","UpgradeHammer"}}
	local op=operations[action]; if not op then return end
 if not self:IsReady(player) then self:_notice(player,"Đang chờ ghi tiến trình. Hãy thử lại khi trạng thái lưu sẵn sàng.");return end
	local profile=self:Profile(player); local offer=self.Offers[player]
	if type(token)~="string" or #token>64 or not offer or token~=offer.Token or offer.Revision~=profile.Revision then
		self:Publish(player,"Yêu cầu cũ đã hết hiệu lực; kho vừa được cập nhật."); return
	end
	if offer.Context~=op[1] or not self:_context(player,op[1]) then self:_notice(player,"Hãy đến đúng điểm giao dịch và cất vũ khí."); return end
	local receipt=self:_apply(player,{Op=op[2],Item=op[3],OperationSerial=profile.OperationSerial+1})
	local text=if receipt.Ok then (if op[2]=="UpgradeHammer" then "Búa cấp 2: sát thương của bạn tăng 15%." elseif op[2]=="CraftTrap" then "Đã chế tạo 1 bẫy sắt." else "Đã mua 1 vật dụng tiếp tế.") else (ERRORS[receipt.Code] or "Chưa thể giao dịch: "..tostring(receipt.Code))
	self:Publish(player,text); self:_notice(player,text)
end
function Service:_runRequest(player,run,op,extra)

	local p=self:Profile(player); local request={Op=op,RunId=run.Id,RunSerial=run.EconomySerial}
	for key,value in extra or {} do request[key]=value end

	else warn("[P1-E] Transaction rejected",op,receipt.Code); self:_notice(player,"Kho chưa ghi nhận được thao tác: "..tostring(receipt.Code)) end

end
