-- P1-E economy and first P1-F specimen collection in server memory. Runtime supplies trusted source IDs, rolls and
-- physical/context validation. Every accepted change commits with its receipt;
-- this module never yields, touches Instances or writes persistent account data.
local Rules = {}

Rules.Config = table.freeze({
	StarterCoins = 80,
	PurchaseCost = 10,
	MaxCarried = 3,
	OreCount = 6,
	CarveCount = 3,
	BonusCoins = 40,
	UpgradeBones = 2,
	UpgradeIron = 2,
	HammerMultiplier = 1.15,
	MaximumCount = 1000000000,
	MaximumSerial = 2147483647,
	RecentOperations = 64,
	RecentClosedRuns = 8,
	MaxOwnedSpecimens = 100,
	DisplaySlotCount = 5,
	MaximumTimestamp = 253402300799,
})
local C = Rules.Config
local Materials = {"Skin", "Tooth", "Scale", "Bone", "Iron"}
local Items = {"RawTrap", "IronTrap", "SleepPotion"}
local RunStates = {Preparing = true, Hunting = true, Defeated = true, Captured = true, Failed = true}

local function clone(value)
	if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
	local copy = {}
	for key, item in value do copy[key] = clone(item) end
	return copy
end

local function integer(value, maximum)
	return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value >= 0
		and value <= (maximum or C.MaximumCount) and value % 1 == 0
end

local function id(value)
	return type(value) == "string" and #value > 0 and #value <= 128 and not value:find("%c")
end

local function serial(value)
	return integer(value, C.MaximumSerial) and value > 0
end

local function roll(value)
	return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value >= 0 and value < 1
end

local function rejected(code)
	return {Ok = false, Code = code, Replay = false}
end

local function accepted(code, fields)
	local receipt = fields or {}
	receipt.Ok, receipt.Code, receipt.Replay = true, code, false
	return receipt
end

local function replay(receipt)
	local copy = clone(receipt)
	copy.Replay = true
	return copy
end

local function counts(container, keys)
	if type(container) ~= "table" then return false end
	for _, key in keys do if not integer(container[key]) then return false end end
	return true
end

local function guid(value)
	return type(value) == "string" and #value == 36
		and value:match("^%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x$") ~= nil
end

local SpecimenFields = {Id = true, SpeciesId = true, Name = true, Variant = true,
	Element = true, SizeScale = true, CapturedAt = true, SourceRunId = true, SourceMonsterId = true, Serial = true}

local function validSpecimen(record, owned)
	if type(record) ~= "table" or not guid(record.Id) or record.SpeciesId ~= "TRex"
		or record.Name ~= "T-Rex" or record.Variant ~= "Normal" or record.Element ~= "None"
		or record.SizeScale ~= 1 or not integer(record.CapturedAt, C.MaximumTimestamp)
		or not id(record.SourceRunId) or not id(record.SourceMonsterId) then return false end
	if owned then
		if not serial(record.Serial) then return false end
	elseif record.Serial ~= nil then return false end
	for key in record do if not SpecimenFields[key] then return false end end
	return true
end

-- Migration accepts validated, acyclic data, never an unreadable profile that
-- would otherwise fall back to fresh starter money. Receipts are kept intact.
local function plainTree(value, visiting, depth)
	local kind = type(value)
	if kind == "number" then return value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge end
	if kind ~= "table" then return kind == "string" or kind == "boolean" end
	if depth > 12 or visiting[value] then return false end
	visiting[value] = true
	for key, child in value do
		if (type(key) ~= "string" and (type(key) ~= "number" or not integer(key, C.MaximumTimestamp)))
			or not plainTree(child, visiting, depth + 1) then visiting[value] = nil return false end
	end
	visiting[value] = nil
	return true
end

local function validReceipt(receipt)
	return type(receipt) == "table" and receipt.Ok == true and receipt.Replay == false
		and id(receipt.Code) and plainTree(receipt, {}, 0)
end

local function validClaims(claims)
	if type(claims) ~= "table" then return false end
	for key, receipt in claims do
		local known = key == "OpenRun" or key == "StartRun" or key == "Finish" or key == "CloseRun" or key == "Drop"
			or (type(key) == "string" and (key:match("^Ore:[1-6]$") or key:match("^Carve:[1-3]$")))
		if not known or not validReceipt(receipt) then return false end
	end
	return validReceipt(claims.OpenRun)
end

local function validRun(run)
	return type(run) == "table" and id(run.Id) and id(run.MonsterId) and serial(run.Serial)
		and RunStates[run.State] and integer(run.Traps, C.MaxCarried) and integer(run.Potions, C.MaxCarried)
		and integer(run.InitialTraps, C.MaxCarried) and integer(run.InitialPotions, C.MaxCarried)
		and run.Traps <= run.InitialTraps and run.Potions <= run.InitialPotions
		and integer(run.Carves, C.CarveCount) and validClaims(run.Claims)
end

local function validBaseProfile(profile, version)
	if type(profile) ~= "table" or profile.DataVersion ~= version or profile.StarterGranted ~= true
		or profile.StorageMode ~= "ServerMemory"
		or not integer(profile.Revision) or not integer(profile.Coins)
		or not counts(profile.Materials, Materials) or not counts(profile.StoredConsumables, Items)
		or (profile.HammerLevel ~= 1 and profile.HammerLevel ~= 2)
		or not integer(profile.RunSerial, C.MaximumSerial) or not integer(profile.OperationSerial, C.MaximumSerial)
		or type(profile.OperationReceipts) ~= "table" or type(profile.OperationOrder) ~= "table"
		or type(profile.ClosedRuns) ~= "table" or #profile.OperationOrder > C.RecentOperations
		or #profile.ClosedRuns > C.RecentClosedRuns then return false end
	if profile.ActiveRun ~= nil and (not validRun(profile.ActiveRun) or profile.ActiveRun.Serial ~= profile.RunSerial) then return false end
	local operations = {}
	for index, operationSerial in profile.OperationOrder do
		if not serial(index) or index > #profile.OperationOrder or not serial(operationSerial)
			or operationSerial > profile.OperationSerial or operations[operationSerial]
			or not validReceipt(profile.OperationReceipts[operationSerial]) then return false end
		operations[operationSerial] = true
	end
	for operationSerial, receipt in profile.OperationReceipts do
		if not operations[operationSerial] or receipt.OperationSerial ~= operationSerial then return false end
	end
	local closedIds, closedSerials = {}, {}
	for index, run in profile.ClosedRuns do
		if not serial(index) or index > #profile.ClosedRuns or type(run) ~= "table" or not id(run.Id)
			or not serial(run.Serial) or run.Serial > profile.RunSerial or not validClaims(run.Claims)
			or closedIds[run.Id] or closedSerials[run.Serial]
			or (profile.ActiveRun and (run.Id == profile.ActiveRun.Id or run.Serial == profile.ActiveRun.Serial)) then return false end
		closedIds[run.Id], closedSerials[run.Serial] = true, true
	end
	return true
end

local function specimenCount(profile)
	local count = 0
	for _ in profile.OwnedSpecimens do count += 1 end
	return count
end

local function validDisplaySlots(profile)
	if type(profile.DisplaySlots) ~= "table" then return false end
	local displayed = {}
	for slot, specimenId in profile.DisplaySlots do
		if not integer(slot, C.DisplaySlotCount) or slot == 0 or not guid(specimenId)
			or not profile.OwnedSpecimens[specimenId] or displayed[specimenId] then return false end
		displayed[specimenId] = true
	end
	return true
end

local function validProfile(profile)
	if not validBaseProfile(profile, 2) or type(profile.OwnedSpecimens) ~= "table"
		or not integer(profile.SpecimenSerial, C.MaximumSerial)
		or type(profile.RedeemedCodes) ~= "table" then return false end
	-- Permanent code receipts are independent of the bounded purchase ledger.
	for codeId, receipt in profile.RedeemedCodes do
		if not id(codeId) or not validReceipt(receipt) or receipt.Code ~= "CodeRedeemed"
			or receipt.CodeId ~= codeId or not integer(receipt.RedeemedAt, C.MaximumTimestamp)
			or not integer(receipt.Coins) or receipt.Coins == 0
			or not counts(receipt.Materials, Materials) then return false end
		for material, quantity in receipt.Materials do
			if not table.find(Materials, material) or quantity == 0 then return false end
		end
		local allowed = {Ok=true,Code=true,Replay=true,CodeId=true,Coins=true,Materials=true,RedeemedAt=true}
		for field in receipt do if not allowed[field] then return false end end
	end
	local count, serials, sourceRuns, sourceMonsters = 0, {}, {}, {}
	for key, record in profile.OwnedSpecimens do
		if not validSpecimen(record, true) or key ~= record.Id or record.Serial > profile.SpecimenSerial
			or serials[record.Serial] or sourceRuns[record.SourceRunId] or sourceMonsters[record.SourceMonsterId] then return false end
		count += 1
		if count > C.MaxOwnedSpecimens then return false end
		serials[record.Serial], sourceRuns[record.SourceRunId], sourceMonsters[record.SourceMonsterId] = true, true, true
	end
	return validDisplaySlots(profile)
end

function Rules.new(existing)
	if existing ~= nil then
		if type(existing) == "table" and existing.DataVersion == 1 then
			if not validBaseProfile(existing, 1) or not plainTree(existing, {}, 0)
				or existing.OwnedSpecimens ~= nil or existing.SpecimenSerial ~= nil
				or (existing.DisplaySlots ~= nil and (type(existing.DisplaySlots) ~= "table" or next(existing.DisplaySlots) ~= nil)) then return nil, "InvalidProfile" end
			local migrated = clone(existing)
			migrated.DataVersion, migrated.OwnedSpecimens, migrated.SpecimenSerial = 2, {}, 0
			migrated.DisplaySlots = {}
			if migrated.RedeemedCodes == nil then migrated.RedeemedCodes = {} end
			if not validProfile(migrated) then return nil, "InvalidProfile" end
			return migrated
		end
		if not plainTree(existing, {}, 0) then return nil, "InvalidProfile" end
		local normalized = clone(existing)
		if type(normalized) ~= "table" then return nil, "InvalidProfile" end
		-- Existing v2 collections predate tube assignments. Add only the new field.
		if normalized.DisplaySlots == nil then normalized.DisplaySlots = {} end
		if normalized.RedeemedCodes == nil then normalized.RedeemedCodes = {} end
		if not validProfile(normalized) then return nil, "InvalidProfile" end
		return normalized
	end
	return {
		DataVersion = 2, Revision = 0, StarterGranted = true, StorageMode = "ServerMemory",
		Coins = C.StarterCoins, HammerLevel = 1, RunSerial = 0, OperationSerial = 0,
		Materials = {Skin = 0, Tooth = 0, Scale = 0, Bone = 0, Iron = 0},
		StoredConsumables = {RawTrap = 0, IronTrap = 0, SleepPotion = 0},
		OperationReceipts = {}, OperationOrder = {}, ClosedRuns = {},
		OwnedSpecimens = {}, SpecimenSerial = 0, DisplaySlots = {}, RedeemedCodes = {},
	}
end

function Rules.canCapture(profile, runId, runSerial)
	if not validProfile(profile) then return false, "InvalidProfile" end
	if runId ~= nil or runSerial ~= nil then
		if not id(runId) or not serial(runSerial) then return false, "InvalidRun" end
		local run = profile.ActiveRun
		if not run or run.Id ~= runId or run.Serial ~= runSerial then return false, "StaleRun" end
		if run.State ~= "Hunting" then return false, "InvalidState" end
	end
	if specimenCount(profile) >= C.MaxOwnedSpecimens or profile.SpecimenSerial >= C.MaximumSerial then return false, "SpecimenCapacity" end
	return true, "Ready"
end

local function commit(profile, nextProfile, receipt)
	if not validProfile(nextProfile) then return rejected("InvalidResult") end
	if profile.Revision >= C.MaximumCount then return rejected("Capacity") end
	nextProfile.Revision = profile.Revision + 1
	for key in profile do profile[key] = nil end
	for key, value in nextProfile do profile[key] = value end
	return clone(receipt)
end

local function add(container, key, quantity)
	if not integer(quantity) or not integer(container[key]) or container[key] + quantity > C.MaximumCount then return false end
	container[key] += quantity
	return true
end

local function typeFor(sample)
	if not roll(sample) then return nil end
	if sample < 0.5 then return "Skin" end
	if sample < 0.75 then return "Tooth" end
	return "Scale"
end

local function sync(run, request)
	if request.Traps == nil and request.Potions == nil then return true end
	if not integer(request.Traps, C.MaxCarried) or not integer(request.Potions, C.MaxCarried)
		or request.Traps > run.Traps or request.Potions > run.Potions then return false end
	run.Traps, run.Potions = request.Traps, request.Potions
	return true
end

local function currentRun(profile, request)
	if not id(request.RunId) or not serial(request.RunSerial) then return nil, "InvalidRun" end
	local run = profile.ActiveRun
	if run and run.Id == request.RunId and run.Serial == request.RunSerial then return run end
	return nil, "StaleRun"
end

local function closedRun(profile, request)
	for _, record in profile.ClosedRuns do
		if record.Id == request.RunId and record.Serial == request.RunSerial then return record end
	end
	return nil
end

local function requestKey(request)
	if request.Op == "Ore" and integer(request.Index, C.OreCount) and request.Index > 0 then return "Ore:" .. request.Index end
	if request.Op == "Carve" and integer(request.Index, C.CarveCount) and request.Index > 0 then return "Carve:" .. request.Index end
	if request.Op == "Drop" or request.Op == "StartRun" or request.Op == "Finish" or request.Op == "CloseRun" then return request.Op end
	return nil
end

local function runTransaction(profile, request)
	local run, failure = currentRun(profile, request)
	local key = requestKey(request)
	if not run then
		local closed = closedRun(profile, request)
		if closed and key and closed.Claims[key] then return replay(closed.Claims[key]) end
		return rejected(failure)
	end
	if key and run.Claims[key] then return replay(run.Claims[key]) end
	local nextProfile = clone(profile)
	local nextRun = nextProfile.ActiveRun
	local receipt
	if request.Op == "StartRun" then
		if run.State ~= "Preparing" then return rejected("InvalidState") end
		nextRun.State = "Hunting"
		receipt = accepted("Started", {RunId = run.Id, RunSerial = run.Serial})
	elseif request.Op == "SyncItems" then
		if run.State == "Preparing" then return rejected("InvalidState") end
		if not sync(nextRun, request) or request.Traps == nil then return rejected("InvalidRemaining") end
		if nextRun.Traps == run.Traps and nextRun.Potions == run.Potions then
			return accepted("Synced", {Traps = run.Traps, Potions = run.Potions, Unchanged = true})
		end
		receipt = accepted("Synced", {Traps = nextRun.Traps, Potions = nextRun.Potions})
	elseif request.Op == "Finish" then
		if run.State ~= "Hunting" then return rejected("InvalidState") end
		if request.Result ~= "Defeated" and request.Result ~= "Captured" and request.Result ~= "Failed" then return rejected("InvalidOutcome") end
		if not sync(nextRun, request) then return rejected("InvalidRemaining") end
		local rewards, capturedSpecimen = {}, nil
		if request.Result == "Captured" then
			if nextRun.InitialTraps - nextRun.Traps < 1 or nextRun.InitialPotions - nextRun.Potions < 1 then return rejected("CaptureItemsMissing") end
			if type(request.Rolls) ~= "table" or #request.Rolls ~= 3 then return rejected("InvalidRolls") end
			if not validSpecimen(request.Specimen, false) or request.Specimen.SourceRunId ~= run.Id
				or request.Specimen.SourceMonsterId ~= run.MonsterId then return rejected("InvalidSpecimen") end
			for specimenId, specimen in profile.OwnedSpecimens do
				if specimenId == request.Specimen.Id or specimen.SourceRunId == run.Id
					or specimen.SourceMonsterId == run.MonsterId then return rejected("DuplicateSpecimen") end
			end
			local available, capacityCode = Rules.canCapture(profile, run.Id, run.Serial)
			if not available then return rejected(capacityCode) end
			for index = 1, 3 do
				local sample = request.Rolls[index]
				if type(sample) ~= "table" or not roll(sample.QuantityRoll) then return rejected("InvalidRolls") end
				local material = typeFor(sample.TypeRoll)
				if not material then return rejected("InvalidRolls") end
				local quantity = if sample.QuantityRoll < 0.5 then 1 else 2
				if not add(nextProfile.Materials, material, quantity) then return rejected("Capacity") end
				table.insert(rewards, {Material = material, Quantity = quantity})
			end
			nextProfile.SpecimenSerial += 1
			capturedSpecimen = clone(request.Specimen)
			capturedSpecimen.Serial = nextProfile.SpecimenSerial
			nextProfile.OwnedSpecimens[capturedSpecimen.Id] = capturedSpecimen
		end
		if request.Result ~= "Failed" then
			if not add(nextProfile.Materials, "Bone", 1) or nextProfile.Coins + C.BonusCoins > C.MaximumCount then return rejected("Capacity") end
			nextProfile.Coins += C.BonusCoins
		end
		nextRun.State = request.Result
		nextRun.Result = request.Result
		receipt = accepted("Finished", {Result = request.Result, Rewards = rewards,
			BonusBone = if request.Result == "Failed" then 0 else 1,
			BonusCoins = if request.Result == "Failed" then 0 else C.BonusCoins,
			SpecimenId = if capturedSpecimen then capturedSpecimen.Id else nil,
			Specimen = if capturedSpecimen then clone(capturedSpecimen) else nil,
			Traps = nextRun.Traps, Potions = nextRun.Potions, RunId = run.Id, RunSerial = run.Serial})
	elseif request.Op == "Ore" or request.Op == "Drop" then
		if run.State ~= "Hunting" and run.State ~= "Defeated" and run.State ~= "Captured" then return rejected("InvalidState") end
		if not key then return rejected("InvalidIndex") end
		local material = if request.Op == "Ore" then "Iron" else "Scale"
		if not add(nextProfile.Materials, material, 1) then return rejected("Capacity") end
		receipt = accepted("PickupGranted", {Material = material, Quantity = 1, Source = key, RunId = run.Id, RunSerial = run.Serial})
	elseif request.Op == "Carve" then
		if run.State ~= "Defeated" then return rejected("InvalidState") end
		if not key or request.Index ~= run.Carves + 1 then return rejected("InvalidIndex") end
		local material = typeFor(request.TypeRoll)
		if not material then return rejected("InvalidRolls") end
		if not add(nextProfile.Materials, material, 1) then return rejected("Capacity") end
		nextRun.Carves += 1
		receipt = accepted("CarveGranted", {Material = material, Quantity = 1, Index = request.Index, RunId = run.Id, RunSerial = run.Serial})
	elseif request.Op == "CloseRun" then
		if request.EntryFailed ~= nil and type(request.EntryFailed) ~= "boolean" then return rejected("InvalidEntryFailure") end
		if request.EntryFailed == true then
			if run.State ~= "Preparing" then return rejected("InvalidState") end
			nextRun.Traps, nextRun.Potions = run.InitialTraps, run.InitialPotions
			nextRun.Result = "EntryFailed"
		else
			if run.State == "Preparing" then return rejected("InvalidState") end
			if not sync(nextRun, request) then return rejected("InvalidRemaining") end
			if run.State == "Hunting" then nextRun.State, nextRun.Result = "Failed", "Failed" end
		end
		if not add(nextProfile.StoredConsumables, "IronTrap", nextRun.Traps)
			or not add(nextProfile.StoredConsumables, "SleepPotion", nextRun.Potions) then return rejected("Capacity") end
		receipt = accepted("Closed", {Result = nextRun.Result, ReturnedTraps = nextRun.Traps,
			ReturnedPotions = nextRun.Potions, RunId = run.Id, RunSerial = run.Serial})
		nextRun.Claims[key] = clone(receipt)
		table.insert(nextProfile.ClosedRuns, {Id = nextRun.Id, Serial = nextRun.Serial, Claims = nextRun.Claims})
		while #nextProfile.ClosedRuns > C.RecentClosedRuns do table.remove(nextProfile.ClosedRuns, 1) end
		nextProfile.ActiveRun = nil
		return commit(profile, nextProfile, receipt)
	else
		return rejected("InvalidOperation")
	end
	if key then nextRun.Claims[key] = clone(receipt) end
	return commit(profile, nextProfile, receipt)
end

local function baseTransaction(profile, request)
	if not serial(request.OperationSerial) then return rejected("InvalidSerial") end
	local cached = profile.OperationReceipts[request.OperationSerial]
	if cached then return replay(cached) end
	if request.OperationSerial ~= profile.OperationSerial + 1 then return rejected("StaleOperation") end
	if profile.ActiveRun then return rejected("ActiveRun") end
	if request.Quantity ~= nil and request.Quantity ~= 1 then return rejected("InvalidQuantity") end
	local nextProfile, receipt = clone(profile)
	if request.Op == "Buy" then
		if request.Item ~= "RawTrap" and request.Item ~= "SleepPotion" then return rejected("InvalidItem") end
		if profile.Coins < C.PurchaseCost then return rejected("InsufficientCoins") end
		if not add(nextProfile.StoredConsumables, request.Item, 1) then return rejected("Capacity") end
		nextProfile.Coins -= C.PurchaseCost
		receipt = accepted("Purchased", {Item = request.Item, Quantity = 1, Cost = C.PurchaseCost})
	elseif request.Op == "CraftTrap" then
		if profile.StoredConsumables.RawTrap < 1 or profile.Materials.Iron < 1 then return rejected("InsufficientMaterials") end
		if not add(nextProfile.StoredConsumables, "IronTrap", 1) then return rejected("Capacity") end
		nextProfile.StoredConsumables.RawTrap -= 1
		nextProfile.Materials.Iron -= 1
		receipt = accepted("Crafted", {Item = "IronTrap", Quantity = 1})
	elseif request.Op == "UpgradeHammer" then
		if profile.HammerLevel ~= 1 then return rejected("MaximumLevel") end
		if profile.Materials.Bone < C.UpgradeBones or profile.Materials.Iron < C.UpgradeIron then return rejected("InsufficientMaterials") end
		nextProfile.Materials.Bone -= C.UpgradeBones
		nextProfile.Materials.Iron -= C.UpgradeIron
		nextProfile.HammerLevel = 2
		receipt = accepted("Upgraded", {HammerLevel = 2, DamageMultiplier = C.HammerMultiplier})
	elseif request.Op == "SetDisplaySlot" then
		if not integer(request.Slot, C.DisplaySlotCount) or request.Slot == 0 then return rejected("InvalidDisplaySlot") end
		local specimenId = request.SpecimenId
		if specimenId ~= false and specimenId ~= nil then
			if not guid(specimenId) then return rejected("InvalidSpecimenId") end
			if not profile.OwnedSpecimens[specimenId] then return rejected("SpecimenNotOwned") end
		end
		local previous, movedFrom = profile.DisplaySlots[request.Slot], nil
		if specimenId then
			for slot, currentId in nextProfile.DisplaySlots do
				if currentId == specimenId and slot ~= request.Slot then
					nextProfile.DisplaySlots[slot], movedFrom = nil, slot
				end
			end
		end
		nextProfile.DisplaySlots[request.Slot] = specimenId or nil
		receipt = accepted("DisplaySlotChanged", {Slot=request.Slot, SpecimenId=specimenId or nil,
			PreviousSpecimenId=previous, MovedFrom=movedFrom})
	else
		return rejected("InvalidOperation")
	end
	nextProfile.OperationSerial = request.OperationSerial
	receipt.OperationSerial = request.OperationSerial
	nextProfile.OperationReceipts[request.OperationSerial] = clone(receipt)
	table.insert(nextProfile.OperationOrder, request.OperationSerial)
	while #nextProfile.OperationOrder > C.RecentOperations do
		local oldest = table.remove(nextProfile.OperationOrder, 1)
		nextProfile.OperationReceipts[oldest] = nil
	end
	return commit(profile, nextProfile, receipt)
end

function Rules.apply(profile, request)
	if not validProfile(profile) then return rejected("InvalidProfile") end
	if type(request) ~= "table" or type(request.Op) ~= "string" then return rejected("InvalidRequest") end
	if request.Op == "RedeemCode" then
		if not id(request.CodeId) or not integer(request.RedeemedAt, C.MaximumTimestamp)
			or not integer(request.Coins) or request.Coins == 0
			or not counts(request.Materials, Materials) then return rejected("InvalidGrant") end
		for material, quantity in request.Materials do
			if not table.find(Materials, material) or quantity == 0 then return rejected("InvalidGrant") end
		end
		if profile.RedeemedCodes[request.CodeId] then return rejected("AlreadyRedeemed") end
		local nextProfile = clone(profile)
		if nextProfile.Coins + request.Coins > C.MaximumCount then return rejected("Capacity") end
		nextProfile.Coins += request.Coins
		for _, material in Materials do
			if not add(nextProfile.Materials, material, request.Materials[material]) then return rejected("Capacity") end
		end
		local receipt = accepted("CodeRedeemed", {CodeId=request.CodeId, Coins=request.Coins,
			Materials=clone(request.Materials), RedeemedAt=request.RedeemedAt})
		nextProfile.RedeemedCodes[request.CodeId] = clone(receipt)
		return commit(profile, nextProfile, receipt)
	end
	if request.Op == "OpenRun" then
		if not id(request.RunId) or not id(request.MonsterId) or not serial(request.RunSerial) then return rejected("InvalidRun") end
		if profile.ActiveRun and profile.ActiveRun.Id == request.RunId and profile.ActiveRun.Serial == request.RunSerial then
			return replay(profile.ActiveRun.Claims.OpenRun)
		end
		local old = closedRun(profile, request)
		if old and old.Claims.OpenRun then return replay(old.Claims.OpenRun) end
		if profile.ActiveRun then return rejected("ActiveRun") end
		if request.RunSerial ~= profile.RunSerial + 1 then return rejected("StaleRun") end
		local nextProfile = clone(profile)
		local traps = math.min(C.MaxCarried, profile.StoredConsumables.IronTrap)
		local potions = math.min(C.MaxCarried, profile.StoredConsumables.SleepPotion)
		nextProfile.StoredConsumables.IronTrap -= traps
		nextProfile.StoredConsumables.SleepPotion -= potions
		nextProfile.RunSerial = request.RunSerial
		local receipt = accepted("Opened", {RunId = request.RunId, MonsterId = request.MonsterId,
			RunSerial = request.RunSerial, Traps = traps, Potions = potions})
		nextProfile.ActiveRun = {Id = request.RunId, MonsterId = request.MonsterId, Serial = request.RunSerial,
			State = "Preparing", Traps = traps, Potions = potions, InitialTraps = traps, InitialPotions = potions,
			Carves = 0, Claims = {OpenRun = clone(receipt)}}
		return commit(profile, nextProfile, receipt)
	end
	if request.Op == "Buy" or request.Op == "CraftTrap" or request.Op == "UpgradeHammer" or request.Op == "SetDisplaySlot" then
		return baseTransaction(profile, request)
	end
	return runTransaction(profile, request)
end

function Rules.snapshot(profile)
	if not validProfile(profile) then return nil end
	local active = profile.ActiveRun
	return {DataVersion = profile.DataVersion, Revision = profile.Revision, StarterGranted = profile.StarterGranted,
		StorageMode = "ServerMemory", Coins = profile.Coins, Materials = clone(profile.Materials),
		StoredConsumables = clone(profile.StoredConsumables), HammerLevel = profile.HammerLevel,
		RunSerial = profile.RunSerial, OperationSerial = profile.OperationSerial,
		OwnedSpecimens = clone(profile.OwnedSpecimens), SpecimenSerial = profile.SpecimenSerial,
		DisplaySlots = clone(profile.DisplaySlots), DisplaySlotCount = C.DisplaySlotCount,
		SpecimenCount = specimenCount(profile), SpecimenLimit = C.MaxOwnedSpecimens,
		ActiveRun = if active then {Id = active.Id, MonsterId = active.MonsterId, Serial = active.Serial,
			State = active.State, Result = active.Result, Traps = active.Traps, Potions = active.Potions,
			InitialTraps = active.InitialTraps, InitialPotions = active.InitialPotions, Carves = active.Carves} else nil}
end

function Rules.damageMultiplier(profile)
	if not validProfile(profile) then return nil end
	return if profile.HammerLevel == 2 then C.HammerMultiplier else 1
end

return Rules

local function weaponPose(s)
	if not s.Grip or not s.Grip.Parent then return end
	local torso = s.Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or s.Character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or s.Root
	local left = s.Character:FindFirstChild("LeftHand") or s.Character:FindFirstChild("Left Arm") or torso
	local right = s.Character:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or s.Character:FindFirstChild("Right Arm") or torso
	if s.Drawn then
		s.Grip.Part0 = if s.WeaponId == "Bow" then left else right
		s.RestPose = if s.WeaponId == "Bow" then CFrame.new(0, .1, -.5) * CFrame.Angles(0, -math.pi/2, 0)
			else CFrame.new(0, -.5, -.5) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-25), 0, math.rad(10))
	else
		s.Grip.Part0 = torso
		s.RestPose = CFrame.new(.5, -1, 1) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-30))
	end
	s.Grip.C0 = s.RestPose
	if s.OffGrip then
		s.OffGrip.Part0 = if s.Drawn then left else torso
		s.OffRest = if s.Drawn then CFrame.new(0, -.3, -.35) else CFrame.new(-.7, -.7, 1.3)
		s.OffGrip.C0 = if s.Blocking then CFrame.new(.5,.5,-1) * CFrame.Angles(0,-.3,0) else s.OffRest
	end
	if s.SheathGrip then s.SheathGrip.Part0 = torso; s.SheathGrip.C0 = CFrame.new(.5,-1,1.04)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(-30)) end
end

local function createWeapon(s)
	if s.WeaponModel then s.WeaponModel:Destroy() end
	s.OffGrip = nil; s.SheathGrip = nil
	local model = weaponTemplates[s.WeaponId]:Clone(); model.Name = "TrainingWeapon"
	for _, assembly in model:GetChildren() do
		local handle = assembly.PrimaryPart
		for _, p in assembly:GetChildren() do
			if p:IsA("BasePart") then
				p.Anchored = false; p.CanCollide = false; p.CanQuery = false; p.Massless = true
				if p ~= handle and not p:FindFirstChild("KatanaWeld") and not p:FindFirstChild("WeaponProWeld") then weld(handle,p,handle.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame)) end
			end
		end
		local grip = weld(s.Root,handle,CFrame.new())
		if assembly.Name == "Main" then s.Grip = grip elseif assembly.Name == "Offhand" then s.OffGrip = grip else s.SheathGrip = grip end
	end
	model.Parent = s.Character; s.WeaponModel = model; weaponPose(s)
end

local function updateDummy(dummy)

local function hit(s, dummy, damage, isPet)
	if not dummy:IsDescendantOf(dummies) then return end
	local hp = dummy:GetAttribute("Health")
	local applied = math.min(hp, damage)
	hp -= applied
	if isPet then s.PetDamage += applied else s.Damage += applied end
	-- Đây là hình nộm vô hạn, làm đầy lại khi bị hạ; không phát thưởng.
	dummy:SetAttribute("Health", if hp <= 0 then Config.DummyHealth else hp)
	updateDummy(dummy)
	remote:FireAllClients("Hit", dummy.Target.Position, applied, isPet)
	sync(s)
end
local function directionOK(v, ranged)
	return typeof(v) == "Vector3" and v.X == v.X and v.Y == v.Y and v.Z == v.Z
		and math.abs(v.X) < 2 and math.abs(v.Z) < 2 and math.abs(v.Y) < (if ranged then 2 else .01) and v.Magnitude > 0.5
end
local function lineOfSight(s, pos, dummy)
	local params = RaycastParams.new(); params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {s.Character, pets}
	local result = workspace:Raycast(s.Root.Position, pos - s.Root.Position, params)
	return not result or result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(dummy)
end
local function startPetAttack(s, target)
	local animator = s.PetAnimator
	if not animator or animator:IsAttacking() then return end
	s.PetTarget = target
	local count = animator:GetHitCount()
	animator.OnHit = function(index)
		if not alive(s) or states[s.Player] ~= s or not s.InTraining or s.PetTarget ~= target
			or s.LastTarget ~= target or not target:IsDescendantOf(dummies)
			or os.clock() >= (s.TargetUntil or 0) then return end
		local point = target.Target.Position
		local center = s.Pet.PrimaryPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {s.Character, pets}
		local obstruction = workspace:Raycast(center, point - center, params)
		if (center - point).Magnitude > 7 or (s.Root.Position - point).Magnitude >= 18
			or (obstruction and not obstruction.Instance:IsDescendantOf(target)) then return end
		-- Split the original total damage across the two dagger strikes.
		local amount = math.floor(Config.PetDamage / count)
			+ (if index <= Config.PetDamage % count then 1 else 0)
		hit(s, target, amount, true)
		if s.PetWeaponId == "Bow" then remote:FireAllClients("Shot", center, point, false) end
	end
	if animator:Attack() then
		s.PetClock = os.clock() + Config.PetInterval
		s.Pet:SetAttribute("PetAttackStarted", workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
		s.Pet:SetAttribute("PetAttackSequence", s.Pet:GetAttribute("PetAttackSequence") + 1)
	end
end
local function attack(s, action, direction, releasedKind, releasedSpec)
	local weapon=Weapons[s.WeaponId]
	if not (s.InTraining or s.InHunting) or not directionOK(direction,weapon.Ranged) then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	local kind,spec=releasedKind,releasedSpec
	if not kind then kind,spec=Rules.attack(Config,Weapons,s,action,now) end
	if not kind then return end
	local attackDamage=spec.Damage*(if s.WeaponId=="Hammer" and economy then economy:DamageMultiplier(s.Player) else 1)
	direction = direction.Unit
	local flat=Vector3.new(direction.X,0,direction.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude>.01 then s.Root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(s.Root.Position, s.Root.Position + flat) end
	s.Humanoid.AutoRotate = false
	local character = s.Character
	local boosted=weapon.Ranged and now<s.BowBoostUntil
	if weapon.Ranged then s.BowBoostUntil=0 end
	s.WeaponModel:SetAttribute("WeaponAttackStarted", workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
	s.WeaponModel:SetAttribute("WeaponAttackDuration", spec.Duration)
	s.WeaponModel:SetAttribute("WeaponAttackWindup", spec.Windup)
	s.WeaponModel:SetAttribute("WeaponAttackHits", (if weapon.Ranged then spec.Shots else spec.Hits) or 1)
	s.WeaponModel:SetAttribute("WeaponAttackHitInterval", (if weapon.Ranged then spec.ShotInterval else spec.HitInterval) or (if weapon.Ranged then (if s.InHunting then .09 else 0) else 0.13))
	s.WeaponModel:SetAttribute("WeaponAttackSequence", (s.WeaponModel:GetAttribute("WeaponAttackSequence") or 0) + 1)
	remote:FireClient(s.Player, "Attack", kind, spec.Name, spec.Duration)
	-- A serial prevents a late recovery callback from overwriting the next strike.
	s.AttackSerial=(s.AttackSerial or 0)+1; local serial=s.AttackSerial
	local attackToken=tostring(s.Player.UserId)..":"..string.format("%.6f",workspace:GetServerTimeNow())..":"..serial
	local function forestHit(applied,point)
		if applied>0 then
			s.HuntEngagedUntil = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + 25
			s.Player:SetAttribute("HuntingDamage",(s.Player:GetAttribute("HuntingDamage") or 0)+applied)
			remote:FireAllClients("Hit",point,applied,false)
		end
	end
	local windup = s.RestPose * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(100), 0, math.rad(-30))
	if spec.Style=="Thrust" then windup=s.RestPose*CFrame.new(0,0,.7)*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2,0,0)
	elseif spec.Style=="Spin" or spec.Style=="Sweep" then windup=s.RestPose*CFrame.Angles(0,-1.4,math.pi/2) end
	if weapon.Ranged then windup=s.RestPose*CFrame.new(0,0,.25) end
	TweenService:Create(s.Grip, TweenInfo.new(spec.Windup), {C0 = windup}):Play()
	task.delay(spec.Windup, function()
		if not alive(s) or s.Character ~= character or states[s.Player] ~= s or s.AttackSerial~=serial then return end
		if weapon.Ranged then
			TweenService:Create(s.Grip,TweenInfo.new(.16),{C0=s.RestPose}):Play()
			local params=RaycastParams.new(); params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances={s.Character,pets}
			for i=1,spec.Shots or 1 do
				if i>1 and (spec.ShotInterval or s.InHunting) then task.wait(spec.ShotInterval or .09) end
				if not alive(s) or s.Character~=character or states[s.Player]~=s or s.AttackSerial~=serial then return end
				local origin=s.Root.Position+Vector3.new(0,.8,0)
				local angle=math.rad(math.ceil((i-1)/2)*(if i%2==0 then -1 else 1)*(spec.Spread or 4))
				local aim=CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.yAxis,angle):VectorToWorldSpace(direction)
				local result=workspace:Raycast(origin,aim*spec.Range,params)
				local endpoint=if result then result.Position else origin+aim*spec.Range
				remote:FireAllClients("Shot",origin,endpoint,boosted and i==1)
				if result then
					if s.InHunting and dinosaurCombat:FromRayHit(result.Instance) then
						local amount=math.floor(spec.Damage*(if boosted and i==1 then 1.25 else 1)+.5)
						if dinosaurCombat:CanHit(s.Player,result.Position,spec.Range+2) then
							forestHit(dinosaurCombat:Damage(s.Player,amount,result.Position,attackToken..":arrow:"..i),result.Position)
						end
					end
					for _,dummy in dummies:GetChildren() do if s.InTraining and result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(dummy) then
						hit(s,dummy,math.floor(spec.Damage*(if boosted and i==1 then 1.25 else 1)+.5),false); s.LastTarget=dummy; s.TargetUntil=os.clock()+12
						break
					end end
				end
			end
			return
		end
		for n=1,spec.Hits or 1 do
			if n>1 then task.wait(spec.HitInterval or .13) end
			if not alive(s) or s.Character~=character or states[s.Player]~=s or s.AttackSerial~=serial then return end
			local pose=s.RestPose*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-95),0,if n%2==0 then -.4 else .4)
			if spec.Style=="Thrust" then pose=s.RestPose*CFrame.new(0,0,-2)*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2,0,0)
			elseif spec.Style=="Spin" or spec.Style=="Sweep" then pose=s.RestPose*CFrame.Angles(0,if n%2==0 then -1.5 else 1.5,math.pi/2) end
			TweenService:Create(s.Grip, TweenInfo.new(.1), {C0=pose}):Play()
			if spec.Style=="Shield" and s.OffGrip then TweenService:Create(s.OffGrip,TweenInfo.new(.1),{C0=s.OffRest*CFrame.new(.4,.3,-1.2)}):Play() end
			if spec.Name then remote:FireAllClients("ComboFX",s.Root.CFrame,spec.Style,spec.Range) end
			if s.OffGrip and s.WeaponId=="DualDaggers" then TweenService:Create(s.OffGrip,TweenInfo.new(.1),{C0=s.OffRest*CFrame.Angles(-1.5,0,if n%2==0 then .4 else -.4)}):Play() end
			if s.InHunting then
				local applied,point=dinosaurCombat:MeleeStrike(s.Player,s.Root.Position+Vector3.new(0,.8,0),direction,
					spec.Range,spec.Arc or .3,attackDamage,attackToken..":melee:"..n)
				if applied>0 then forestHit(applied,point) end
			end
			for _, dummy in dummies:GetChildren() do
				local delta = dummy.Target.Position - s.Root.Position
				local targetFlat = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z)
				if s.InTraining and delta.Magnitude <= spec.Range and targetFlat.Magnitude > 0 and direction:Dot(targetFlat.Unit) >= (spec.Arc or .3)
					and lineOfSight(s, dummy.Target.Position, dummy) then
					hit(s, dummy, attackDamage, false); s.LastTarget = dummy; s.TargetUntil = now + 12
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	task.delay(spec.Duration, function()
		if states[s.Player] ~= s or not alive(s) or s.Character ~= character or s.AttackSerial~=serial then return end

local accumulator = 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	accumulator += dt; if accumulator < 0.1 then return end
	local petAnimationDt = accumulator
	dt = math.min(accumulator, 0.25); accumulator = 0
	local now = os.clock()
	quests:Step(dt)
	for _,player in hunting:Expired() do
		local s=states[player]
		if alive(s) and s.InHunting and not s.Travelling and not quests:OwnsVisit(player) then
			task.spawn(travel,s,"Lobby",nil,"Hết thời gian thám hiểm thung lũng. Đã trở về sảnh cùng Pet.",true)
		end
	end
	for _, s in states do
		if not alive(s) then continue end
		if s.InHunting and not s.Travelling and s.Player:GetAttribute("AdminFlying")~=true and hunting:IsOutside(s.Root.Position) then
			if quests:OwnsVisit(s.Player) then
				task.spawn(travel,s,"Hunting",nil,"Đã đưa bạn về trại; đồng hồ và tiến độ săn được giữ nguyên.",true)
			else task.spawn(travel,s,"Lobby",nil,"Đã đưa bạn và Pet về sảnh an toàn.",true) end
		end
		if s.Charge and now-s.Charge.Started>=s.Charge.MaxHold then releaseCharge(s,s.Charge.Direction) end
		if s.ChangeDraw ~= nil and now >= s.BusyUntil then
			s.Drawn = s.ChangeDraw; s.ChangeDraw = nil; weaponPose(s)
		end
		if s.WantSprint and s.Drawn and now >= s.BusyUntil then toggleDraw(s, false) end
		s.Sprinting = s.WantSprint and not s.Drawn and now >= s.BusyUntil and s.Stamina > 0
			and s.Humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.1
		if s.Sprinting then
			s.Stamina = math.max(0, s.Stamina - Rules.staminaCost(Config,Config.SprintCost) * dt); s.LastSpend = now
			if s.Stamina == 0 then s.WantSprint = false; s.Sprinting = false end
		end
		if s.Blocking then
			s.Stamina=math.max(0,s.Stamina-Rules.staminaCost(Config,Config.GuardCost)*dt); s.LastSpend=now
			if s.Stamina==0 then s.Blocking=false; weaponPose(s) end
		end
		Rules.regenerate(Config, s, now, dt)
		s.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = if s.Blocking then 6 elseif now < (s.DodgingUntil or 0) then Config.WalkSpeed elseif now < s.BusyUntil then 8 elseif s.Sprinting then Config.SprintSpeed else Config.WalkSpeed
		local companionHandled = s.Companion and s.Companion:Step(workspace:GetServerTimeNow(),dt)
		if companionHandled then s.PetAnimator:Update(petAnimationDt);sync(s);continue end
		if s.Player:GetAttribute("AdminFlying")==true then
			s.Pet:SetAttribute("PetMoving",false);s.PetAnimator:Update(petAnimationDt);sync(s);continue
		end
		-- Standing pet: move the feet along the collision surface.
		local target = s.LastTarget
		local active = s.InTraining and target and now < s.TargetUntil
			and (target.Target.Position - s.Root.Position).Magnitude < 18
		local desired = if active then target.Target.Position + Vector3.new(3, 0, 3)
			else s.Root.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(3, 0, 4))
		local petPos = s.Pet.PrimaryPart.Position
		local flat = Vector3.new(desired.X - petPos.X, 0, desired.Z - petPos.Z)
		local step = flat * math.min(1, 18 * dt / math.max(flat.Magnitude, 0.01))
		local filter = RaycastParams.new()
		filter.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		filter.FilterDescendantsInstances = {s.Character, pets}
		filter.RespectCanCollide = true
		local moved = false
		if flat.Magnitude > 0.2 and not workspace:Raycast(petPos + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0), step, filter) then
			local newPos = PetPlacement.position(s.Character, petPos + step, pets)
			s.Pet:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(newPos, newPos + flat))
			moved = true
		elseif active then
			local aim = target.Target.Position - petPos
			aim = Vector3.new(aim.X, 0, aim.Z)
			if aim.Magnitude > 0.1 then s.Pet:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(petPos, petPos + aim)) end
		end
		s.Pet:SetAttribute("PetMoving", moved)
		s.Pet:SetAttribute("PetSpeed", 1.3)
		if active and (s.Pet.PrimaryPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0) - target.Target.Position).Magnitude <= 7
			and now >= s.PetClock and lineOfSight(s, target.Target.Position, target) then
			startPetAttack(s, target)
		end
		s.PetAnimator:Update(petAnimationDt)
		sync(s)
	end
end)

local function healAvailability(now)
	local hum = humanoid()
	if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return false, "Chờ hồi sinh" end
	if player:GetAttribute("AdminFlying") == true then return false, "Đang bay · Pet tạm nghỉ" end
	if player:GetAttribute("InHunting") ~= true and player:GetAttribute("InTraining") ~= true then
		return false, "Dùng tại bãi tập hoặc khu săn"
	end
	if numberAttribute("PetMaxHealth", 0) <= 0 then return false, "Đang chờ Pet" end
	local stunned = numberAttribute("PetStunnedUntil", 0) - now
	if stunned > 0 or player:GetAttribute("PetState") == "Stunned" or numberAttribute("PetHealth", 0) <= 1 then
		return false, string.format("Pet đang hồi phục (%ds)", math.max(0, math.ceil(stunned)))
	end
	local state = player:GetAttribute("PetState")
	if player:GetAttribute("PetHealCasting") == true or state == "HealApproach" or state == "Healing" then
		return false, if state == "HealApproach" then "Pet đang tới..." else "Đang hồi..."
	end
	local cooldown = numberAttribute("PetHealReadyAt", 0) - now
	if cooldown > 0 then return false, string.format("Hồi chiêu · %ds", math.ceil(cooldown)) end
	if hum.Health >= hum.MaxHealth - .001 then return false, "Bạn đã đầy máu" end
	if menuOpen() then return false, "Đóng menu để gọi Pet" end
	return true, "[H] Gọi Pet Hồi Máu (+70% HP)"
end

-- Hunting-map prototype clock. Start a new clock on mission entry; Stop on exit.
-- At the default 30x scale, 120 real seconds advance one in-world hour.
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local EnvironmentClock = {}
EnvironmentClock.__index = EnvironmentClock

local LIGHTING_PROPERTIES = {
	"ClockTime", "GeographicLatitude", "Brightness", "Ambient", "OutdoorAmbient",
	"ColorShift_Top", "ColorShift_Bottom", "ExposureCompensation", "FogStart", "FogEnd",
	"EnvironmentDiffuseScale", "EnvironmentSpecularScale", "GlobalShadows",
}
local ATMOSPHERE_PROPERTIES = { "Density", "Offset", "Color", "Decay", "Glare", "Haze" }
local READABILITY_PROPERTIES = { "Brightness", "Contrast", "Saturation", "TintColor", "Enabled" }
local VALLEY_TERRAIN = {
	Grass=Color3.fromRGB(142,156,91),LeafyGrass=Color3.fromRGB(107,135,78),
	Ground=Color3.fromRGB(103,86,64),Rock=Color3.fromRGB(99,114,116),
	Slate=Color3.fromRGB(122,133,134),Mud=Color3.fromRGB(75,80,60),
	Sandstone=Color3.fromRGB(132,132,117),Sand=Color3.fromRGB(151,143,111),
}

local function wallTime()
	return DateTime.now().UnixTimestampMillis / 1000
end

local function capture(instance, properties)
	local saved = {}
	for _, property in properties do
		saved[property] = instance[property]
	end
	return saved
end

local function restore(instance, properties)
	for property, value in properties do
		instance[property] = value
	end
end

local function mix(a, b, alpha)
	return a + (b - a) * alpha
end

local function smoothstep(low, high, value)
	local alpha = math.clamp((value - low) / (high - low), 0, 1)
	return alpha * alpha * (3 - 2 * alpha)
end

local function finiteNumber(value, default)
	if type(value) == "number" and value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge then
		return value
	end
	return default
end

function EnvironmentClock.new(root, config)
	assert(typeof(root) == "Instance", "EnvironmentClock needs a map root Instance")
	config = config or {}
	local atmosphere = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
	local readability = Lighting:FindFirstChild("HunDinoNightReadability")
	local self = setmetatable({
		Root = root,
		Style = config.EnvironmentStyle,
		TimezoneOffsetMinutes = finiteNumber(config.TimezoneOffsetMinutes, 420),
		TimeScale = math.max(0.01, finiteNumber(config.TimeScale, 30)),
		Latitude = math.clamp(finiteNumber(config.ClockLatitude, -8), -90, 90),
		SavedLighting = capture(Lighting, LIGHTING_PROPERTIES),
		Atmosphere = atmosphere,
		SavedAtmosphere = if atmosphere then capture(atmosphere, ATMOSPHERE_PROPERTIES) else nil,
		OwnedAtmosphere = false,
		Readability = readability,
		SavedReadability = if readability then capture(readability, READABILITY_PROPERTIES) else nil,
		OwnedReadability = false,
		SavedClockHours = root:GetAttribute("GameClockHours"),
		SavedElapsedSeconds = root:GetAttribute("HuntElapsedSeconds"),
		Connection = nil,
		StartedAt = nil,
		EntryClockHours = nil,
		Destroyed = false,
	}, EnvironmentClock)
	if self.Style=="GreyMist" then
		self.SavedSceneCorrections={}
		for _,effect in Lighting:GetChildren() do
			if effect:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") and effect~=readability then
				self.SavedSceneCorrections[effect]=effect.Enabled
			end
		end
		self.SavedTerrainColors={}
		for name in VALLEY_TERRAIN do self.SavedTerrainColors[name]=workspace.Terrain:GetMaterialColor(Enum.Material[name]) end
		self.SavedWater=capture(workspace.Terrain,{"WaterColor","WaterTransparency","WaterReflectance","WaterWaveSize","WaterWaveSpeed"})
	end
	return self
end

function EnvironmentClock:_ensureAtmosphere()
	if self.Atmosphere and self.Atmosphere.Parent == Lighting then
		return
	end
	-- A caller may construct the clock before setting up the rest of the scene.
	local existing = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
	if existing then
		self.Atmosphere = existing
		self.SavedAtmosphere = capture(existing, ATMOSPHERE_PROPERTIES)
		self.OwnedAtmosphere = false
	else
		local atmosphere = Instance.new("Atmosphere")
		atmosphere.Name = "HunDinoHuntingAtmosphere"
		atmosphere.Parent = Lighting
		self.Atmosphere = atmosphere
		self.SavedAtmosphere = nil
		self.OwnedAtmosphere = true
	end
end

function EnvironmentClock:Step(unixSeconds)
	assert(not self.Destroyed, "EnvironmentClock has been destroyed")
	if self.StartedAt == nil then
		return nil
	end
	local now = finiteNumber(unixSeconds, wallTime())
	local elapsed = math.max(0, now - self.StartedAt)
	local hours = (self.EntryClockHours + elapsed * self.TimeScale / 3600) % 24
	local sun = math.sin((hours - 6) / 24 * math.pi * 2)
	local daylight = smoothstep(-0.16, 0.42, sun)
	local dusk = math.exp(-((hours - 18) / 1.25) ^ 2)
	local dawn = math.exp(-((hours - 6) / 1.25) ^ 2)
	local warmth = math.clamp(dusk + dawn * 0.65, 0, 1)

	Lighting.ClockTime = hours
	Lighting.GeographicLatitude = self.Latitude
	Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
	-- A bright ambient floor keeps routes and dinosaur silhouettes legible at night.
	Lighting.Brightness = mix(2.15, 2.8, daylight)
	Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(105, 130, 150):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(121, 127, 113), daylight)
	Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(135, 153, 172):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(151, 157, 139), daylight)
	Lighting.ColorShift_Top = Color3.fromRGB(8, 14, 26):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), daylight)
		:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(52, 24, 9), warmth * 0.68)
	Lighting.ColorShift_Bottom = Color3.fromRGB(5, 10, 18):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), daylight)
	Lighting.ExposureCompensation = mix(0.45, 0.03, daylight)
	Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 0.72
	Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = mix(0.40, 0.55, daylight)
	Lighting.FogStart = 700
	Lighting.FogEnd = 6000

	self:_ensureAtmosphere()
	local atmosphere = self.Atmosphere
	-- Gentle distance haze; combat spaces remain clear in this outdoor jungle.
	atmosphere.Density = mix(0.18, 0.14, daylight)
	atmosphere.Offset = 0.12
	atmosphere.Color = Color3.fromRGB(152, 177, 204):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(199, 215, 197), daylight)
		:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(225, 194, 151), warmth * 0.38)
	atmosphere.Decay = Color3.fromRGB(90, 112, 143):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(118, 139, 113), daylight)
	atmosphere.Glare = daylight * 0.08
	atmosphere.Haze = mix(1.15, 0.85, daylight)
	if self.Style == "GreyMist" then
		-- The hub's cool grading belongs to its own scene. Restore it on exit.
		for effect in self.SavedSceneCorrections do
			if effect.Parent==Lighting then effect.Enabled=false end
		end
		if not self.TerrainPaletteApplied then
			for name,color in VALLEY_TERRAIN do workspace.Terrain:SetMaterialColor(Enum.Material[name],color) end
			workspace.Terrain.WaterColor=Color3.fromRGB(70,111,104)
			workspace.Terrain.WaterTransparency=.32;workspace.Terrain.WaterReflectance=.12
			workspace.Terrain.WaterWaveSize=.12;workspace.Terrain.WaterWaveSpeed=5
			self.TerrainPaletteApplied=true
		end
		Lighting.Brightness = mix(1.85, 2.9, daylight)
		Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(84,106,132):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(100,112,105),daylight)
		Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(116,137,157):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(140,150,138),daylight)
		Lighting.FogStart=900;Lighting.FogEnd=8500
		Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale=.68
		atmosphere.Density=mix(.24,.20,daylight)
		atmosphere.Color=Color3.fromRGB(155,178,200):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(199,210,202),daylight)
			:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(233,202,163),warmth*.4)
		atmosphere.Decay=Color3.fromRGB(89,111,140):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(127,144,137),daylight)
		atmosphere.Haze=mix(1.7,1.35,daylight);atmosphere.Glare=.12*daylight
	end
	-- Lift the darkest shadows instead of turning night into daytime.
	if not self.Readability or self.Readability.Parent ~= Lighting then
		self.Readability=Lighting:FindFirstChild("HunDinoNightReadability")
		if not self.Readability then
			self.Readability=Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
			self.Readability.Name="HunDinoNightReadability";self.Readability.Parent=Lighting
			self.OwnedReadability=true
		else self.SavedReadability=capture(self.Readability,READABILITY_PROPERTIES) end
	end
	self.Readability.Enabled=true
	self.Readability.Brightness=0.055*(1-daylight)
	self.Readability.Contrast=-0.04*(1-daylight)
	self.Readability.Saturation=-0.04*(1-daylight)
	self.Readability.TintColor=Color3.new(1,1,1)

	self.Root:SetAttribute("GameClockHours", hours)
	self.Root:SetAttribute("HuntElapsedSeconds", elapsed)
	return hours, elapsed
end

function EnvironmentClock:Start(unixSeconds)
	assert(not self.Destroyed, "EnvironmentClock has been destroyed")
	self:Stop()
	local now = finiteNumber(unixSeconds, wallTime())
	self.StartedAt = now
	self.EntryClockHours = ((now + self.TimezoneOffsetMinutes * 60) % 86400) / 3600
	self:Step(now)
	self.Connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		self:Step()
	end)
	return self
end

function EnvironmentClock:Stop()
	if self.Connection then
		self.Connection:Disconnect()
		self.Connection = nil
	end
	return self
end

function EnvironmentClock:Destroy(restoreOriginal)
	if self.Destroyed then
		return
	end
	self:Stop()
	if restoreOriginal ~= false then
		if self.SavedSceneCorrections then
			for effect,enabled in self.SavedSceneCorrections do
				if effect.Parent==Lighting then effect.Enabled=enabled end
			end
		end
		if self.SavedTerrainColors then
			for name,color in self.SavedTerrainColors do workspace.Terrain:SetMaterialColor(Enum.Material[name],color) end
			if self.SavedWater then restore(workspace.Terrain,self.SavedWater) end
		end
		restore(Lighting, self.SavedLighting)
		if self.OwnedAtmosphere and self.Atmosphere then
			self.Atmosphere:Destroy()
		elseif self.Atmosphere and self.Atmosphere.Parent == Lighting and self.SavedAtmosphere then
			restore(self.Atmosphere, self.SavedAtmosphere)
		end
		if self.OwnedReadability and self.Readability then self.Readability:Destroy()
		elseif self.Readability and self.Readability.Parent==Lighting and self.SavedReadability then
			restore(self.Readability,self.SavedReadability)
		end
		self.Root:SetAttribute("GameClockHours", self.SavedClockHours)
		self.Root:SetAttribute("HuntElapsedSeconds", self.SavedElapsedSeconds)
	end
	self.Destroyed = true
end

return EnvironmentClock

local function basePart(name, size, color)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = name
	p.Size = size
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	p.Anchored = false
	p.CanCollide = false
	p.CanTouch = false
	p.CanQuery = false
	p.Massless = true
	return p
end

-- Trả về (model, rig). rig.Motors[tên khớp] để sau này đặt Transform làm hoạt ảnh.
function PetStanding.build(parent: Instance?)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "PetStanding"

	local bones: { [string]: BasePart } = {}
	local worlds: { [string]: CFrame } = {}
	local motors: { [string]: Motor6D } = {}

	-- Root: khớp gốc cố định, neo; mọi khối khác nối vào nó nên PivotTo cả mô hình vẫn đúng.
	local root = basePart("Root", Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2), WHITE)
	root.Transparency = 1
	root.Anchored = true
	root.CFrame = CFrame.new()
	root.Parent = model
	model.PrimaryPart = root
	bones.Root, worlds.Root = root, CFrame.new()

	for _, def in BONES do
		local name, parentName, offset = def[1], def[2], def[3]
		local part = basePart(name, Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2), WHITE)
		part.Transparency = 1
		local world = worlds[parentName] * CFrame.new(offset)
		part.CFrame = world
		part.Parent = model
		local motor = Instance.new("Motor6D")
		motor.Name = name
		motor.Part0 = bones[parentName]
		motor.Part1 = part
		motor.C0 = CFrame.new(offset)
		motor.C1 = CFrame.new()
		motor.Parent = bones[parentName]
		bones[name], worlds[name], motors[name] = part, world, motor
	end

	local slots: { [string]: { BasePart } } = { Helmet = {}, Armor = {}, Horns = {} }
	for i, def in PARTS do
		local bone, size, pos, color, rot, slot = def[1], def[2], def[3], def[4], def[5], def[6]
		local part = basePart(bone .. "_" .. i, size, color)
		local offset = CFrame.new(pos)
		if rot then
			offset = offset * CFrame.Angles(rot[1], rot[2], rot[3])
		end
		part.CFrame = worlds[bone] * offset
		local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
		weld.Part0 = bones[bone]
		weld.Part1 = part
		weld.C0 = offset
		weld.Parent = part
		part.Parent = model
		if slot then
			part:SetAttribute("Slot", slot)
			table.insert(slots[slot], part)
		end
	end

	local rig = { Motors = motors, Bones = bones, Slots = slots, Grips = { R = bones.GripR, L = bones.GripL } }
	PetStanding.setHelmet(rig, true)
	PetStanding.setArmor(rig, true)
	if parent then
		model.Parent = parent
	end
	return model, rig
end

-- Resolve the replicated rig without creating another pet on the client.
function PetStanding.bind(model: Model)
	local bones, motors = {}, {}
	local root = model:FindFirstChild("Root")
	if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then return nil end
	bones.Root = root
	for _, def in BONES do
		local bone = model:FindFirstChild(def[1])
		local parent = bones[def[2]]
		local motor = parent and parent:FindFirstChild(def[1])
		if not bone or not bone:IsA("BasePart") or not motor or not motor:IsA("Motor6D") then
			return nil
		end
		bones[def[1]], motors[def[1]] = bone, motor
	end
	local slots = { Helmet = {}, Armor = {}, Horns = {} }
	for _, part in model:GetChildren() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			local slot = part:GetAttribute("Slot")
			if slot and slots[slot] then table.insert(slots[slot], part) end
		end
	end
	return { Motors = motors, Bones = bones, Slots = slots, Grips = { R = bones.GripR, L = bones.GripL } }
end

-- Ẩn bằng Transparency để khớp nối không bị tháo ra.
local function show(parts: { BasePart }, on: boolean)
	for _, p in parts do
		p.Transparency = if on then 0 else 1
	end
end
-- Khi có mũ thì ẩn sừng tự nhiên của pet để khỏi xuyên qua mũ.
function PetStanding.setHelmet(rig, on: boolean)
	show(rig.Slots.Helmet, on)
	show(rig.Slots.Horns, not on)
end
function PetStanding.setArmor(rig, on: boolean)
	show(rig.Slots.Armor, on)
end

return PetStanding

-- Durable account format. Pure data only: usable in Studio and in Lune tests.
-- Economy remains authoritative for its own migrations, transactions and receipts.
local ProfileSchema = {}
local VERSION = 1
local MAX_TIME = 253402300799
local MAX_COUNT = 1000000000
local MAX_SERIAL = 2147483647
local WEAPONS = {Hammer=true, SwordShield=true, Katana=true, Glaive=true,
	DualDaggers=true, Bow=true, GreatAxe=true}
local ARMORS = {Training=true, Leather=true, Metal=true, Bone=true, None=true}
local SLOTS = {"Head", "Chest", "Arms", "Waist", "Legs"}
local FIELDS = {DataVersion=true, Economy=true, Loadout=true, Preferences=true,
	Pet=true, Statistics=true, CreatedAt=true, UpdatedAt=true}

local function integer(value, maximum)
	return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value >= 0
		and value <= maximum and value % 1 == 0
end

local function clone(value)
	if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
	local copy = {}
	for key, child in value do copy[key] = clone(child) end
	return copy
end

-- Reject cycles, executable values, metatables and invalid floats before cloning.
-- The bounded depth also keeps malformed input from exhausting the Lua stack.
local function plain(value, visiting, depth)
	local kind = type(value)
	if kind == "number" then return value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge end
	if kind ~= "table" then return kind == "string" or kind == "boolean" end
	if depth > 24 or visiting[value] or getmetatable(value) ~= nil then return false end
	visiting[value] = true
	for key, child in value do
		if (type(key) ~= "string" and not integer(key, MAX_TIME))
			or not plain(child, visiting, depth + 1) then
			visiting[value] = nil
			return false
		end
	end
	visiting[value] = nil
	return true
end

local function exactFields(value, names)
	if type(value) ~= "table" then return false end
	local allowed = {}
	for _, name in names do allowed[name] = true; if value[name] == nil then return false end end
	for key in value do if not allowed[key] then return false end end
	return true
end

local function armor(kind)
	local result = {}
	for _, slot in SLOTS do result[slot] = kind end
	return result
end

local function validArmor(value)
	if not exactFields(value, SLOTS) then return false end
	for _, slot in SLOTS do if not ARMORS[value[slot]] then return false end end
	return true
end

-- Numeric dictionary keys are unsafe through Roblox JSON/DataStore serialization.
-- Decode only canonical positive decimal keys, rejecting aliases/collisions.
local function decodeOperations(economy)
	if type(economy) ~= "table" or type(economy.OperationReceipts) ~= "table" then return false end
	local decoded = {}
	for key, receipt in economy.OperationReceipts do
		local n
		if type(key) == "number" then n = key
		elseif type(key) == "string" and key:match("^[1-9]%d*$") then n = tonumber(key) end
		if not integer(n, MAX_SERIAL) or n == 0 or decoded[n] ~= nil
			or (type(key) == "string" and tostring(n) ~= key) then return false end
		decoded[n] = receipt
	end
	economy.OperationReceipts = decoded
	return true
end

local function decodeDisplaySlots(economy)
	if economy.DisplaySlots == nil then return true end -- Validated v2 migration adds the empty collection.
	if type(economy.DisplaySlots) ~= "table" then return false end
	local decoded = {}
	for key, specimenId in economy.DisplaySlots do
		local slot
		if type(key) == "number" then slot = key
		elseif type(key) == "string" and key:match("^[1-5]$") then slot = tonumber(key) end
		if not integer(slot, 5) or slot == 0 or decoded[slot] ~= nil then return false end
		decoded[slot] = specimenId
	end
	economy.DisplaySlots = decoded
	return true
end

function ProfileSchema.new(economyRules)
	assert(type(economyRules) == "table" and type(economyRules.new) == "function"
		and type(economyRules.apply) == "function", "Economy rules are required")
	local schema = {DataVersion = VERSION}

	function schema.Default(nowUnix)
		assert(integer(nowUnix, MAX_TIME), "Default requires a Unix timestamp")
		return {DataVersion=VERSION, Economy=economyRules.new(),
			Loadout={WeaponId="Hammer", PetWeaponId="Hammer", PlayerArmor=armor("Training"), PetArmor=armor("Metal")},
			Preferences={ShowComboGuide=true, ShowDamage=true, ShowComboFX=true, AimSensitivity=1},
			Pet={HealReadyAt=0}, Statistics={HuntsCompleted=0, HuntsFailed=0, Captures=0},
			CreatedAt=nowUnix, UpdatedAt=nowUnix}
	end

	function schema.Validate(data)
		if type(data) ~= "table" or not plain(data, {}, 0) then return nil, "InvalidProfile" end
		if data.DataVersion ~= VERSION then
			return nil, if integer(data.DataVersion, MAX_SERIAL) and data.DataVersion > VERSION then "FutureDataVersion" else "InvalidDataVersion"
		end
		for field in FIELDS do if data[field] == nil then return nil, "MissingField:" .. field end end
		for field in data do if not FIELDS[field] then return nil, "UnknownField:" .. tostring(field) end end
		if not integer(data.CreatedAt, MAX_TIME) or not integer(data.UpdatedAt, MAX_TIME)
			or data.UpdatedAt < data.CreatedAt then return nil, "InvalidTimestamps" end
		local loadout = data.Loadout
		if not exactFields(loadout, {"WeaponId", "PetWeaponId", "PlayerArmor", "PetArmor"})
			or not WEAPONS[loadout.WeaponId] or not WEAPONS[loadout.PetWeaponId]
			or not validArmor(loadout.PlayerArmor) or not validArmor(loadout.PetArmor) then return nil, "InvalidLoadout" end
		local preferences = data.Preferences
		if not exactFields(preferences, {"ShowComboGuide", "ShowDamage", "ShowComboFX", "AimSensitivity"})
			or type(preferences.ShowComboGuide) ~= "boolean" or type(preferences.ShowDamage) ~= "boolean"
			or type(preferences.ShowComboFX) ~= "boolean"
			or (preferences.AimSensitivity ~= 0.5 and preferences.AimSensitivity ~= 0.75 and preferences.AimSensitivity ~= 1) then
			return nil, "InvalidPreferences"
		end
		if not exactFields(data.Pet, {"HealReadyAt"}) or not integer(data.Pet.HealReadyAt, MAX_TIME) then return nil, "InvalidPet" end
		if not exactFields(data.Statistics, {"HuntsCompleted", "HuntsFailed", "Captures"}) then return nil, "InvalidStatistics" end
		for _, value in data.Statistics do if not integer(value, MAX_COUNT) then return nil, "InvalidStatistics" end end
		local normalized = clone(data)
		if not decodeOperations(normalized.Economy) then return nil, "InvalidOperationReceipts" end
		if not decodeDisplaySlots(normalized.Economy) then return nil, "InvalidDisplaySlots" end
		local economy, reason = economyRules.new(normalized.Economy)
		if not economy then return nil, "Economy:" .. tostring(reason) end
		normalized.Economy = economy
		return normalized
	end

	function schema.Encode(data)
		local encoded, reason = schema.Validate(data)
		if not encoded then return nil, reason end
		local receipts = {}
		for key, receipt in encoded.Economy.OperationReceipts do receipts[tostring(key)] = receipt end
		encoded.Economy.OperationReceipts = receipts
		local slots = {}
		for slot, specimenId in encoded.Economy.DisplaySlots do slots[tostring(slot)] = specimenId end
		encoded.Economy.DisplaySlots = slots
		return encoded
	end

	-- Loading never resumes a half-finished hunt: only its unspent reserved items
	-- return. Committed loot and claim ledgers remain intact, without new rewards.
	-- The caller must durably save this repaired profile before permitting actions.
	function schema.Recover(data)
		local recovered, reason = schema.Validate(data)
		if not recovered then return nil, reason end
		local run = recovered.Economy.ActiveRun
		if not run then return recovered end
		local request = {Op="CloseRun", RunId=run.Id, RunSerial=run.Serial}
		if run.State == "Preparing" then request.EntryFailed = true
		else request.Traps, request.Potions = run.Traps, run.Potions end
		local receipt = economyRules.apply(recovered.Economy, request)
		if not receipt.Ok then return nil, "RecoveryFailed:" .. tostring(receipt.Code) end
  if run.State=="Hunting" then recovered.Statistics.HuntsFailed=math.min(MAX_COUNT,recovered.Statistics.HuntsFailed+1) end
		return recovered, receipt
	end

	schema.Decode = schema.Validate
	return schema
end

return ProfileSchema

	local out={}
	for _,slot in Armor.Slots do out[slot]=player:GetAttribute(target.."Armor_"..slot) or (if target=="Pet" then "Metal" else "Training") end
	return out
end
local function find(model,names)
	for _,name in names do local p=model:FindFirstChild(name);if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then return p end end
end
