-- Keep the existing inventory ID Training as the Hunter set alias.
function Armor.petSet(id)
	return Armor.PetSets[if id=="Training" then "Hunter" else id]
end
local function petSlot(model,slot,id,group)
	local set=assert(Armor.petSet(id),"Invalid pet armor set")
	for i,def in set.slots[slot] do
		local bone=assert(find(model,{def[1]}),"Missing pet armor bone: "..def[1])
		local offset=CFrame.new(def[3]);local rot=def[5]
		if rot then offset*=CFrame.Angles(rot[1],rot[2],rot[3]) end
		local p=Instance.new(def[7] or "Part");p.Name=string.format("%s_%s_%d",if id=="Training" then "Hunter" else id,slot,i)
		p.Size=def[2];p.Color=def[4];p.Material=def[6] or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		p.Anchored=false;p.CanCollide=false;p.CanTouch=false;p.CanQuery=false;p.Massless=true
		p.CFrame=bone.CFrame*offset;p:SetAttribute("ArmorSet",id);p:SetAttribute("ArmorSlot",slot);p:SetAttribute("ArmorBone",def[1]);p.Parent=group
		local w=Instance.new("Weld");w.Name="ArmorWeld";w.Part0=bone;w.Part1=p;w.C0=offset;w.Parent=p
		if not group.PrimaryPart then group.PrimaryPart=p end
	end
	return group
end

function Armor.slot(model,target,slot,id)
	assert(Armor.valid(slot,id),"Invalid armor selection")
	local group=Instance.new("Model");group.Name="Armor_"..slot
	group:SetAttribute("ArmorSlot",slot);group:SetAttribute("ArmorSet",id)
	if id=="None" then return group end
	if target=="Pet" then return petSlot(model,slot,id,group) end
	local style=Armor.Sets[id]
	local pet=target=="Pet"
	local function add(bone,name,size,offset,trim,class)
		if not bone then return end
		local p=Instance.new(class or "Part");p.Name=name;p.Size=size
		p.Color=if trim then style.Trim else style.Color;p.Material=style.Material
		p.Anchored=false;p.CanCollide=false;p.CanTouch=false;p.CanQuery=false;p.Massless=true
		p.CFrame=bone.CFrame*offset;p.Parent=group
		local w=Instance.new("Weld");w.Name="ArmorWeld";w.Part0=bone;w.Part1=p;w.C0=offset;w.Parent=p
		if not group.PrimaryPart then group.PrimaryPart=p end
		return p
	end
	if slot=="Head" then
		local bone=find(model,{"Head"})
		if bone then
			local size=if pet then Vector3.new(1.3,1.1,1.25) else bone.Size
			add(bone,"HelmetCrown",Vector3.new(size.X*1.12,size.Y*.3,size.Z*1.08),CFrame.new(0,size.Y*.52,0))
			add(bone,"HelmetBand",Vector3.new(size.X*1.15,size.Y*.12,size.Z*1.1),CFrame.new(0,size.Y*.35,0),true)
			for _,side in {-1,1} do
				add(bone,"CheekPlate",Vector3.new(size.X*.1,size.Y*.48,size.Z*.52),CFrame.new(side*size.X*.54,0,0))
				if id=="Bone" then add(bone,"Horn",Vector3.new(.15,.36,.18),CFrame.new(side*size.X*.36,size.Y*.78,0)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,-side*.3),true,"WedgePart") end
			end
		end
	elseif slot=="Chest" then
		local bone=find(model,if pet then {"Torso"} else {"UpperTorso","Torso"})
		if bone then
			local size=if pet then Vector3.new(1.4,1.7,1.1) else bone.Size
			for _,side in {-1,1} do add(bone,"BodyPlate",Vector3.new(size.X*1.04,size.Y*.76,.18),CFrame.new(0,0,side*(size.Z*.5+.09))) end
			add(bone,"CollarTrim",Vector3.new(size.X*1.08,.12,.22),CFrame.new(0,size.Y*.32,-size.Z*.5-.1),true)
			add(bone,"HunterBadge",Vector3.new(.27,.36,.1),CFrame.new(0,0,-size.Z*.5-.23),true)
		end
	elseif slot=="Arms" then
		for _,side in {"R","L"} do
			local bone=find(model,if pet then {"Arm"..side} elseif side=="R" then {"RightUpperArm","Right Arm"} else {"LeftUpperArm","Left Arm"})
			if bone then
				local size=if pet then Vector3.new(.6,.65,.6) else bone.Size
				local y=if pet then .12 else size.Y*.32
				add(bone,"ShoulderGuard",Vector3.new(size.X*1.25,.28,size.Z*1.18),CFrame.new(0,y,0))
				add(bone,"ShoulderTrim",Vector3.new(size.X*1.3,.07,size.Z*1.22),CFrame.new(0,y+.17,0),true)
				if id=="Bone" then add(bone,"ShoulderSpike",Vector3.new(.18,.32,.18),CFrame.new(0,y+.32,0),true,"WedgePart") end
			end
		end
	elseif slot=="Waist" then
		local bone=find(model,if pet then {"Torso"} else {"LowerTorso","Torso","HumanoidRootPart"})
		if bone then
			local size=if pet then Vector3.new(1.4,1.7,1.1) else bone.Size
			local y=if pet then -.72 else -size.Y*.38
			add(bone,"Belt",Vector3.new(size.X*1.1,.24,size.Z*1.1),CFrame.new(0,y,0))
			add(bone,"Buckle",Vector3.new(.32,.32,.12),CFrame.new(0,y,-size.Z*.56-.07),true)
			for _,side in {-1,1} do add(bone,"HipPlate",Vector3.new(size.X*.3,.4,.16),CFrame.new(side*size.X*.35,y-.23,-size.Z*.5)) end
		end
	elseif slot=="Legs" then
		for _,side in {"R","L"} do
			local bone=find(model,if pet then {"Leg"..side} elseif side=="R" then {"RightLowerLeg","Right Leg"} else {"LeftLowerLeg","Left Leg"})
			if bone then
				local size=if pet then Vector3.new(.55,.8,.65) else bone.Size
				local y=if pet then -.72 else -size.Y*.04
				add(bone,"ShinPlate",Vector3.new(size.X*.8,if pet then .7 else size.Y*.68,.15),CFrame.new(0,y,-size.Z*.5-.04))
				add(bone,"KneeTrim",Vector3.new(size.X*.88,.2,.2),CFrame.new(0,y+.29,-size.Z*.5-.06),true)
			end
		end
	end
	return group
end

function Armor.apply(model,target,equipment)
	local old=model:FindFirstChild("EquipmentArmor");if old then old:Destroy() end
	local legacy=model:FindFirstChild("TrainingArmor");if legacy then legacy:Destroy() end
	if target=="Pet" then
		for _,p in model:GetChildren() do
			if p:IsA("BasePart") then
				local slot=p:GetAttribute("Slot")
				if slot=="Armor" or slot=="Helmet" then p.Transparency=1
				elseif slot=="Horns" then
					local set=Armor.petSet(equipment.Head)
					p.Transparency=if set and set.hideNaturalHorns then 1 else 0
				end
			end
		end
	else
		for _,accessory in model:GetChildren() do
			if accessory:IsA("Accessory") and (accessory.AccessoryType==Enum.AccessoryType.Hair or accessory.AccessoryType==Enum.AccessoryType.Hat) then
				for _,part in accessory:GetDescendants() do if part:IsA("BasePart") then
					if part:GetAttribute("ArmorOriginalTransparency")==nil then part:SetAttribute("ArmorOriginalTransparency",part.Transparency) end
					part.Transparency=if equipment.Head=="None" then part:GetAttribute("ArmorOriginalTransparency") else 1
				end end
			end
		end
	end
	local all=Instance.new("Model");all.Name="EquipmentArmor"
	for _,slot in Armor.Slots do Armor.slot(model,target,slot,equipment[slot] or "None").Parent=all end
	all.Parent=model
	return all
end

function Armor.icon(target,slot,id)
	if target=="Pet" then
		local body=Instance.new("Model")
		local origins={Head=CFrame.new(),Torso=CFrame.new(),ArmR=CFrame.new(.85,0,0),ForeR=CFrame.new(.85,-.5,0),ArmL=CFrame.new(-.85,0,0),ForeL=CFrame.new(-.85,-.5,0),LegR=CFrame.new(.5,0,0),LegL=CFrame.new(-.5,0,0),Tail1=CFrame.new(0,-.6,.5),Tail2=CFrame.new(0,-.6,1.7)}
		for name,cf in origins do local bone=Instance.new("Part");bone.Name=name;bone.CFrame=cf;bone.Parent=body end
		local piece=Armor.slot(body,target,slot,id)
		for _,v in piece:GetDescendants() do if v:IsA("Weld") then v:Destroy() elseif v:IsA("BasePart") then v.Anchored=true end end
		body:Destroy();return piece
	end
	local body=Instance.new("Model")
	local names=if target=="Pet" then {"Head","Torso","ArmR","ArmL","LegR","LegL"} else {"Head","Torso","Left Arm","Right Arm","Left Leg","Right Leg"}
	for i,name in names do
		local p=Instance.new("Part");p.Name=name;p.Transparency=1;p.Anchored=true
		p.Size=if name=="Head" then Vector3.new(2,1,1) elseif name=="Torso" then Vector3.new(2,2,1) else Vector3.new(1,2,1)
		p.CFrame=CFrame.new(if i==3 or i==5 then -.65 elseif i==4 or i==6 then .65 else 0,0,0);p.Parent=body
	end
	local piece=Armor.slot(body,target,slot,id)
	for _,v in piece:GetDescendants() do if v:IsA("Weld") then v:Destroy() elseif v:IsA("BasePart") then v.Anchored=true end end
	body:Destroy()
	return piece
end

return Armor

-- Server-only durable profile repository. The UpdateAsync callback must not yield.
-- Token must be unique to this server/session; Now uses Unix seconds. Inject Store,
-- Sleep and Now in tests. Validate migrates/sanitizes memory data; Encode converts it
-- to DataStore-safe tables. No load error ever becomes a new/default profile.
local Store = {}
Store.__index = Store

local MAX_INTEGER = 9007199254740991
local RECEIPT_LIMIT = 32
local function integer(n)
	return type(n) == "number" and n == n and n >= 0 and n <= MAX_INTEGER and n % 1 == 0
end

local function copy(value, seen, depth)
	local kind = type(value)
	if kind == "nil" or kind == "string" or kind == "boolean" then return value end
	if kind == "number" then
		assert(value == value and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge, "Non-finite data")
		return value
	end
	assert(kind == "table" and (depth or 0) < 48, "Unsupported profile data/depth")
	seen = seen or {}
	assert(not seen[value], "Cyclic profile data")
	seen[value] = true
	local result = {}
	for key, item in value do
		assert(type(key) == "string" or (integer(key) and key > 0), "Invalid profile key")
		result[key] = copy(item, seen, (depth or 0) + 1)
	end
	seen[value] = nil
	return result
end

local function serializable(value)
	if type(value) ~= "table" then return end
	local strings, numbers, count, maximum = false, false, 0, 0
	for key, item in value do
		if type(key) == "string" then strings = true else numbers = true; maximum = math.max(maximum, key) end
		count += 1
		serializable(item)
	end
	assert(not (strings and numbers) and (not numbers or count == maximum), "Encode must return dictionaries or dense arrays")
end

local function equal(a, b)
	if type(a) ~= type(b) then return false end
	if type(a) ~= "table" then return a == b end
	for key, item in a do if not equal(item, b[key]) then return false end end
	for key in b do if a[key] == nil then return false end end
	return true
end

function Store.new(options)
	assert(type(options) == "table" and options.Store ~= nil, "Store required")
	assert(type(options.Token) == "string" and #options.Token > 0 and #options.Token <= 160, "Unique session Token required")
	local self = setmetatable({}, Store)
	self._store, self._token = options.Store, options.Token
	self._now = options.Now or os.time
	self._sleep = options.Sleep or function(seconds) task.wait(seconds) end
	self._validate, self._encode = options.Validate, options.Encode
	self._lease = options.LeaseSeconds or 120
	self._attempts = options.MaxAttempts or 4
	self._baseDelay, self._maxDelay = options.BaseDelay or 0.5, options.MaxDelay or 4
	assert(type(self._lease) == "number" and self._lease >= 10 and self._lease <= 3600, "LeaseSeconds must be 10..3600")
	assert(integer(self._attempts) and self._attempts >= 1 and self._attempts <= 8, "MaxAttempts must be 1..8")
	assert(type(self._baseDelay) == "number" and self._baseDelay >= 0 and self._baseDelay <= 10
		and type(self._maxDelay) == "number" and self._maxDelay >= self._baseDelay and self._maxDelay <= 30, "Invalid retry delays")
	self._states, self._serial = {}, 0
	return self
end

function Store:_data(data)
	local ok, result, code = pcall(function()
		local candidate = copy(data)
		if type(candidate) ~= "table" then return nil, "InvalidData" end
		if self._validate then
			local normalized, reason = self._validate(candidate)
			if type(normalized) ~= "table" then return nil, reason or "InvalidData" end
			candidate = copy(normalized)
		end
		return candidate
	end)
	if not ok then return nil, "InvalidData" end
	return result, code
end

function Store:_encoded(data)
	local ok, encoded = pcall(function()
		local result = copy(if self._encode then self._encode(copy(data)) else data)
		assert(type(result) == "table", "Encode returned no data")
		serializable(result)
		return result
	end)
	return if ok then encoded else nil
end

function Store:_envelope(raw)
	if type(raw) ~= "table" then return nil, "InvalidEnvelope" end
	if integer(raw.FormatVersion) and raw.FormatVersion > 1 then return nil, "FutureFormat" end
	if raw.FormatVersion ~= 1 or not integer(raw.Revision) then return nil, "InvalidEnvelope" end
	if raw.Session ~= nil and (type(raw.Session) ~= "table" or type(raw.Session.Token) ~= "string"
		or #raw.Session.Token == 0 or not integer(raw.Session.ExpiresAt)) then return nil, "InvalidEnvelope" end
	local function validReceipt(mark)
		return type(mark) == "table" and type(mark.Id) == "string" and #mark.Id > 0
			and type(mark.Token) == "string" and #mark.Token > 0 and integer(mark.Revision)
			and mark.Revision <= raw.Revision and type(mark.Released) == "boolean"
	end
	if raw.LastCommit ~= nil and not validReceipt(raw.LastCommit) then return nil, "InvalidEnvelope" end
	if raw.RecentCommits ~= nil then
		if type(raw.RecentCommits) ~= "table" or #raw.RecentCommits > RECEIPT_LIMIT then return nil, "InvalidEnvelope" end
		local count = 0
		for key, mark in raw.RecentCommits do
			count += 1
			if not integer(key) or key < 1 or key > #raw.RecentCommits or not validReceipt(mark) then return nil, "InvalidEnvelope" end
		end
		if count ~= #raw.RecentCommits then return nil, "InvalidEnvelope" end
	end
	local data, reason = self:_data(raw.Data)
	if not data then return nil, reason end
	local ok, envelope = pcall(copy, raw)
	if not ok then return nil, "InvalidEnvelope" end
	return envelope, nil, data
end

function Store:_begin(key)
	assert(type(key) == "string" and #key > 0, "Profile key required")
	local state = self._states[key]
	if not state then state = {}; self._states[key] = state end
	if state.Busy then return nil, "Busy" end
	state.Busy = true
	return state
end

function Store:_retry(callback, failureCode)
	for attempt = 1, self._attempts do
		local ok, value, reason = pcall(callback)
		if ok then return value, reason end
		if attempt < self._attempts then
			self._sleep(math.min(self._maxDelay, self._baseDelay * 2 ^ (attempt - 1)))
		end
	end
	return nil, failureCode
end

local function receipt(envelope, id)
	if type(envelope.LastCommit) == "table" and envelope.LastCommit.Id == id then return envelope.LastCommit end
	if type(envelope.RecentCommits) == "table" then
		for _, item in envelope.RecentCommits do
			if type(item) == "table" and item.Id == id then return item end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Explicit acquisition is the only operation allowed to take an expired lease.
function Store:Load(key, defaultData)
	local state, reason = self:_begin(key)
	if not state then return false, reason end
	if state.Loaded then state.Busy = nil; return true, "Loaded", copy(state.Data) end
	local default, invalid = self:_data(defaultData)
	local encoded = if default then self:_encoded(default) else nil
	if not encoded then state.Busy = nil; return false, invalid or "InvalidData" end
	local created = false
	local result, failure = self:_retry(function()
		local rejected
		local value = self._store:UpdateAsync(key, function(raw)
			local now = self._now()
			local envelope, why
			if raw == nil then
				created = true
				envelope = {FormatVersion = 1, Data = copy(encoded), Revision = 0}
			else envelope, why = self:_envelope(raw) end
			if not envelope then rejected = why; return nil end
			if envelope.Session and envelope.Session.Token ~= self._token and envelope.Session.ExpiresAt > now then
				rejected = "Locked"; return nil
			end
			-- Keep commit receipts when acquiring: a previous owner's lost release response
			-- can still be acknowledged without modifying this new owner's session.
			envelope.Session = {Token = self._token, ExpiresAt = now + self._lease}
			return envelope
		end)
		return value, rejected
	end, "LoadFailed")
	if result == nil then state.Busy = nil; return false, failure or "LoadFailed" end
	local envelope, why, normalized = self:_envelope(result)
	if not envelope or not envelope.Session or envelope.Session.Token ~= self._token then
		state.Busy = nil; return false, why or "SessionLost"
	end
	state.Loaded, state.Data, state.Revision = true, normalized, envelope.Revision
	state.Pending, state.Released, state.Busy = nil, nil, nil
	return true, if created then "Created" else "Loaded", copy(normalized)
end

function Store:_commit(key, state, pending)
	local result, failure = self:_retry(function()
		local rejected
		local value = self._store:UpdateAsync(key, function(raw)
			local envelope, why = self:_envelope(raw)
			if not envelope then rejected = why; return nil end
			if receipt(envelope, pending.Id) then return envelope end
			local now, session = self._now(), envelope.Session
			if not session or session.Token ~= self._token or session.ExpiresAt <= now then rejected = "SessionLost"; return nil end
			if envelope.Revision ~= pending.Revision then rejected = "RevisionConflict"; return nil end
			if pending.Revision >= MAX_INTEGER then rejected = "RevisionLimit"; return nil end
			envelope.Data, envelope.Revision = copy(pending.Encoded), pending.Revision + 1
			envelope.Session = if pending.Release then nil else {Token = self._token, ExpiresAt = now + self._lease}
			local mark = {Id = pending.Id, Token = self._token, Revision = envelope.Revision, Released = pending.Release}
			local history = if type(envelope.RecentCommits) == "table" then envelope.RecentCommits else {}
			table.insert(history, copy(mark))
			while #history > RECEIPT_LIMIT do table.remove(history, 1) end
			envelope.LastCommit, envelope.RecentCommits = mark, history
			return envelope
		end)
		return value, rejected
	end, "SaveFailed")
	if result == nil then
		if failure ~= "SaveFailed" then state.Loaded, state.Pending = false, nil end
		return false, failure or "SaveFailed"
	end
	local envelope, why = self:_envelope(result)
	local committed = if envelope then receipt(envelope, pending.Id) else nil
	if not committed then state.Loaded, state.Pending = false, nil; return false, why or "RevisionConflict" end
	state.Data, state.Revision, state.Pending = copy(pending.Data), committed.Revision, nil
	if pending.Release then state.Loaded, state.Released = false, true; return true, "Released", copy(state.Data) end
	if not envelope.Session or envelope.Session.Token ~= self._token or envelope.Session.ExpiresAt <= self._now() then
		state.Loaded = false; return false, "SessionLost"
	end
	return true, "Saved", copy(state.Data)
end

function Store:Save(key, data, release)
	local state, reason = self:_begin(key)
	if not state then return false, reason end
	-- Release is itself idempotent, even after the lock has been removed.
	if state.Released then state.Busy = nil; return true, "Released", copy(state.Data) end
	if not state.Loaded then state.Busy = nil; return false, "NotLoaded" end
	local normalized, invalid = self:_data(data)
	local encoded = if normalized then self:_encoded(normalized) else nil
	if not encoded then state.Busy = nil; return false, invalid or "InvalidData" end
	if state.Pending then
		local previous = state.Pending
		local ok, status, committed = self:_commit(key, state, previous)
		if not ok or previous.Release or (not release and equal(normalized, previous.Data)) then
			state.Busy = nil; return ok, status, committed
		end
	end
	self._serial += 1
	local pending = {Id = self._token .. ":" .. self._serial, Revision = state.Revision,
		Data = copy(normalized), Encoded = encoded, Release = release == true}
	state.Pending = pending
	local ok, status, committed = self:_commit(key, state, pending)
	state.Busy = nil
	return ok, status, committed
end

-- Renew at an interval comfortably below LeaseSeconds (for example every 30s).
-- A pending save is resolved by Save, so it cannot be silently replaced by Renew.
function Store:Renew(key)
	local state, reason = self:_begin(key)
	if not state then return false, reason end
	if not state.Loaded then state.Busy = nil; return false, "NotLoaded" end
	if state.Pending then state.Busy = nil; return false, "PendingSave" end
	local result, failure = self:_retry(function()
		local rejected
		local value = self._store:UpdateAsync(key, function(raw)
			local envelope, why = self:_envelope(raw)
			if not envelope then rejected = why; return nil end
			local now, session = self._now(), envelope.Session
			if not session or session.Token ~= self._token or session.ExpiresAt <= now then rejected = "SessionLost"; return nil end
			if envelope.Revision ~= state.Revision then rejected = "RevisionConflict"; return nil end
			envelope.Session.ExpiresAt = now + self._lease
			return envelope
		end)
		return value, rejected
	end, "RenewFailed")
	state.Busy = nil
	if result == nil then
		if failure ~= "RenewFailed" then state.Loaded = false end
		return false, failure or "RenewFailed"
	end
	return true, "Renewed", copy(state.Data)
end

return Store

-- Hoạt ảnh + vũ khí cho pet đứng (PetStanding.luau). ModuleScript độc lập, chưa gắn vào Training.server.luau.
-- Mọi góc dùng cùng công thức như bản xem mẫu trên web: tay xoay quanh trục X, góc dương = vung ra phía trước.
-- Dùng:
--   local model, rig = PetStanding.build(workspace)
--   local anim = PetAnimator.new(model, rig, game.ServerStorage.TrainingWeapons)
--   anim:SetWeapon("Hammer"); anim.OnHit = function(i) ... end
--   RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt) anim:Update(dt) end)
--   anim:SetMoving(true); anim:Attack()
local Animator = {}
Animator.__index = Animator

-- k = tỉ lệ thu nhỏ; o = dịch vũ khí dọc cán để tay nắm ở chỗ hợp lý; R/L = mô hình lấy từ TrainingWeapons.
-- leftPose = tư thế tay trái khi cầm đồ; style = kiểu đòn đánh.
local WEAPONS = {
	Hammer = { k = 0.7, o = 0.9, R = "Main", style = "Overhead" },
	SwordShield = { k = 0.8, o = 0, R = "Main", L = "Offhand", style = "Overhead", leftPose = { 0.8, 0.5 } },
	Katana = { k = 0.75, o = 0.3, R = "Main", style = "Overhead" },
	Glaive = { k = 0.55, o = 1.6, R = "Main", style = "Thrust" },
	DualDaggers = { k = 0.9, o = 0, R = "Main", L = "Offhand", style = "Dual", leftPose = { 0.8, 0.5 } },
	Bow = { k = 0.7, o = 0, ry = math.pi / 2, L = "Main", style = "Shoot", leftPose = { 1.1, 0.5 } },
	GreatAxe = { k = 0.7, o = 0.8, R = "Main", style = "Overhead" },
}

-- Bộ số {u vai, l khuỷu, tilt vũ khí, lean thân}. t1 = hết giai đoạn gồng, t2 = hết giai đoạn đánh.
-- marks = các mốc tiến độ (0..1) gọi OnHit.
local STYLES = {
	Overhead = { dur = 0.8, t1 = 0.35, t2 = 0.6, wind = { 2.6, 0.3, -0.5, -0.15 }, hit = { 0.6, 0.9, 1.8, 0.3 }, marks = { 0.45 } },
	Thrust = { dur = 0.65, t1 = 0.3, t2 = 0.5, wind = { 0.5, 1.0, 0.7, -0.12 }, hit = { 1.4, 0.2, 1.5, 0.25 }, marks = { 0.4 } },
	Shoot = { dur = 1.0, t1 = 0.6, t2 = 0.72, wind = { 1.2, 1.7, 0, -0.05 }, hit = { 1.1, 0.5, 0, 0.06 }, marks = { 0.65 } },
	Dual = {
		dur = 0.9, t1 = 0.35, t2 = 0.6, dual = true, marks = { 0.25, 0.65 },
		wind = { 2.0, 0.5, -0.3, -0.1 }, hit = { 0.7, 0.8, 1.5, 0.2 },
	},
}

local function ease(x: number): number
	return x * x * (3 - 2 * x)
end
local function lerpT(a, b, s: number)
	return { a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * s, a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * s, a[3] + (b[3] - a[3]) * s, a[4] + (b[4] - a[4]) * s }
end
-- rest -> wind -> hit -> rest
local function blend(rest, wind, hit, p: number, t1: number, t2: number)
	if p < t1 then
		return lerpT(rest, wind, ease(p / t1))
	elseif p < t2 then
		return lerpT(wind, hit, ease((p - t1) / (t2 - t1)))
	end
	return lerpT(hit, rest, ease((p - t2) / (1 - t2)))
end

local function attachWeapon(pet: Model, grip: BasePart, source: Model, cfg, name: string)
	assert(source and source:IsA("Model") and source.PrimaryPart, "Weapon template needs a PrimaryPart")
	local clone = source:Clone()
	clone.Name = name
	clone:ScaleTo(cfg.k)
	local handle = clone.PrimaryPart
	for _, d in clone:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			d.Anchored = false
			d.CanCollide = false
			d.CanQuery = false
			d.CanTouch = false
			d.Massless = true
		end
	end
	for _, d in clone:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and d ~= handle and not d:FindFirstChild("KatanaWeld") and not d:FindFirstChild("WeaponProWeld") then
			local w = Instance.new("Weld")
			w.Part0 = handle
			w.Part1 = d
			w.C0 = handle.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(d.CFrame)
			w.Parent = d
		end
	end
	clone:PivotTo(grip.CFrame)
	local motor = Instance.new("Motor6D")
	motor.Name = name
	motor.Part0 = grip
	motor.Part1 = handle
	-- Keep the joint inside the clone so changing weapons destroys it too.
	motor.Parent = clone
	clone.Parent = pet
	return clone, motor
end

function Animator.new(model: Model, rig, templates: Instance)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Animator)
	self.Model, self.Rig, self.Templates = model, rig, templates
	self.t = 0
	self.walkBlend = 0
	self.moving = false
	self.speed = 1
	self.atk = nil
	self.fired = {}
	self.OnHit = nil -- function(markIndex: number)
	self.weaponModels = {}
	self.RenderPose = true
	self.destroyed = false
	return self
end

function Animator:GetHitCount(): number
	return if self.cfg then #STYLES[self.cfg.style].marks else 0
end

function Animator.profile(id: string)
	local cfg=WEAPONS[id]
	return if cfg then STYLES[cfg.style] else nil
end

function Animator:CancelAttack()
	self.atk = nil
	self.fired = {}
end

-- Client binds the server-created weapons; it never clones another copy.
function Animator:BindWeapon(id: string): boolean
	local cfg = WEAPONS[id]
	if not cfg then return false end
	local right = self.Model:FindFirstChild("WeaponR")
	local left = self.Model:FindFirstChild("WeaponL")
	local motorR = right and right:FindFirstChild("WeaponR")
	local motorL = left and left:FindFirstChild("WeaponL")
	if cfg.R and (not motorR or not motorR:IsA("Motor6D")) then return false end
	if cfg.L and (not motorL or not motorL:IsA("Motor6D")) then return false end
	self.id, self.cfg = id, cfg
	self.motorR, self.motorL = motorR, motorL
	self:CancelAttack()
	return true
end

function Animator:SyncAttack(elapsed: number)
	if self.cfg then
		self.atk = self.t - math.max(0, elapsed)
		self.fired = {}
	end
end

function Animator:SetWeapon(id: string?)
	local cfg = if id then WEAPONS[id] else nil
	local template = if id then self.Templates:FindFirstChild(id) else nil
	assert(not id or (cfg and template), "Không có vũ khí: " .. tostring(id))
	for _, m in self.weaponModels do
		m:Destroy()
	end
	self.weaponModels, self.motorR, self.motorL, self.id, self.cfg = {}, nil, nil, nil, nil
	self.atk = nil
	if not id then
		return
	end
	self.id, self.cfg = id, cfg
	if cfg.R then
		local m, motor = attachWeapon(self.Model, self.Rig.Grips.R, template[cfg.R], cfg, "WeaponR")
		table.insert(self.weaponModels, m)
		self.motorR = motor
	end
	if cfg.L then
		local m, motor = attachWeapon(self.Model, self.Rig.Grips.L, template[cfg.L], cfg, "WeaponL")
		table.insert(self.weaponModels, m)
		self.motorL = motor
	end
end

function Animator:SetMoving(on: boolean, speed: number?)
	self.moving = on
	self.speed = speed or 1
end

-- Bắt đầu đòn đánh. Trả về thời lượng (giây), hoặc nil nếu đang đánh hoặc chưa có vũ khí.
function Animator:Attack(): number?
	if self.destroyed or self.atk or not self.cfg then
		return nil
	end
	self.atk = self.t
	self.fired = {}
	return STYLES[self.cfg.style].dur
end

function Animator:IsAttacking(): boolean
	return self.atk ~= nil
end

function Animator:Update(dt: number)
	if self.destroyed then return end
	self.t += dt
	local t = self.t
	local cfg = self.cfg
	local m = self.Rig.Motors

	self.walkBlend += ((if self.moving then 1 else 0) - self.walkBlend) * (1 - math.exp(-10 * dt))
	local sw = math.sin(t * 6 * self.speed) * self.walkBlend

	-- Tư thế nghỉ của hai tay: {u, l, tilt, lean}
	local restR = if cfg and cfg.R then { 0.7, 0.8, 0.25, 0 } else { 0.15, 0.25, 0.25, 0 }
	local restL = if cfg and cfg.leftPose then { cfg.leftPose[1], cfg.leftPose[2], 0, 0 } else { 0.15, 0.25, 0, 0 }
	local R, L = restR, restL

	if self.atk and cfg then
		local style = STYLES[cfg.style]
		local p = (t - self.atk) / style.dur
		-- Process crossed marks even when this frame reaches/passes recovery.
		for i, mark in style.marks do
			if p >= mark and not self.fired[i] then
				self.fired[i] = true
				if self.OnHit then self.OnHit(i) end
			end
		end
		if self.destroyed then return end
		if p >= 1 then
			self.atk = nil
		else
			if style.dual then
				R = blend(restR, style.wind, style.hit, math.clamp(p / 0.55, 0, 1), style.t1, style.t2)
				L = blend(restL, style.wind, style.hit, math.clamp((p - 0.35) / 0.65, 0, 1), style.t1, style.t2)
				R = { R[1], R[2], R[3], (R[4] + L[4]) / 2 }
			else
				R = blend(restR, style.wind, style.hit, p, style.t1, style.t2)
			end
		end
	end

	-- Server advances hit timing; clients apply the visual pose in PreSimulation.
	if not self.RenderPose then return end
	local uR, lR, uL, lL = R[1], R[2], L[1], L[2]
	if not self.atk then
		uR -= sw * 0.12
		uL += sw * 0.12
	end

	m.Torso.Transform = CFrame.new(0, (if self.moving then math.abs(sw) * 0.1 else math.sin(t * 2) * 0.025), 0)
		* CFrame.Angles(R[4], 0, 0)
	m.ArmR.Transform = CFrame.Angles(uR, 0, 0)
	m.ForeR.Transform = CFrame.Angles(lR, 0, 0)
	m.ArmL.Transform = CFrame.Angles(uL, 0, 0)
	m.ForeL.Transform = CFrame.Angles(lL, 0, 0)
	m.LegR.Transform = CFrame.Angles(sw * 0.6, 0, 0)
	m.LegL.Transform = CFrame.Angles(-sw * 0.6, 0, 0)
	m.Head.Transform = CFrame.Angles(math.sin(t * 3) * 0.04, if self.atk then 0 else math.sin(t * 0.8) * 0.25, 0)
	m.Tail1.Transform = CFrame.Angles(0, math.sin(t * 3) * 0.18, 0)
	m.Tail2.Transform = CFrame.Angles(0, math.sin(t * 3 - 0.9) * 0.28, 0)

	-- Weapon-specific pose overrides from the full weapons reference.
	if cfg and self.atk then
		local p = math.clamp((t - self.atk) / STYLES[cfg.style].dur, 0, 1)
		if self.id=="Katana" or self.id=="SwordShield" then
			local recovery=math.clamp((1-p)/0.2,0,1)
			m.Torso.Transform *= CFrame.Angles(0,math.cos(p*math.pi)*-0.4*recovery,0)
			m.ArmR.Transform *= CFrame.Angles(0,0,-0.3*math.sin(p*math.pi))
		elseif self.id=="Glaive" then
			m.Torso.Transform *= CFrame.Angles(0,math.sin(p*math.pi)*0.45,0)
		elseif self.id=="Hammer" or self.id=="GreatAxe" then
			local jumpY=if p<0.45 then math.sin((p/0.45)*math.pi)*0.35 else 0
			m.Torso.Transform *= CFrame.new(0,jumpY,0)
		elseif self.id=="Bow" then
			m.Torso.Transform *= CFrame.Angles(0,-0.35*math.sin(p*math.pi),0)
		end
	end

	-- Vũ khí luôn bù góc để giữ hướng: xoay X (bù tay + tilt), rồi dịch dọc cán, rồi xoay Y.
	if cfg then
		local shift = CFrame.new(0, cfg.o * cfg.k, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, cfg.ry or 0, 0)
		if self.motorR then
			self.motorR.Transform = CFrame.Angles(-(uR + lR) - R[3], 0, 0) * shift
		end
		if self.motorL then
			self.motorL.Transform = CFrame.Angles(-(uL + lL) - L[3], 0, 0) * shift
		end
	end
end

function Animator:Destroy()
	if self.destroyed then return end
	self.destroyed = true
	self:CancelAttack()
	self.OnHit = nil
	for _, w in self.weaponModels do
		w:Destroy()
	end
	table.clear(self.weaponModels)
	self.motorR, self.motorL, self.cfg = nil, nil, nil
end

return Animator

-- Server-owned visits to the connected forest. Lighting is applied per client.
local Session = {}
Session.__index = Session

local ATTRIBUTES = {"HuntStartedAt", "HuntStartServerTime", "HuntEntryClockHours", "HuntTimeScale", "HuntDuration", "HuntRemainingSeconds", "HuntClockStoppedAt"}

local function wallTime()
	return DateTime.now().UnixTimestampMillis / 1000
end

function Session:RestartClock(player, duration)
	local visit = self.Players[player]; if not visit then return end
	local started = wallTime()
	visit.StartedAt, visit.Duration, visit.FrozenAt = started, duration or self.Duration, nil
	player:SetAttribute("HuntStartedAt", started)
	player:SetAttribute("HuntStartServerTime", workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
	player:SetAttribute("HuntEntryClockHours", ((started + (self.Config.TimezoneOffsetMinutes or 420) * 60) % 86400) / 3600)
	player:SetAttribute("HuntDuration", visit.Duration); player:SetAttribute("HuntRemainingSeconds", visit.Duration)
	player:SetAttribute("HuntClockStoppedAt", nil)
end

function Session:FreezeClock(player)
	local visit = self.Players[player]; if not visit or visit.FrozenAt then return end
	visit.FrozenAt = wallTime()
	player:SetAttribute("HuntClockStoppedAt", workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
end

function Session.new(forest, config, dinosaur, routeController)
	return setmetatable({
		Forest = forest, Config = config, Dinosaur = dinosaur, Routes = routeController,
		Players = {}, Count = 0, Patrol = nil,
		Duration = math.max(30, config.HuntDurationSeconds or 40 * 60),
	}, Session)
end

function Session:Enter(player)
	-- A Studio zone jump keeps the current visit and its original entry clock.
	if self.Players[player] then return end
	if not self.Patrol then
		self.Patrol = self.Routes.new(self.Dinosaur, self.Forest, self.Config)
		self.Patrol:Start()
		if self.Combat then self.Combat:Reset() end
	end
	local started = wallTime()
	self.Players[player] = {StartedAt = started, Duration = self.Duration}
	self.Count += 1
	player:SetAttribute("HuntStartedAt", started)
	player:SetAttribute("HuntStartServerTime", workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
	player:SetAttribute("HuntEntryClockHours", ((started + (self.Config.TimezoneOffsetMinutes or 420) * 60) % 86400) / 3600)
	player:SetAttribute("HuntTimeScale", self.Config.TimeScale or 30)
	player:SetAttribute("HuntDuration", self.Duration)
	player:SetAttribute("HuntRemainingSeconds", self.Duration)
	player:SetAttribute("InHunting", true)
	self.Forest:SetAttribute("ActiveHunters", self.Count)
end

function Session:Exit(player)
	if self.Combat then self.Combat:PlayerExited(player) end
	player:SetAttribute("InHunting", false)
	for _, attribute in ATTRIBUTES do player:SetAttribute(attribute, nil) end
	if self.Players[player] then
		self.Players[player] = nil
		self.Count -= 1
	end
	self.Forest:SetAttribute("ActiveHunters", self.Count)
	if self.Count == 0 and self.Patrol then
		if self.Combat then self.Combat:Reset() end
		self.Patrol:Destroy(true)
		self.Patrol = nil
	end
end

function Session:Expired()
	local now, expired = wallTime(), {}
	for player, visit in self.Players do
		local remaining = math.max(0, math.ceil(visit.Duration - ((visit.FrozenAt or now) - visit.StartedAt)))
		if player:GetAttribute("HuntRemainingSeconds") ~= remaining then player:SetAttribute("HuntRemainingSeconds", remaining) end
		if remaining == 0 then table.insert(expired, player) end
	end
	return expired
end

function Session:IsOutside(position)
	local offset = self.Config.WorldOffset or self.Forest:GetAttribute("WorldOffset") or Vector3.new(0, 0, 6500)
	local localPosition = position - offset
	local limitX = (self.Config.MapWidth or self.Config.MapSize or 1620) / 2 + 105
	local limitZ = (self.Config.MapDepth or self.Config.MapSize or 1620) / 2 + 105
	return localPosition.Y < (self.Config.TerrainMin or -48) - 20
		or math.abs(localPosition.X) > limitX or math.abs(localPosition.Z) > limitZ
end

function Session:Destroy()
	local players = {}
	for player in self.Players do table.insert(players, player) end
	for _, player in players do self:Exit(player) end
end

return Session

local Rules={}
local keys={Light="L",Heavy="H",Skill="S"}
function Rules.staminaCost(config,base) return base*config.StaminaCostScale end
function Rules.clearCombo(state)
 state.ComboChain=""; state.ComboStep=0; state.ComboUntil=0
end
function Rules.dodge(config,weapons,state,now)
 local cost=Rules.staminaCost(config,config.DodgeCost)
 if state.Charge or state.Blocking or now<state.BusyUntil or state.Stamina+1e-7<cost then return false end
 local chain=if now<=state.ComboUntil then state.ComboChain or "" else ""
 local nextChain=chain.."D"
 for _,combo in weapons[state.WeaponId].Combos do
  if #nextChain<#combo.Input and combo.Input:sub(1,#nextChain)==nextChain then chain=nextChain; break end
 end
 state.Stamina=math.max(0,state.Stamina-cost); state.BusyUntil=now+config.DodgeTime
 state.DodgingUntil=state.BusyUntil; state.LastSpend=state.BusyUntil; state.Sprinting=false
 state.ComboChain=chain; state.ComboStep=#chain; state.ComboUntil=state.BusyUntil+config.ComboWindow
 return true
end
function Rules.attack(config,weapons,state,action,now)
 if not keys[action] then return nil end
 if state.Charge or not state.Drawn or now<state.BusyUntil or state.Sprinting or state.Blocking then return nil end
 local weapon=weapons[state.WeaponId]; if not weapon or not weapon.Attacks then return nil end
 local chain=(if now<=state.ComboUntil then state.ComboChain or "" else "")..keys[action]
 local kind=action
 for _,combo in weapon.Combos do
  if chain==combo.Input then kind=combo.Attack; break end
 end
 local spec=weapon.Attacks[kind]; local cost=Rules.staminaCost(config,spec.Cost)
 if state.Stamina+1e-7<cost then return nil end
 state.Stamina=math.max(0,state.Stamina-cost); state.BusyUntil=now+spec.Duration; state.LastSpend=state.BusyUntil
 -- Keep the longest suffix that starts a recipe; rejected inputs never advance it.
 local prefix=""
 if kind==action then
  for start=1,#chain do
   local suffix=chain:sub(start)
   for _,combo in weapon.Combos do
    if #suffix<#combo.Input and combo.Input:sub(1,#suffix)==suffix and #suffix>#prefix then prefix=suffix end
   end
  end
 end
 state.ComboChain=prefix; state.ComboStep=#prefix; state.ComboUntil=state.BusyUntil+config.ComboWindow
 return kind,spec
end
function Rules.canEquip(state,weapons,id,now)
 return typeof(id)=="string" and weapons[id]~=nil and id~="Order" and (state.InTraining or state.InHunting)
  and not state.Drawn and not state.Blocking and not state.Sprinting and now>=state.BusyUntil
end
function Rules.regenerate(config,state,now,dt)
 if not state.Sprinting and not state.Blocking and now>=state.BusyUntil and now-state.LastSpend>=config.RegenDelay then
  state.Stamina=math.min(config.MaxStamina,state.Stamina+config.StaminaRegen*dt)
 end
end
function Rules.beginCharge(config,weapons,state,action,now)
 if state.WeaponId~="Bow" or action~="Light" then return nil end
 local kind,spec=Rules.attack(config,weapons,state,action,now);if not kind then return nil end
 local setting=weapons.Bow.Charge
 local charge={Kind=kind,Spec=spec,Started=now,Time=setting.Time,Multiplier=setting.Multiplier,MaxHold=setting.MaxHold}
 state.Charge=charge;state.BusyUntil=math.huge;return charge
end
function Rules.releaseCharge(config,state,now)
 local c=state.Charge;if not c then return nil end
 local alpha=math.clamp((now-c.Started)/c.Time,0,1)
 local spec=table.clone(c.Spec);spec.Damage=math.floor(spec.Damage*(1+(c.Multiplier-1)*alpha)+.5)
 state.Charge=nil;state.BusyUntil=now+spec.Duration;state.LastSpend=state.BusyUntil;state.ComboUntil=state.BusyUntil+config.ComboWindow
 return c.Kind,spec,alpha
end
function Rules.cancelCharge(state,now)
 if not state.Charge then return false end
 state.Charge=nil;state.BusyUntil=now+.15;state.LastSpend=now;Rules.clearCombo(state);return true
end
return Rules

-- Client visuals for server-approved dodges. No hitboxes or character invisibility.
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService=game:GetService("TweenService")
local Debris=game:GetService("Debris")
local player=Players.LocalPlayer
local entries={}
local effects=Instance.new("Folder");effects.Name="DarkStepFX";effects.Parent=workspace
local purple=Color3.fromRGB(48,34,69)

local function smoke(cf,count)
	local anchor=Instance.new("Part");anchor.Name="StepSmoke";anchor.Size=Vector3.one;anchor.CFrame=cf
	anchor.Transparency=1;anchor.Anchored=true;anchor.CanCollide=false;anchor.CanTouch=false;anchor.CanQuery=false;anchor.Parent=effects
	local emitter=Instance.new("ParticleEmitter");emitter.Name="ShadowSmoke";emitter.Texture="rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds"
	emitter.Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(21,19,28),purple);emitter.LightInfluence=0;emitter.LightEmission=.08
	emitter.Size=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,1.3),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.5,2.8),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,3.7)})
	emitter.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,.42),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.4,.7),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)})
	emitter.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(.22,.42);emitter.Speed=NumberRange.new(2,7);emitter.Drag=5;emitter.Rate=0
	emitter.SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(160,160);emitter.Rotation=NumberRange.new(-180,180);emitter.RotSpeed=NumberRange.new(-70,70)
	emitter.Parent=anchor;emitter:Emit(count);Debris:AddItem(anchor,.65)
end
local function snapshot(character)
	local ghost=Instance.new("Model");ghost.Name="Afterimage"
	local count=0
	for _,source in character:GetDescendants() do
		if source:IsA("BasePart") and source.Name~="HumanoidRootPart" and source.Transparency<.8 then
			local copy=source:Clone()
			if copy then
				for _,child in copy:GetChildren() do if not child:IsA("DataModelMesh") then child:Destroy() end end
				copy.Name="Shadow";copy.Anchored=true;copy.CanCollide=false;copy.CanTouch=false;copy.CanQuery=false;copy.CastShadow=false
				copy.Color=purple;copy.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic;copy.Reflectance=0;copy.Transparency=.64
				if copy:IsA("MeshPart") then copy.TextureID="" elseif copy:IsA("UnionOperation") then copy.UsePartColor=true end
				for _,mesh in copy:GetChildren() do if mesh:IsA("SpecialMesh") then mesh.TextureId="";mesh.VertexColor=Vector3.one end end
				copy.Parent=ghost;TweenService:Create(copy,TweenInfo.new(.38,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{Transparency=1}):Play()
				count+=1;if count>=64 then break end
			end
		end
	end
	ghost.Parent=effects;Debris:AddItem(ghost,.42)
end
local function restore(entry)
	for _,pose in entry.poses or {} do if pose.motor.Parent then pose.motor.Transform=pose.original end end
	for _,object in entry.ribbon or {} do if object.Parent then object:Destroy() end end
	entry.poses=nil;entry.ribbon=nil;entry.active=false
end
local function ribbon(root,duration)
	local a=Instance.new("Attachment");a.Name="DarkStepLeft";a.Position=Vector3.new(-.75,-.6,.2);a.Parent=root
	local b=Instance.new("Attachment");b.Name="DarkStepRight";b.Position=Vector3.new(.75,-.6,.2);b.Parent=root
	local trail=Instance.new("Trail");trail.Name="DarkStepTrail";trail.Attachment0=a;trail.Attachment1=b;trail.Lifetime=.16
	trail.FaceCamera=true;trail.MinLength=.15;trail.LightEmission=.08;trail.Color=ColorSequence.new(purple,Color3.fromRGB(108,81,140))
	trail.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,.72),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)});trail.Parent=root
	for _,object in {a,b,trail} do Debris:AddItem(object,duration+.4) end
	return {trail,a,b}
end
local function begin(entry,char,root,duration)
	restore(entry);entry.active=true;entry.poses={};entry.nextGhost=0;entry.lastGhost=nil;entry.endSmoke=false
	local motors={}
	for _,m in char:GetDescendants() do if m:IsA("Motor6D") or m:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then motors[m.Name]=m end end
	local lean=motors.Waist or motors.RootJoint or motors.Root
	if lean then table.insert(entry.poses,{motor=lean,original=lean.Transform,kind="Lean"}) end
	for _,pair in {{"RightShoulder","Right Shoulder",1},{"LeftShoulder","Left Shoulder",-1}} do
		local m=motors[pair[1]] or motors[pair[2]]
		if m then table.insert(entry.poses,{motor=m,original=m.Transform,kind="Arm",side=pair[3]}) end
	end
	entry.fx=player:GetAttribute("ShowComboFX")~=false
	if entry.fx then
		entry.ribbon=ribbon(root,duration)
		smoke(root.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,-2,0),12)
	end
end
-- Remove our last overlay before Animator evaluates its next frame.
local beforeAnimation=RunService.PreAnimation:Connect(function()
	for _,entry in entries do for _,pose in entry.poses or {} do if pose.motor.Parent then pose.motor.Transform=pose.original end end end
end)
local connection=RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function()
	local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow();local seen={}
	for _,p in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local char=p.Character;local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");local hum=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not root or not hum or hum.Health<=0 or (workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position-root.Position).Magnitude>180 then continue end
		seen[char]=true
		local seq=char:GetAttribute("DarkStepSequence")
		if not seq then continue end
		local entry=entries[char];if not entry then entry={};entries[char]=entry end
		local started=char:GetAttribute("DarkStepStarted") or 0
		local duration=char:GetAttribute("DarkStepDuration") or .4
		local elapsed=now-started
		if entry.seq~=seq then
			entry.seq=seq
			if elapsed>=-.1 and elapsed<duration then begin(entry,char,root,duration) else restore(entry) end
		end
		if not entry.active then continue end
		if elapsed>duration+.14 or elapsed<-.1 then restore(entry);continue end
		local blend=math.clamp(elapsed/.045,0,1)*math.clamp((duration+.14-elapsed)/.16,0,1)
		local direction=char:GetAttribute("DarkStepDirection") or root.CFrame.LookVector
		for _,pose in entry.poses do
			local m=pose.motor;if not m.Parent then continue end
			local parent,jointCF
			if m:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then
				local a=m.Attachment0;if not a or not a.Parent:IsA("BasePart") then continue end
				parent=a.Parent;jointCF=a.CFrame
			else parent=m.Part0;jointCF=m.C0 end
			if not parent then continue end
			pose.original=m.Transform
			local jointWorld=parent.CFrame*jointCF*pose.original
			local rotation
			if pose.kind=="Lean" then
				local localDirection=jointWorld:VectorToObjectSpace(direction)
				local up=jointWorld:VectorToObjectSpace(Vector3.yAxis)
				local axis=up:Cross(localDirection)
				rotation=if axis.Magnitude>.01 then CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis.Unit,math.rad(27)) else CFrame.new()
			else
				local axis=jointWorld:VectorToObjectSpace(root.CFrame.RightVector)
				rotation=CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis,-.55)
			end
			m.Transform=pose.original* CFrame.new():Lerp(rotation,blend)
		end
		if entry.fx then
			if elapsed<duration and elapsed>=entry.nextGhost then
				if not entry.lastGhost or (root.Position-entry.lastGhost).Magnitude>.65 then snapshot(char);entry.lastGhost=root.Position end
				entry.nextGhost=elapsed+.055
			elseif elapsed>=duration and not entry.endSmoke then
				entry.endSmoke=true;snapshot(char);smoke(root.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,-2,0),6)
				if entry.ribbon and entry.ribbon[1].Parent then entry.ribbon[1].Enabled=false end
			end
		end
	end
	for char,entry in entries do if not seen[char] then restore(entry);entries[char]=nil end end
end)
script.Destroying:Connect(function()
	connection:Disconnect();beforeAnimation:Disconnect();for _,entry in entries do restore(entry) end;effects:Destroy()
end)

function Service.new(options)

function Service:_repository()

  -- Deliberately explicit QA mode, never an automatic fallback after a DS error.
  self.TestRecords=self.TestRecords or {}
  local records=self.TestRecords
  backend={UpdateAsync=function(_,key,transform)
   if (self.TestFailWrites or 0)>0 then self.TestFailWrites-=1;error("Injected Studio QA outage") end
   local result=transform(copy(records[key]))
   if result~=nil then records[key]=copy(result) end
   return copy(result)
  end}
  self.Mode="TestMemory"
  local probe=Instance.new("BindableFunction");probe.Name="StudioProfileProbe";probe.Parent=script.Parent
  probe.OnInvoke=function(action,p,value)
   if action=="Snapshot" then return copy(self:Data(p)) end
   if action=="Save" then return self:Save(p) end
   if action=="Reload" then self:Release(p);return self:Load(p) end
   if action=="Outage" then self.TestFailWrites=value;return true end
   if action=="Records" then return copy(self.TestRecords) end
  end
 elseif RunService:IsStudio() and Config.StudioLocalFileEnabled==true then
  self.Mode="LocalFile"

 else

   return DataStoreService:GetDataStore(if RunService:IsStudio() then Config.StudioStoreName else Config.StoreName,Config.Scope)
  end)
  if not ok then return nil,"Unavailable" end

 end
 self.Repository=Store.new({Store=backend,Token=game.JobId..":"..HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
  Now=self.Now,Sleep=task.wait,Validate=self.Schema.Validate,Encode=self.Schema.Encode,
  LeaseSeconds=self.LeaseSeconds or Config.LeaseSeconds,MaxAttempts=4,BaseDelay=.5,MaxDelay=3})

end
function Service:_state(p,e,state,code)

 local notice=TEXT[state] or TEXT.Error
 if self.Mode=="LocalFile" then
  local messages={Loading="Đang tải dữ liệu trên máy…",Loaded="Đã tải tiến trình trên máy.",
   Dirty="Có thay đổi, đang chờ lưu trên máy…",Saving="Đang ghi tiến trình vào máy…",Saved="Đã lưu tiến trình trên máy.",
   Unavailable="Chưa kết nối bộ lưu trên máy. Mở CHOI_VA_LUU.cmd rồi bấm THỬ TẢI LẠI.",
   Error="Chưa ghi được dữ liệu trên máy. Kiểm tra bộ lưu rồi thử lại.",Closing="Đang lưu trên máy trước khi rời…"}
  messages.Conflict="Đang chờ phiên Studio trước đóng; hệ thống sẽ tự tải lại trong ít giây."

 end
 set(p,"ProfileStatusText",notice)
end
function Service:Data(p) local e=self.Entries[p];return if e and e.Ready then e.Data else nil end
function Service:Ready(p) return self:Data(p)~=nil end
function Service:CanPlay(p)
 local e=self.Entries[p]

end
function Service:CanMutate(p)
 local e=self.Entries[p]
 return e~=nil and e.Ready==true and not e.Saving and not e.Closing and not e.Pending
  and e.State~="Error" and e.State~="Conflict"

function Service:_apply(p,data)
 set(p,"WeaponId",data.Loadout.WeaponId);set(p,"PetWeaponId",data.Loadout.PetWeaponId)
 for _,target in {"Player","Pet"} do for _,slot in SLOTS do
  set(p,target.."Armor_"..slot,data.Loadout[target.."Armor"][slot])
 end end
 for key,value in data.Preferences do set(p,key,value) end
 set(p,"PetHealReadyAt",data.Pet.HealReadyAt)
end
function Service:_capture(p,e)
 for _,key in {"WeaponId","PetWeaponId"} do
  local value=p:GetAttribute(key);if value~=nil then e.Data.Loadout[key]=value end
 end
 for _,target in {"Player","Pet"} do for _,slot in SLOTS do
  local value=p:GetAttribute(target.."Armor_"..slot)
  if value~=nil then e.Data.Loadout[target.."Armor"][slot]=value end
 end end
 for key in PREFS do
  local value=p:GetAttribute(key);if value~=nil then e.Data.Preferences[key]=value end
 end
 local ready=p:GetAttribute("PetHealReadyAt")
 if type(ready)=="number" then
  e.Data.Pet.HealReadyAt=if ready>self.ServerNow() then math.ceil(self.Now()+ready-self.ServerNow()) else 0
 end
 e.Data.UpdatedAt=self.Now()
end
function Service:Touch(p)
 local e=self.Entries[p];if not e or not e.Ready or e.Closing then return end
 e.Generation+=1;e.DirtyAt=os.clock()
 if not e.Saving and not e.Pending then self:_state(p,e,"Dirty") end
end
function Service:_watch(p,e)
 e.Connections={}
 local keys={"WeaponId","PetWeaponId","PetHealReadyAt"}
 for key in PREFS do table.insert(keys,key) end
 for _,target in {"Player","Pet"} do for _,slot in SLOTS do table.insert(keys,target.."Armor_"..slot) end end
 for _,key in keys do table.insert(e.Connections,p:GetAttributeChangedSignal(key):Connect(function() self:Touch(p) end)) end
end
function Service:Load(p)
 local old=self.Entries[p]
 if old and (old.Ready or old.Loading) then return old.Ready==true end
 local e=old or {Generation=0,Key="player_"..tostring(p.UserId)}
 self.Entries[p]=e;e.Loading=true;self:_state(p,e,"Loading")
 local repository,code=self:_repository()
 if not repository then e.Loading=false;self:_state(p,e,code);return false end
 local ok,status,data
 if e.RecoveryData then
  data=e.RecoveryData;ok,status=repository:Save(e.Key,data)
 else
  ok,status,data=repository:Load(e.Key,self.Schema.Default(self.Now()))
 end
 if ok and not e.RecoveryData then
  local recovered,receipt=self.Schema.Recover(data)
  if not recovered then ok=false;status=receipt or "InvalidData"
  else
   data=recovered
   -- Recovery (return carried items, close old run) must itself be durable.
   if receipt then e.RecoveryData=data;e.NextRecoveryAt=os.clock()+Config.RetrySeconds;ok,status=repository:Save(e.Key,data) end
  end

 e.Loading=false

   e.Pending=nil;e.RecoveryData=nil;self:_state(p,e,"Conflict",status)
   if self.Mode=="LocalFile" and status=="Locked" then

     if not self.Stopped and p.Parent and self.Entries[p]==e and not e.Ready and not e.Loading then self:Load(p) end
    end)
   end

end
function Service:_failure(p,e,status)
 e.NextSave=os.clock()+Config.RetrySeconds

  e.Quarantined=e.Pending;e.Pending=nil;e.RecoveryData=nil

end
function Service:_installPending(p,e)
 local pending=e.Pending
 if not pending then return true end
 local ok,status=self.Repository:Save(e.Key,pending.Data)
 if not ok then self:_failure(p,e,status);return false end
 -- Canonical economy identity survives: runtime adapters retain this table.

 e.Data.Statistics=pending.Data.Statistics
 e.Pending=nil;e.Generation+=1;e.SavedGeneration=pending.Generation+1
 if self.OnEconomyCommitted then local called,err=pcall(self.OnEconomyCommitted,p);if not called then warn(err) end end

end
function Service:CommitEconomy(p,mutate)
 local e=self.Entries[p]

 local candidate=assert(self.Schema.Validate(e.Data))
 local receipt=mutate(candidate.Economy,candidate.Statistics)
 if not receipt or not receipt.Ok or receipt.Replay or receipt.Unchanged then return receipt end
 e.Pending={Data=candidate,Receipt=receipt,Generation=e.Generation}
 e.Saving=true;self:_state(p,e,"Saving")

 e.Saving=false
 if not ok then return {Ok=false,Code="SavePending",Replay=false} end
 set(p,"ProfileSavedAt",self.Now())
 self:_state(p,e,if e.Generation>e.SavedGeneration then "Dirty" else "Saved")
 if e.Generation==e.SavedGeneration then e.DirtyAt=nil end
 e.NextSave=os.clock()+(self.AutoSaveSeconds or Config.AutoSaveSeconds)

end
function Service:Save(p,release)
 local e=self.Entries[p]

 local data,invalid=self.Schema.Validate(e.Data)
 if not data then e.Saving=false;self:_failure(p,e,invalid or "InvalidData");return false,invalid end

 e.Saving=false
 if not ok then self:_failure(p,e,status);return false,status end
 e.SavedGeneration=generation;e.NextSave=os.clock()+(self.AutoSaveSeconds or Config.AutoSaveSeconds)
 if e.Generation==generation then e.DirtyAt=nil end
 set(p,"ProfileSavedAt",self.Now())
 self:_state(p,e,if e.Generation==generation then "Saved" else "Dirty")

end
function Service:Release(p)
 local e=self.Entries[p];if not e or e.Releasing then return end

 while e.Saving and os.clock()<deadline do task.wait(.05) end
 local ok=false
 if not e.Saving then
  if e.RecoveryData then
   ok=self.Repository:Save(e.Key,e.RecoveryData,true)
  elseif e.Ready then ok=self:Save(p,true)
  else ok=true end -- No profile was acquired; nothing can be written.
 end
 if ok then
  for _,connection in e.Connections or {} do connection:Disconnect() end
  self.Entries[p]=nil

  warn("[HunDino Save] Final save pending; retained for retry",e.Key)
  task.delay(Config.RetrySeconds,function() if self.Entries[p]==e then self:Release(p) end end)

end
function Service:Request(p,action,key,value)
 local e=self.Entries[p]
 if type(action)~="string" then return end
 if action=="RetryLoad" then
  if e and os.clock()-(e.LastLoadRequest or -math.huge)<5 then return end
  if e then e.LastLoadRequest=os.clock() end
  if self:Ready(p) then self:Save(p) else self:Load(p) end
 elseif action=="Save" then
  if not e or os.clock()-(e.LastManual or -math.huge)<5 then return end
  e.LastManual=os.clock();self:Save(p)
 elseif action=="Preference" then
  if not self:CanMutate(p) or not PREFS[key] then return end
  if key=="AimSensitivity" then
   if value~=1 and value~=.75 and value~=.5 then return end
  elseif type(value)~="boolean" then return end

  e.LastPreference=os.clock();set(p,key,value)

end
function Service:Shutdown(beforeRelease)

  if e.Ready or e.RecoveryData then
   pending+=1
   task.spawn(function()
    if beforeRelease then local ok,err=pcall(beforeRelease,p);if not ok then warn(err) end end
    self:Release(p);pending-=1
   end)
  end

 local deadline=os.clock()+25
 while pending>0 and os.clock()<deadline do task.wait(.1) end
end
return Service

-- Solo mission coordinator; P1-E uses a server-memory economy adapter.
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local CaptureController = require(script.Parent.HuntCaptureController)
local HarvestController = require(script.Parent.HuntHarvestController)
local Service = {}
Service.__index = Service
local function now() return workspace:GetServerTimeNow() end
local function alive(s)
	return s and s.Character and s.Character.Parent and s.Root and s.Root.Parent
		and s.Humanoid and s.Humanoid.Health > 0
end
local function set(player, key, value)
	if player.Parent and player:GetAttribute(key) ~= value then player:SetAttribute(key, value) end
end
function Service.new(options)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Service)
	for key, value in options do self[key] = value end
	self.Active = nil
	self:_createBoard()
	return self
end
function Service:Run(player)
	return if self.Active and self.Active.Player == player then self.Active.Run else nil
end
function Service:OwnsVisit(player)
	local run = self:Run(player)
	return run ~= nil and not run.Closed
end
function Service:ShouldResume(player)
	local run = self:Run(player)
	return run ~= nil and (run.State == "Hunting" or run.State == "Harvest")
end
function Service:CanEnter(player)
	if self.Active and not self.Active.Run.Closed and self.Active.Player ~= player then
		return false, "Đang có lượt săn thử solo. Hãy đợi người săn trở về sảnh."
	end
	return true
end
function Service:_publish(entry)
	local player, run = entry.Player, entry.Run
	set(player, "QuestRunId", run.Id); set(player, "QuestMonsterId", run.MonsterId)
	set(player, "QuestTarget", "T-REX · Không hệ")
	set(player, "QuestState", run.State); set(player, "QuestResult", run.Result)
	set(player, "QuestDeaths", run.Deaths); set(player, "QuestDeadline", run.Deadline)
	set(player, "QuestHarvestUntil", run.HarvestUntil or 0)
	set(player, "QuestFailureReason", run.FailureReason)
	set(player, "HuntTraps", run.Traps); set(player, "HuntPotions", run.Potions)
	if not run.Action then set(player, "HuntCaptureActive", false) end
	if entry.LastState ~= run.State then
		entry.LastState = run.State
		self.Remote:FireClient(player, "QuestState", self.Rules.snapshot(run, now()))
	end
end
function Service:_lobbyReady(player)
	local s = self.GetState(player)
	if not alive(s) or s.InTraining or s.InHunting or s.Travelling
		or s.Drawn or s.ChangeDraw ~= nil or s.Charge or s.Blocking or s.Sprinting
		or os.clock() < s.BusyUntil or player:GetAttribute("AdminFlying") == true then
		return false, "Về sảnh, cất vũ khí và dừng động tác để nhận nhiệm vụ."
	end
	if (s.Root.Position - self.Map.Lobby.Arrival.Position).Magnitude > 160 then
		return false, "Đến bảng nhiệm vụ ở sảnh trung tâm."
	end
	return true
end
function Service:OpenBoard(player)
	local ready, reason = self:_lobbyReady(player)
	if not ready then self.Message(player, reason); return false end
	local available = not self.Active or self.Active.Run.Closed
	if not available then reason = "Đang có lượt săn solo; hãy kết thúc lượt hiện tại trước." end
	if self.Session.Count > 0 then available = false; reason = "Khu săn đang có người thám hiểm. Đợi khu săn trống để bắt đầu lượt solo." end
	if available and player:GetAttribute("SpecimenFull")==true then reason="Kho cá thể đã đầy. Bạn vẫn nhận săn tiêu diệt được; hiện không thể bắt thêm." end
	self.Remote:FireClient(player, "QuestBoard", {CanAccept = available, Reason = reason})
	return true
end
function Service:_canUseItems(entry)
 if self.Economy and not self.Economy:IsReady(entry.Player) then return false end
	local s = self.GetState(entry.Player)
	return self.Active == entry and entry.Run.State == "Hunting" and alive(s) and s.InHunting
		and not s.Travelling and not s.Drawn and s.ChangeDraw == nil and not s.Charge
		and not s.Blocking and not s.Sprinting and os.clock() >= s.BusyUntil
		and os.clock() >= (s.DodgingUntil or 0) and entry.Player:GetAttribute("AdminFlying") ~= true
end
function Service:_capture(entry)
	if self.Active ~= entry or entry.Run.Result ~= "Captured" then return end
	assert(self.Combat:Capture(entry.Run.Id, entry.Run.FinishedAt), "Capture result must match the locked server monster")
	self:_result(entry)
end
function Service:_result(entry)
	if entry.ResultPublished then return end
	if self.Economy and not self.Economy:Result(entry.Player,entry.Run) then return end
 if self.Active~=entry then return end
	entry.ResultPublished = true
	self.Session:FreezeClock(entry.Player)
	self.Combat.Model:SetAttribute("QuestCombatAllowed", false)
	self.Combat:PlayerExited(entry.Player)
	if entry.Capture then entry.Capture:Cancel("Result") end
	set(entry.Player, "HuntCaptureActive", false)
	if self.OnResult then self.OnResult(entry.Player) end
	if entry.Run.State == "Failed" then entry.ReturnAfter = now() + 5 end
	self:_publish(entry)
end
function Service:Accept(player)
	local ready, reason = self:_lobbyReady(player)
	if not ready then self.Message(player, reason); return false end
	if self.Active and not self.Active.Run.Closed then self.Message(player, "Chỉ có một lượt săn thử solo tại một thời điểm."); return false end
	if self.Session.Count ~= 0 then self.Message(player, "Khu săn cần trống trước khi nhận nhiệm vụ solo."); return false end
	local run = self.Rules.new(HttpService:GenerateGUID(false), HttpService:GenerateGUID(false), now())
	if self.Economy then
		local prepared, reason = self.Economy:Begin(player,run)
		if not prepared then self.Message(player,reason); return false end
	end
	local entry = {Player = player, Run = run}
	self.Active = entry
	self.Combat.Model:SetAttribute("QuestOwnerUserId", player.UserId)
	self.Combat.Model:SetAttribute("QuestCombatAllowed", true)
	self.Combat.Model:SetAttribute("MonsterInstanceId", run.MonsterId)
	self:_publish(entry)
	task.spawn(function()
		local moved = self.Travel(player, "Hunting", nil, "Hạ hoặc bắt T-REX. Quặng ở phía bắc trại; đồ nhặt được giữ cả khi thua.")
		task.wait(.55)
		if self.Active ~= entry or run.Closed then return end
		local s = self.GetState(player)
		if not moved or not alive(s) or not s.InHunting then
			self.Rules.fail(run, "EntryInterrupted", now()); self:_result(entry); return
		end
		if not self.Rules.start(run, now()) then return end
		if self.Economy and not self.Economy:Start(player,run) then
			self.Rules.fail(run,"EntryInterrupted",now()); self:_result(entry); return
		end
		self.Session:RestartClock(player, self.Rules.Config.Duration)
		entry.Capture = CaptureController.new({
			Player = player, Run = run, Rules = self.Rules, Combat = self.Combat,
			Forest = self.Forest, PetFolder = self.PetFolder,
			Character = function() local state = self.GetState(player); return state and state.Character end,
			CanUseItems = function() return self:_canUseItems(entry) end,
			CanCapture = function() return self.Economy:CanCapture(player,run) end,
   OnItemsChanged = function() return self.Economy:Sync(player,run) end,
			OnCapture = function() self:_capture(entry) end,
			OnMessage = function(text) self.Message(player, text) end,
		})
		local harvestReady,harvest=pcall(HarvestController.new,{
			Player=player,Run=run,Combat=self.Combat,Forest=self.Forest,PetFolder=self.PetFolder,

function Service:Step(dt)
 if self._stepping then return end
 self._stepping=true
 local ok,err=xpcall(function() self:_step(dt) end,debug.traceback)
 self._stepping=false
 if not ok then warn("[HunDino Quest]",err) end
end
function Service:_step(dt)
	local entry = self.Active
	if not entry then return end
	local run, time = entry.Run, now()
	if not entry.Player.Parent then self:RemovePlayer(entry.Player); return end
	if run.State == "Hunting" and self.Combat:GetSnapshot().Health <= 0 then
		if self.Rules.finish(run, "Defeated", time) then self:_result(entry) end
	end
	self.Rules.tick(run, time)
	if entry.Capture then entry.Capture:Step(time, dt) end
	if entry.Harvest then entry.Harvest:Step(time,dt) end
	if self.Economy then self.Economy:Sync(entry.Player,run) end
	if run.Result and not entry.ResultPublished then self:_result(entry) end
	if run.State == "Returning" or (run.State == "Failed" and time >= (entry.ReturnAfter or math.huge)) then
		self:Return(entry.Player)
	end
	self:_publish(entry)
end

	local entry = self.Active

  -- Disk recovery owns the reserved items if a last write is still pending.
  -- Release runtime ownership so a departed player cannot block everyone else.
  if entry.Capture then entry.Capture:Destroy();entry.Capture=nil end

  self.Combat.Model:SetAttribute("QuestCombatAllowed",nil)
