-- Studio-only disk backend. The companion helper performs atomic compare-and-swap.
-- Published Roblox servers always use DataStoreService in ProfileService.
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local LocalStore = {}

function LocalStore.new()
	assert(RunService:IsStudio(), "Local saves are only available in Studio")
	local base = "http://127.0.0.1:18764"
	local function request(method, path, body)
		local response = HttpService:RequestAsync({
			Url = base .. path, Method = method,
			Headers = {["Content-Type"] = "application/json", ["X-HunDino-Local"] = "v1"},
			Body = if body then HttpService:JSONEncode(body) else nil,
		})
		if response.StatusCode == 409 then return nil, "Retry" end
		assert(response.Success, "Local save helper failed: " .. tostring(response.StatusCode))
		return HttpService:JSONDecode(response.Body)
	end
	local health = request("GET", "/health")
	assert(health and health.service == "HunDinoLocalSaveV1", "Wrong local save helper")
	local backend = {}
	function backend:UpdateAsync(key, transform)
		local path = "/profile/" .. HttpService:UrlEncode(key)
		for _ = 1, 8 do
			local current = request("GET", path)
			local nextValue = transform(if current.exists then current.value else nil)
			-- A nil callback result cancels the write, just like DataStore UpdateAsync.
			if nextValue == nil then return nil end
			local result, reason = request("POST", path, {version = current.version, value = nextValue})
			if reason ~= "Retry" then return result.value end
			task.wait(.05)
		end
		error("Local save has too many concurrent updates")
	end
	return backend
end

return LocalStore

-- Server-private, temporary map inspection permissions and command parsing.
-- Disable Enabled or remove the AdminFly runtime to retire this tool.
-- There is deliberately no Studio-wide permission: every user is checked.
local Policy = {
	Enabled = true,
	AdminUserIds = {[11605296816] = true},
	AllowExperienceOwner = true,
	Speeds = {80, 160, 260},
	DefaultSpeed = 160,
	BoostMultiplier = 2,
	MaxAltitude = 1800,
	MaxHorizontal = 12000,
}

local function positiveInteger(value)
	return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value > 0
		and value < math.huge and value % 1 == 0
end

-- creatorTypeString must be game.CreatorType.Name ("User" or "Group").
-- Group ownership never grants its numeric group ID permission as a user ID.
function Policy.Allowed(userId, creatorId, creatorTypeString)
	if Policy.Enabled ~= true or not positiveInteger(userId) then return false end
	if Policy.AdminUserIds[userId] == true then return true end
	return Policy.AllowExperienceOwner == true and creatorTypeString == "User"
		and positiveInteger(creatorId) and userId == creatorId
end

function Policy.ValidateSpeed(speed)
	return positiveInteger(speed) and (speed == 80 or speed == 160 or speed == 260)
end

-- Returns ("Toggle", nil), ("SetEnabled", boolean), ("SetSpeed", number),
-- or (nil, nil). SetSpeed is a fly command with the selected base speed.
-- Only complete commands match; /flyer and additional arguments are ignored.
function Policy.ParseChat(message)
	if type(message) ~= "string" then return nil, nil end
	local command = message:lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"):gsub("%s+", " ")
	if command == "/fly" then return "Toggle", nil end
	if command == "/fly on" then return "SetEnabled", true end
	if command == "/fly off" or command == "/unfly" then return "SetEnabled", false end
	for _, speed in Policy.Speeds do
		if Policy.ValidateSpeed(speed) and (command == "/fly" .. speed or command == "/fly " .. speed) then
			return "SetSpeed", speed
		end
	end
	return nil, nil
end

return Policy

-- Client presentation only. Injector yaw follows the specimen but its height
-- never bobs: Beam endpoints bend between a fixed ceiling and moving implants.
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local TAG = "HunDinoBioSpecimen"
local MAX_DISTANCE = 240
local tracked = {}
local connections = {}
local running = true
local nextMembershipUpdate = 0
local nearby = {}

local function disconnectEntry(entry)
	if entry.changed then entry.changed:Disconnect() end
	if entry.added then entry.added:Disconnect() end
	if entry.removed then entry.removed:Disconnect() end
end

local function remove(model)
	local entry = tracked[model]
	if not entry then return end
	disconnectEntry(entry)
	tracked[model] = nil
end

local function register(model)
	if tracked[model] or not model:IsA("Model") then return end
	local entry = {model = model, dirty = true, valid = false, nextFrame = 0, distance = math.huge}
	local function dirty() entry.dirty = true end
	entry.changed = model.AttributeChanged:Connect(dirty)
	-- Tag replication may precede children and attributes; a partial clone is
	-- retried after every descendant arrives instead of being permanently skipped.
	entry.added = model.DescendantAdded:Connect(dirty)
	entry.removed = model.DescendantRemoving:Connect(dirty)
	tracked[model] = entry
end

local function hydrate(entry)
	entry.dirty = false
	entry.valid = false
	local assembly = entry.model
	if not assembly:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) or assembly:GetAttribute("Ready") ~= true then return end
	local specimen, injector = assembly:FindFirstChild("Specimen"), assembly:FindFirstChild("RotatingInjector")
	local origin = assembly:GetAttribute("StaticOrigin")
	local rest = assembly:GetAttribute("SpecimenRestPivot")
	local injectorRest = assembly:GetAttribute("InjectorRestPivot")
	local slot = assembly:GetAttribute("DisplaySlot")
	if not specimen or not specimen:IsA("Model") or not injector or not injector:IsA("Model")
		or typeof(origin) ~= "CFrame" or typeof(rest) ~= "CFrame" or typeof(injectorRest) ~= "CFrame"
		or type(slot) ~= "number" or slot < 1 or slot > 5 then return end
	-- The tube index is authoritative for presentation, including #5's exact
	-- zero yaw. Metadata cannot accidentally make the center exhibit rotate.
	entry.specimen, entry.injector = specimen, injector
	entry.origin, entry.rest, entry.injectorRest = origin, rest, injectorRest
	entry.speed = if slot == 5 then 0 else math.rad(10)
	entry.amplitude = .12
	entry.frequency = .22
	entry.valid = true
end

table.insert(connections, CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(TAG):Connect(register))
table.insert(connections, CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal(TAG):Connect(remove))
for _, model in CollectionService:GetTagged(TAG) do register(model) end

table.insert(connections, RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if not running then return end
	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now >= nextMembershipUpdate then
		nextMembershipUpdate = now + .35
		table.clear(nearby)
		for model, entry in tracked do
			if not model.Parent then remove(model); continue end
			if entry.dirty or not entry.valid then hydrate(entry) end
			if entry.valid then
				entry.distance = (camera.CFrame.Position - entry.origin.Position).Magnitude
				if entry.distance <= MAX_DISTANCE then table.insert(nearby, entry) end
			end
		end
	end
	-- A shared server clock produces the same heading for all observers and
	-- catches a streamed-in tube up immediately without server per-frame traffic.
	local phase = Workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	for _, entry in nearby do
		if tracked[entry.model] ~= entry or not entry.model.Parent then continue end
		if entry.dirty then hydrate(entry) end
		if not entry.valid or now < entry.nextFrame then continue end
		entry.nextFrame = now + (if entry.distance <= 95 then 1 / 30 else 1 / 15)
		local yaw = (phase * entry.speed) % (math.pi * 2)
		local bob = math.sin(phase * math.pi * 2 * entry.frequency) * entry.amplitude
		local rotation = entry.origin * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) * entry.origin:Inverse()
		entry.specimen:PivotTo(entry.origin * CFrame.new(0, bob, 0) * entry.origin:Inverse() * rotation * entry.rest)
		entry.injector:PivotTo(rotation * entry.injectorRest)
	end
end))

script.Destroying:Connect(function()
	running = false
	for _, connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end
	for _, entry in tracked do disconnectEntry(entry) end
	table.clear(tracked)
	table.clear(nearby)
end)

-- P1-D mission/capture rules. Server runtime owns the clock, player, monster,
-- movement, distance, damage and ground checks. This module never yields and
-- does not finish physical interactions until the runtime explicitly commits.
local Rules = {}

Rules.Config = table.freeze({
	Duration = 2400,
	HarvestSeconds = 120,
	MaxDeaths = 4,
	RespawnDelay = 5,
	TrapPlaceSeconds = 1,
	TrapLifetime = 60,
	TrapHoldSeconds = 13,
	CaptureSeconds = 3,
	WeakRatio = 0.1,
	TrapCount = 3,
	PotionCount = 3,
})
local Config = Rules.Config
local States = {Preparing = true, Hunting = true, Harvest = true, Returning = true, Failed = true, Closed = true}

local function finite(value)
	return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge
end

local function validTime(value)
	return finite(value) and value >= 0
end

local function integer(value, maximum)
	return finite(value) and value >= 0 and value % 1 == 0 and (maximum == nil or value <= maximum)
end

local function validId(value, maximum)
	return type(value) == "string" and #value > 0 and #value <= (maximum or 128) and not string.find(value, "%c")
end

local function successful(run)
	return run.Result == "Defeated" or run.Result == "Captured"
end

local function validRun(run)
	if type(run) ~= "table" or not validId(run.Id) or not validId(run.MonsterId)
		or not States[run.State] or type(run.Closed) ~= "boolean" or type(run.Returned) ~= "boolean"
		or not validTime(run.CreatedAt) or not validTime(run.StartedAt) or not validTime(run.Deadline)
		or not integer(run.Deaths, Config.MaxDeaths) or not integer(run.Traps, Config.TrapCount)
		or not integer(run.Potions, Config.PotionCount) or not integer(run.TrapSerial)
		or not integer(run.ActionSerial) then return false end
	if run.Result ~= nil and run.Result ~= "Failed" and not successful(run) then return false end
	if run.Closed ~= (run.State == "Closed") then return false end
	if (run.State == "Preparing" or run.State == "Hunting") and run.Result ~= nil then return false end
	if run.State == "Hunting" and (run.StartedAt < run.CreatedAt or run.Deadline < run.StartedAt) then return false end
	if (run.State == "Harvest" or run.State == "Returning")
		and (not successful(run) or not validTime(run.FinishedAt) or not validTime(run.HarvestUntil)) then return false end
	if run.State == "Failed" and run.Result ~= "Failed" then return false end
	local action = run.Action
	if action ~= nil and (type(action) ~= "table" or (action.Kind ~= "Place" and action.Kind ~= "Capture")
		or not validTime(action.StartedAt) or not validTime(action.FinishAt)
		or action.FinishAt < action.StartedAt or not integer(action.Serial)
		or action.Serial ~= run.ActionSerial) then return false end
	local trap = run.ActiveTrap
	if trap ~= nil and (type(trap) ~= "table" or not validId(trap.Id, 160)
		or (trap.State ~= "Waiting" and trap.State ~= "Holding")
		or not validTime(trap.PlacedAt) or not validTime(trap.ExpiresAt)
		or trap.ExpiresAt < trap.PlacedAt
		or (trap.State == "Holding" and (not validTime(trap.TriggeredAt)
			or not validTime(trap.HeldUntil) or trap.TriggeredAt < trap.PlacedAt
			or trap.HeldUntil < trap.TriggeredAt))) then return false end
	return true
end

local function checkTime(run, now)
	if not validRun(run) then return false, "InvalidRun" end
	if not validTime(now) or now < run.CreatedAt
		or (run.State ~= "Preparing" and run.StartedAt > now) then return false, "InvalidTime" end
	if run.Closed then return false, "Closed" end
	return true, nil
end

local function checkHunting(run, now)
	local allowed, reason = checkTime(run, now)
	if not allowed then return false, reason end
	if run.State ~= "Hunting" then return false, "NotHunting" end
	-- A valid completion delivered exactly at the deadline wins. No backdating.
	if now > run.Deadline then return false, "Expired" end
	return true, nil
end

local function clearAction(run)
	if run.Action == nil then return false end
	run.Action = nil
	run.ActionSerial += 1
	return true
end

local function beginAction(run, kind, now, duration)
	run.ActionSerial += 1
	run.Action = {Kind = kind, StartedAt = now, FinishAt = now + duration, Serial = run.ActionSerial}
	return true, nil, run.ActionSerial
end

local function checkAction(run, kind, now, expectedSerial)
	local action = run.Action
	if not action then return false, "NoAction" end
	if expectedSerial ~= nil and (not integer(expectedSerial) or action.Serial ~= expectedSerial) then
		return false, "StaleAction"
	end
	if action.Kind ~= kind then return false, "WrongAction" end
	if now < action.FinishAt then return false, "NotReady" end
	return true, nil
end

local function checkHolding(run, now)
	local trap = run.ActiveTrap
	if not trap then return false, "NoTrap" end
	if trap.State ~= "Holding" then return false, "NotTrapped" end
	if now < trap.TriggeredAt then return false, "InvalidTime" end
	if now > trap.HeldUntil then return false, "TrapEscaped" end
	return true, nil
end

local function checkWeak(hp, maxhp)
	if not finite(hp) or not finite(maxhp) or maxhp <= 0 or hp <= 0 or hp > maxhp then
		return false, "InvalidHealth"
	end
	if hp / maxhp > Config.WeakRatio then return false, "NotWeak" end
	return true, nil
end

function Rules.new(runId, monsterId, now)
	if not validId(runId) or not validId(monsterId) or not validTime(now) then return nil, "InvalidInput" end
	return {
		Id = runId, MonsterId = monsterId, State = "Preparing", Result = nil,
		CreatedAt = now, StartedAt = 0, Deadline = 0, Deaths = 0,
		Traps = Config.TrapCount, Potions = Config.PotionCount, TrapSerial = 0,
		ActionSerial = 0, ActiveTrap = nil, Action = nil, Closed = false, Returned = false,
	}, nil
end

function Rules.start(run, now)
	local allowed = checkTime(run, now)
	if not allowed or run.State ~= "Preparing" then return false end
	run.State = "Hunting"
	run.StartedAt = now
	run.Deadline = now + Config.Duration
	return true
end

function Rules.cancelAction(run)
	if not validRun(run) or run.Closed then return false end
	return clearAction(run)
end

function Rules.finish(run, result, now)
	if result ~= "Defeated" and result ~= "Captured" then return false end
	if not checkHunting(run, now) then return false end
	run.Result = result
	run.State = "Harvest"
	run.FinishedAt = now
	run.HarvestUntil = now + Config.HarvestSeconds
	clearAction(run)
	run.ActiveTrap = nil
	return true
end

function Rules.fail(run, reason, now)
	if not checkTime(run, now) or not validId(reason) or successful(run)
		or run.Result ~= nil or (run.State ~= "Preparing" and run.State ~= "Hunting") then return false end
	run.Result = "Failed"
	run.State = "Failed"
	run.FailureReason = reason
	run.FinishedAt = now
	clearAction(run)
	run.ActiveTrap = nil
	return true
end

function Rules.death(run, now)
	if not checkTime(run, now) then return nil end
	if run.State == "Harvest" then
		clearAction(run)
		return "Camp"
	end
	if run.State ~= "Hunting" then return nil end
	if now > run.Deadline then
		Rules.fail(run, "TimeExpired", now)
		return "Failed"
	end
	run.Deaths += 1
	clearAction(run)
	if run.Deaths >= Config.MaxDeaths then
		Rules.fail(run, "DeathLimit", now)
		return "Failed"
	end
	return "Camp"
end

function Rules.tick(run, now)
	if not checkTime(run, now) then return nil end
	if run.State == "Harvest" then
		if now >= run.HarvestUntil then
			run.State = "Returning"
			return "Returning"
		end
		return nil
	end
	if run.State ~= "Hunting" then return nil end
	if now > run.Deadline then
		Rules.fail(run, "TimeExpired", now)
		return "Failed"
	end
	local trap = run.ActiveTrap
	if trap then
		if trap.State == "Waiting" and now > trap.ExpiresAt then
			run.ActiveTrap = nil
			if run.Action and run.Action.Kind == "Capture" then clearAction(run) end
			return "TrapExpired"
		elseif trap.State == "Holding" and now > trap.HeldUntil then
			run.ActiveTrap = nil
			if run.Action and run.Action.Kind == "Capture" then clearAction(run) end
			return "TrapEscaped"
		end
	end
	-- Runtime revalidates geometry/ownership/HP before the explicit commit calls.
	return nil
end

function Rules.beginPlace(run, now)
	local allowed, reason = checkHunting(run, now)
	if not allowed then return false, reason end
	if run.Action then return false, "Busy" end
	if run.ActiveTrap then return false, "TrapActive" end
	if run.Traps <= 0 then return false, "NoTraps" end
	return beginAction(run, "Place", now, Config.TrapPlaceSeconds)
end

function Rules.commitPlace(run, now, expectedSerial)
	local allowed, reason = checkHunting(run, now)
	if not allowed then return nil, reason end
	allowed, reason = checkAction(run, "Place", now, expectedSerial)
	if not allowed then return nil, reason end
	if run.ActiveTrap then return nil, "TrapActive" end
	if run.Traps <= 0 then return nil, "NoTraps" end
	run.TrapSerial += 1
	local trap = {
		Id = run.Id .. ":trap:" .. tostring(run.TrapSerial), State = "Waiting",
		PlacedAt = now, ExpiresAt = now + Config.TrapLifetime,
	}
	run.Traps -= 1
	run.ActiveTrap = trap
	clearAction(run)
	return trap, nil
end

function Rules.triggerTrap(run, now)
	local allowed, reason = checkHunting(run, now)
	if not allowed then return false, reason end
	local trap = run.ActiveTrap
	if not trap then return false, "NoTrap" end
	if trap.State ~= "Waiting" then return false, "TrapNotWaiting" end
	if now > trap.ExpiresAt then return false, "TrapExpired" end
	if now < trap.PlacedAt then return false, "InvalidTime" end
	trap.State = "Holding"
	trap.TriggeredAt = now
	trap.HeldUntil = now + Config.TrapHoldSeconds
	return true, nil
end

function Rules.beginCapture(run, now, hp, maxhp)
	local allowed, reason = checkHunting(run, now)
	if not allowed then return false, reason end
	if run.Action then return false, "Busy" end
	allowed, reason = checkHolding(run, now)
	if not allowed then return false, reason end
	allowed, reason = checkWeak(hp, maxhp)
	if not allowed then return false, reason end
	if run.Potions <= 0 then return false, "NoPotions" end
	return beginAction(run, "Capture", now, Config.CaptureSeconds)
end

function Rules.commitCapture(run, now, hp, maxhp, expectedSerial)
	local allowed, reason = checkHunting(run, now)
	if not allowed then return false, reason end
	allowed, reason = checkAction(run, "Capture", now, expectedSerial)
	if not allowed then return false, reason end
	allowed, reason = checkHolding(run, now)
	if not allowed then return false, reason end
	allowed, reason = checkWeak(hp, maxhp)
	if not allowed then return false, reason end
	if run.Potions <= 0 then return false, "NoPotions" end
	-- No yields occur between final validation, result lock and item consumption.
	if not Rules.finish(run, "Captured", now) then return false, "NotHunting" end
	run.Potions -= 1
	return true, nil
end

function Rules.close(run)
	if not validRun(run) or run.Closed then return false end
	clearAction(run)
	run.ActiveTrap = nil
	run.State = "Closed"
	run.Closed = true
	run.Returned = true
	return true
end

-- Copies nested records so a consumer cannot accidentally change live rules.
function Rules.snapshot(run, now)
	if not validRun(run) or not validTime(now) or now < run.CreatedAt then return nil end
	return {
		Id = run.Id, MonsterId = run.MonsterId, State = run.State, Result = run.Result,
		CreatedAt = run.CreatedAt, StartedAt = run.StartedAt, Deadline = run.Deadline,
		FinishedAt = run.FinishedAt, HarvestUntil = run.HarvestUntil,
		FailureReason = run.FailureReason, Deaths = run.Deaths, Traps = run.Traps,
		Potions = run.Potions, Closed = run.Closed, Returned = run.Returned,
		Remaining = run.State == "Hunting" and math.max(0, run.Deadline - now) or 0,
		HarvestRemaining = run.State == "Harvest" and math.max(0, run.HarvestUntil - now) or 0,
		Action = run.Action and table.clone(run.Action) or nil,
		ActiveTrap = run.ActiveTrap and table.clone(run.ActiveTrap) or nil,
	}
end

return Rules

local function orbit(v,yaw,pitch)
	local center=v:GetAttribute("OrbitCenter");local distance=v:GetAttribute("OrbitDistance")
	if not center or not distance then return end
	local angle,elevation=math.rad(yaw),math.rad(pitch)
	local direction=Vector3.new(math.sin(angle)*math.cos(elevation),math.sin(elevation),-math.cos(angle)*math.cos(elevation))
	local boundsSize,boundsCF=v:GetAttribute("OrbitBoundsSize"),v:GetAttribute("OrbitBoundsCFrame")
	if boundsSize and boundsCF then
		local orientation=CFrame.lookAt(center+direction,center).Rotation
		local pixels=v.AbsoluteSize
		local aspect=if pixels.X>0 and pixels.Y>0 then pixels.X/pixels.Y else v.Size.X.Offset/math.max(v.Size.Y.Offset,1)
		local tanV=math.tan(math.rad(v.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView*.5))
		local tanH=tanV*math.max(aspect,.1)
		local half=boundsSize*.5
		distance=1
		for _,x in {-1,1} do for _,y in {-1,1} do for _,z in {-1,1} do
			local corner=boundsCF:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(half.X*x,half.Y*y,half.Z*z))
			local q=orientation:VectorToObjectSpace(corner)
			distance=math.max(distance,q.Z+math.abs(q.X)/tanH,q.Z+math.abs(q.Y)/tanV)
		end end end
		distance*=1.15
	end
	v.CurrentCamera.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(center+direction*distance,center)
end
local function show(v,model,actor,yaw,pitch)

	if not model then return end
	local n=0
	for _,p in model:GetDescendants() do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.Anchored=true;p.CanCollide=false;n+=1
		elseif p:IsA("Trail") or p:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then p.Enabled=false end
	end
	if n==0 then model:Destroy();return end
	model.Parent=v.PreviewWorld
	local cf,size=model:GetBoundingBox()
	local span=math.max(size.Y,size.X/(v.Size.X.Offset/v.Size.Y.Offset),size.Z*.8,1)
	local distance=span/(2*math.tan(math.rad(16)))*1.18
	v:SetAttribute("OrbitCenter",cf.Position);v:SetAttribute("OrbitDistance",distance)
	if v:GetAttribute("FitBoundsOnOrbit") then v:SetAttribute("OrbitBoundsSize",size);v:SetAttribute("OrbitBoundsCFrame",cf) end
	orbit(v,yaw or 18,pitch or 5)
end

		if v:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or v:IsA("JointInstance") or v:IsA("Animator") then v:Destroy()
		elseif v:IsA("BasePart") then v.Anchored=true

	end
	for _,name in {"EquipmentArmor","TrainingArmor","TrainingWeapon","WeaponR","WeaponL"} do

		armorTab.BackgroundColor3=if self.Category=="Armor" then selectedColor else cardColor;setSelected(armorTab,self.Category=="Armor")
		weaponList.Visible=self.Category=="Weapons";armorList.Visible=self.Category=="Armor";headers.Visible=armorList.Visible;remove.Visible=armorList.Visible
		if not self.Selected then
			self.Selected=if self.Category=="Weapons" then {Id=equippedWeapon()} else {Id=Armor.read(player,self.Target).Head,Slot="Head"}
		end
		local selection=self.Selected
		for id,b in weaponButtons do
			b.BackgroundColor3=if selection.Id==id then selectedColor else cardColor;setSelected(b,selection.Id==id and self.Category=="Weapons")
			local level=if id=="Hammer" and self.Target=="Player" then hammerLevel() else 1
			weaponLevels[id].Text=if level==nil then "Cấp độ: đang cập nhật…" elseif id=="Hammer" and self.Target=="Player" and level>=2 then "CẤP 2  ·  +15% sát thương" else "CẤP "..level..(if equippedWeapon()==id then "  ·  ĐANG DÙNG" else "  ·  SỞ HỮU")
		end
		if self.Category=="Weapons" then
			equip.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(248,42)

			local item=Builder.build(selection.Id)

			if offhand then offhand:PivotTo(CFrame.new(if selection.Id=="DualDaggers" then .85 else 1.7,0,0)) end
			show(itemView,item,false)
			local level=if selection.Id=="Hammer" and self.Target=="Player" then hammerLevel() else 1
			info.Text=(if selection.Id==equippedWeapon() then "ĐANG TRANG BỊ" else "ĐÃ SỞ HỮU · CÓ THỂ TRANG BỊ")
				.."\n"..(if level==nil then "Đang cập nhật cấp độ…" else "Cấp "..level)..(if selection.Id=="Hammer" and self.Target=="Player" and level and level>=2 then " · +15% sát thương" else "")
				.."\n\n"..tostring(weapons[selection.Id].Description or "Vũ khí thợ săn")
			remove.Visible=false
		else
			equip.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(158,42)
			local current=Armor.read(player,self.Target)
			for id,row in cells do
				local worn=0
				for slot,data in row do
					show(data.Viewport,Armor.icon(self.Target,slot,id),false)
					data.Tick.Visible=current[slot]==id;if data.Tick.Visible then worn+=1 end
					local active=id==selection.Id and slot==selection.Slot
					data.Button.BackgroundColor3=if active then selectedColor else cardColor;setSelected(data.Button,active)
				end
				setProgress[id].Text=worn.."/5";setProgress[id].TextColor3=if worn==5 then readyColor else gold
			end
			selectedName.Text=(Armor.ItemNames[selection.Slot] or "Giáp").." • "..(Armor.Sets[selection.Id] and Armor.Sets[selection.Id].Name or "Không mặc")
			show(itemView,Armor.icon(self.Target,selection.Slot,selection.Id),false)

		end
		drawActor()
	end
	local function chooseTarget(target)
		if stopDrag then stopDrag() end
		api.Section="Equipment";api.Target=target;api.Selected=nil;api:Refresh()
	end
	itemsTab.Activated:Connect(function() api.Section="Items";api:Refresh() end)
	specimensTab.Activated:Connect(function() api.Section="Specimens";api:Refresh() end)
	craftTab.Activated:Connect(function() api.Section="Crafting";api:Refresh() end)
	playerTab.Activated:Connect(function() chooseTarget("Player") end)
	petTab.Activated:Connect(function() chooseTarget("Pet") end)
	weaponTab.Activated:Connect(function() api.Category="Weapons";api.Selected=nil;api:Refresh() end)
	armorTab.Activated:Connect(function() api.Category="Armor";api.Selected=nil;api:Refresh() end)
	local dragInput,lastPointer,dragCamera,dragView
	stopDrag=function()
		if dragView==specimenView then specimenAutoResumeAt=os.clock()+1.5 end
		dragInput=nil;lastPointer=nil;dragView=nil
		if dragCamera then
			if dragCamera.Camera.CameraType==Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then dragCamera.Camera.CameraType=dragCamera.Type end
			dragCamera=nil
		end
	end
	for _,v in {actorView,specimenView} do
		table.insert(connections,v.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if panel.Visible and (input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
				if dragInput then return end
				local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
				dragCamera={Camera=camera,Type=camera.CameraType};camera.CameraType=Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
				dragInput=input;dragView=v;lastPointer=Vector2.new(input.Position.X,input.Position.Y)
			end
		end))
	end
	table.insert(connections,UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if not dragInput or not panel.Visible then return end
		if not (dragInput.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) and input~=dragInput then return end
		local position=Vector2.new(input.Position.X,input.Position.Y)
		local delta=(position-lastPointer)/math.max(scale.Scale,.1);lastPointer=position
		if dragView==specimenView then
			api.SpecimenYaw=(api.SpecimenYaw-delta.X*.45)%360
			api.SpecimenPitch=math.clamp(api.SpecimenPitch+delta.Y*.35,-65,65)
			orbit(specimenView,api.SpecimenYaw,api.SpecimenPitch)
		else
			api.Yaw=(api.Yaw-delta.X*.45)%360
			api.Pitch=math.clamp(api.Pitch+delta.Y*.35,-65,65)
			orbit(actorView,api.Yaw,api.Pitch)
		end
	end))
	table.insert(connections,UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input==dragInput or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then stopDrag() end
	end))
	table.insert(connections,UIS.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(stopDrag))
	table.insert(connections,RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(delta)
		if panel.Visible and api.Section=="Specimens" and displayedSpecimenKey and dragView~=specimenView and os.clock()>=specimenAutoResumeAt then
			api.SpecimenYaw=(api.SpecimenYaw+delta*12)%360
			orbit(specimenView,api.SpecimenYaw,api.SpecimenPitch)
		end
	end))
	resetView.Activated:Connect(function() stopDrag();api.Yaw=18;api.Pitch=5;orbit(actorView,api.Yaw,api.Pitch) end)
	resetSpecimenView.Activated:Connect(function() stopDrag();api.SpecimenYaw=55;api.SpecimenPitch=12;orbit(specimenView,api.SpecimenYaw,api.SpecimenPitch) end)
	close.Activated:Connect(function() panel.Visible=false end)
	equip.Activated:Connect(function()
		if api.Section~="Equipment" then return end
		local s=api.Selected;if s then remote:FireServer("EquipInventory",{Target=api.Target,Kind=api.Category,Id=s.Id,Slot=s.Slot}) end
	end)
	remove.Activated:Connect(function()
		local s=api.Selected;if api.Section=="Equipment" and s and api.Category=="Armor" then
			remote:FireServer("EquipInventory",{Target=api.Target,Kind="Armor",Id="None",Slot=s.Slot})
			api.Selected={Id="None",Slot=s.Slot};api:Refresh()
		end
	end)
	table.insert(connections,panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		stopDrag()
		cover.Visible=panel.Visible
		if panel.Visible then
			if inventoryDisplayOrder==nil then inventoryDisplayOrder=gui.DisplayOrder end
			gui.DisplayOrder=math.max(100,inventoryDisplayOrder+1)
		elseif inventoryDisplayOrder~=nil then gui.DisplayOrder=inventoryDisplayOrder;inventoryDisplayOrder=nil end
		if panel.Visible then api.Selected=nil;api:Refresh();economyRemote:FireServer("GetInventory") else actorView.PreviewWorld:ClearAllChildren();itemView.PreviewWorld:ClearAllChildren();specimenView.PreviewWorld:ClearAllChildren();displayedSpecimenKey=nil end
	end))
	table.insert(connections,economyRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(event,dto)
		if event=="OpenSpecimenTube" then
			local slot=if type(dto)=="table" then dto.Slot else nil
			if type(slot)~="number" or slot%1~=0 or slot<1 or slot>5 or player:GetAttribute("Drawn")==true then return end
			stopDrag();api.Section="Specimens";api.SelectedDisplaySlot=slot
			local currentId=displaySlots()[slot];if currentId then api.SelectedSpecimenId=currentId end
			panel.Visible=true;api:Refresh();economyRemote:FireServer("GetInventory")
			return
		end
		if (event~="Snapshot" and event~="Open") or type(dto)~="table" then return end
		local revision=dto.Revision
		if type(revision)~="number" or revision~=revision or math.abs(revision)==math.huge or (itemSnapshot and revision<itemSnapshot.Revision) then return end
		itemSnapshot=dto
		if panel.Visible then api:Refresh() end
	end))
	local attributes={"WeaponId","PetWeaponId"}
	for _,target in {"Player","Pet"} do for _,slot in Armor.Slots do table.insert(attributes,target.."Armor_"..slot) end end
	for _,attr in attributes do table.insert(connections,player:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attr):Connect(function() api:Refresh() end)) end
	table.insert(connections,player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() task.delay(.5,function() if panel.Parent then api:Refresh() end end) end))
	panel.Destroying:Connect(function() stopDrag();if inventoryDisplayOrder~=nil then gui.DisplayOrder=inventoryDisplayOrder end;for _,c in connections do c:Disconnect() end;cover:Destroy() end)
	return api
end
return Inventory

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local PetStanding = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("PetStanding"))
local PetAnimator = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared:WaitForChild("PetAnimator"))
local pets = workspace:WaitForChild("TrainingPets")
local entries = {}

local function discard(model)
	local entry = entries[model]
	if entry then entry.anim:Destroy(); entries[model] = nil end
end

local connection = RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function(dt)
	for model in entries do
		if model.Parent ~= pets or not model:FindFirstChild("Root") then discard(model) end
	end
	for _, model in pets:GetChildren() do
		if not model:IsA("Model") then continue end
		local entry = entries[model]
		if not entry then
			local rig = PetStanding.bind(model)
			if not rig then continue end
			entry = { anim = PetAnimator.new(model, rig, nil), sequence = -1, weapon = nil }
			entries[model] = entry
		end
		local anim = entry.anim
		local id = model:GetAttribute("PetWeaponId")
		if entry.weapon ~= id or (anim.motorR and not anim.motorR.Parent) or (anim.motorL and not anim.motorL.Parent) then
			if not id or not anim:BindWeapon(id) then continue end
			entry.weapon = id
			entry.sequence = -1
		end
		anim:SetMoving(model:GetAttribute("PetMoving") == true, model:GetAttribute("PetSpeed") or 1)
		local sequence = model:GetAttribute("PetAttackSequence") or 0
		local started = model:GetAttribute("PetAttackStarted") or -1
		if started < 0 then
			anim:CancelAttack()
		elseif sequence ~= entry.sequence then
			anim:SyncAttack(workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - started)
		end
		entry.sequence = sequence
		anim:Update(dt)
	end
end)

script.Destroying:Connect(function()
	connection:Disconnect()
	for model in entries do discard(model) end
end)
